d.description:
About the Company

At Covera Health, we're on a mission to improve healthcare by making every diagnosis more accurate.

Every year, millions of patients receive imaging that shapes life changing medical decisions. Yet too often, important findings are missed, patients struggle to access high quality imaging, and the healthcare system treats radiology like a commodity instead of one of the most critical moments in a patient's care journey.

We're changing that.

Covera combines clinical expertise, advanced AI, and one of the industry's largest radiology quality datasets to help detect disease earlier, improve diagnostic accuracy, and give clinicians greater confidence in every decision they make. Better diagnoses lead to better treatment, fewer unnecessary procedures, lower healthcare costs, and, most importantly, better outcomes for patients.

In 2026, Covera and Medmo came together to create the first platform designed to support the entire radiology journey. From helping patients find and schedule high quality imaging, to coordinating care, to ensuring the accuracy of every diagnosis, we're building a connected experience that simply hasn't existed before.

Backed by Insight Partners, our platform supports nearly 6 million people across Fortune 10 and Fortune 100 employers, three of the five largest national health plans, and thousands of value based primary care physicians.

This is an exciting moment to join Covera. We're building technology that is helping detect serious conditions earlier, improving the quality of care for millions of patients, and redefining what healthcare can be. If you're excited by meaningful work, ambitious teammates, and the opportunity to help save lives through better healthcare, we'd love to meet you.

About the role

Covera's Population Health program is scaling rapidly across multiple states and a growing roster of national and regional health plan and provider clients. Each client needs a clear, credible performance story: what the program found, what closed, what it was worth, and where it should grow next. The Manager, Growth and Reporting owns that story, turning the program's analytics into client-facing reporting, performance-review materials, and expansion business cases that drive retention and wallet-share growth.

The seam is deliberate: Performance Analytics produces the numbers; this role turns numbers into insight and growth; Customer Engagement runs the client relationship rhythm. You are the bridge between what the data says and what the client decides to do next.

This role will initially report to the Chief Financial & Operations Officer before transitioning to the VP, Population Health as that leader joins the organization. This reporting structure is intentional and reflects the long-term design of the team.

In this role, you will be expected to:

•
Own client performance reporting: the recurring reporting packages and performance-review materials for every client, built on the Performance Analytics function's data.

•
Own the performance narrative: translating gap identification, closure results, and program value into materials a health plan or provider executive acts on, with disciplined distinctions the client can trust; submitted is not closed, and immature cohorts are labeled as such.

•
Make reporting actionable at the practice level: which practices are converting, which need intervention, and what happens next, built with the analytics and clinical functions, so every performance review ends in an action, not just a summary.

•
Support growth: identify and build the case for wallet-share expansion with existing clients, including additional services, pathologies, and populations, with supporting materials.

•
Work with Covera's clinical team to understand the clinical and economic pathway for each pathology the program surfaces, what appropriate care looks like and what it is worth, grounded in claims analysis or credible third-party studies, and build that understanding into client materials so growth conversations carry clinical and economic weight.

•
Build a consistent, scalable reporting framework, including a stage-level funnel view from finding to closure, that holds up as the book grows, rather than bespoke decks per client, and uphold the standard that no definitive claims about a partner's results or future direction appear in external materials without that partner's approval.

•
In your first 90 days: take over the live reporting calendar without a gap in cadence, ship the standard reporting package, stand up reporting for newly onboarding clients, and deliver the first expansion business case with program leadership.

Requirements:

•
Experience turning healthcare performance data into executive-facing narratives: client success, consulting, health plan account management, or program reporting backgrounds all fit.

•
Working familiarity with the reports behind the story: claims-based analysis, eligibility data, and Medicare reporting such as MAO-004 or CDI, enough to understand what the data means, pressure-test it, and articulate the actionable insight, even though producing it belongs to the analytics function.

•
Comfort building pathology-level value narratives: the clinical pathway, the economics of appropriate care, and the evidence base behind both, developed in partnership with clinical experts.

•
Strong materials craft: you build clear, credible decks and documents quickly, and know the difference between reporting data and telling a client what it means.

•
Commercial instinct: you spot the expansion opportunity inside a performance review and can build the case for it.

•
Hypothesis-driven by habit: you ask the relevant questions, form a view, test it, verify the result, and repeat. We will ask what you built, what changed as a result, and what failed.

•
Fluency with value-based care and Medicare programs sufficient to hold the room with plan and provider stakeholders.

•

About the Role

We're looking for someone who's deeply plugged into internet culture. If you're always spotting trends before they peak, understand why certain creators or memes take off, and instinctively know what content feels native to social media, you'll fit right in.

You'll work closely with the marketing team to turn internet trends and creator insights into campaigns that people actually engage with.

What You'll Do

• Spot emerging trends, memes, creators, and conversations worth jumping on.
• Identify and collaborate with creators who fit the brand.
• Collaborate in creative concepts and scripts for creator-led content and social campaigns.
• Analyse what content, hooks, and narratives are working and repurpose those insights into high-performing ads.
• Test different creative ideas, measure performance, and use data to continuously improve content and campaigns.

Who We're Looking For

• 0-3 years of experience creating content or working with a brand known for great content (internships and personal projects count).
• A self starter who lives on Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, X, or other internet communities.
• Understands pop culture, creator ecosystems, and the language of the internet.
• Curious, creative, and comfortable experimenting in a fast-moving startup.
• Strong communication skills with an eye for good content.
• Bonus if you've built your own content page, worked with creators, or have a portfolio of content you're proud of.

When You Apply

Don't just send us a resume. Show us your work, whether it's a portfolio, social page, videos, campaigns, or anything else that reflects your creative thinking and visual direction. And tell us one original opinion on a trend, creator, or brand campaign. We care less about the "right" answer and more about how you think.

What You'll Get

• Work directly with the founding team.
• Own creator marketing from idea to execution.
• Learn how content, creators, and performance marketing work together.
• A front-row seat to building a consumer brand through creativity, experimentation, and culture.

d.description:
We maximize product availability with minimal cashflow investment in 1/10 of the time. We solve a real problem for SMEs. With AI.

VOIDS is the AI brain for mid-size Shopify brands inventory. We forecast demand at the product level, catch stockouts and inefficiencies before they happen, and give e-commerce teams exactly the right action — or execute it automatically with a single click.

The result: 98% inventory efficiency, 20x ROI, and six-figure cash unlocked. Within weeks.

We launched in June 2023. Since then: 300% growth, 1B+ data points processed, €2M ARR, and 50+ brands live — including Hyrox, 6pm, Creamyfabrics, and NatureHeart. Now, we're targeting €10M ARR by 2028.

Today we own demand forecasting and stock management. Our vision for tomorrow: AI handles procurement end-to-end — fully autonomous.

This is where you come in. We're a small, fast team and every hire shapes the trajectory of the company. You'll shape how we ingest, process, and activate 1B+ data points, and help us build the data foundation for a fully AI-driven procurement future. Work directly with Jannik and Tobias, who live and breathe e-commerce and AI.

High autonomy. Real data scale. Work that actually ships.

We're just getting started — want to build it with us?

Tasks

You'll own the reliability and growth of our data infrastructure end-to-end. This isn't a ticket-execution role — you'll identify problems, design solutions, and ship them yourself.

Connectivity Expansion & Integrations

• Expand our data connector ecosystem far beyond Shopify and Amazon, paving the way for complete AI-driven custom integrations.

• Evaluate, implement, and maintain new data sources in a way that works with existing flows — system stability and customization tolerance are non-negotiable.

• Work closely with customers to understand their data sources, requirements, and edge cases — you are the first technical contact when it comes to what data goes into our system.

Customer & Team Collaboration

• Communicate fluently in German and English — with customers during onboarding and pilot projects, and async with the internal team.

• Act as a bridge between customer needs and technical implementation, translating real-world data messiness into clean, reliable pipelines.

• Understand the e-commerce space intuitively - Suggest solutions to customers and implemented them before the customers even asks for it.

Data Pipeline Architecture

• Take ownership of our Bronze → Silver → Gold medallion architecture: the logic between layers needs to be airtight, well-documented, and consistent.

• Scale the piplines to new heights: More data, faster pipelines, less costs. You need to find abstraction layer that allow to scale across multiple customer with very unique requirements.

• Improve Developer Experience: Enable fast iterations cycles and smooth developer experience when working with existing systems or building new things on top.

AI-Delegated Development Workflows

• Fully embrace AI tooling — not just as a productivity booster, but as a core part of how you work: delegate end-to-end workflows (testing, development, staging, production) to AI agents where possible.

• Build and maintain AI-driven pipelines that can handle deep customiszation without system failures — the architecture must be robust enough that AI-generated changes don't break production.

• Push the limits of what's achievable by combining your engineering judgment with AI automation. 10x yourself every year.

Data Quality, Testing & Reliability

• Own the full development lifecycle: testing → development → staging → production, with automated checks at every layer.

• Set up and maintain robust testing environments and DataOps/MLOps workflows to enable rapid iteration.

• Proactively identify bottlenecks, inconsistencies, and schema drift — and fix them before they reach downstream consumers.

Requirements

✅ Must-Have Skills

• Fluent German and English — both written and spoken (customer-facing communication required)

• 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering or closely related roles

• 3+ years experience in Python, particularly with data manipulation libraries (Pandas, Polars) for efficient data processing

• Deep proficiency in SQL and PostgreSQL for structured data

• Hands-on experience building and maintaining scalable streaming, event-driven and batch data pipelines and workflows as inputs for web applications and AI models

• Proven ability to set up and maintain robust testing environments, and manage efficient DataOps/MLOps workflows to enable rapid iteration

• Familiarity with infrastructure and containerization frameworks (Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform)

• End-to-end expertise in designing and operating scalable data platforms, including storage (S3/Parquet), data pipelines, APIs, and connectors, with a strong grasp of layered data architectures.

• Strong understanding of medallion / layered data architecture — and the ability to fix one that isn't working properly

• Daily, fluent use of AI tools — you actively delegate end-to-end workflows to AI: from testing and development through to staging and production. AI is not a helper tool; it's how you multiply your output.

• Strong product intuition and understanding with a proactive, ownership-oriented mindset

• Comfortable with ambiguity, autonomous decision-making, and direct customer contact

🌟 Bonus / Nice-to-Have

• Experience in B2B AI startups / scale-ups

• Experience with eCommerce data sets and solutions (Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Klaviyo, Channable, etc.)

• Familiarity with scalable big data tools and frameworks (dbt, dask, Apache Spark, EMR, Databricks, AWS Glue)

• Familiarity or interest in Data Science workflows, especially related to time series forecasting (Nixtla, Darts, statsmodels, sktime)

• Contributions to developer experience, data observability, or internal tooling improvements

🧱 Tech Stack

• Programming: Python (Pandas, Polars), SQL

d.description:
About Exa

AI agents need to find information on the web. Exa is building the search engine they use to do it.

We built our own web index and retrieval models from scratch. Today, Exa powers products at companies including Cursor, Cognition, and HubSpot. In 2026, we crossed $100 million in annualized revenue and 2 billion searches per month.

We raised a $250 million Series C led by a16z, with participation from Benchmark, Lightspeed, and Y Combinator. Our team of researchers, engineers, builders, and former founders is primarily based in San Francisco.

We are looking for a social media strategist to shape Exa’s voice, create original content, and bring our work to the developers and technology leaders building with AI.

About the role

Exa built a search engine from scratch for AI. You will show the world what people can build with it and introduce them to the people behind it.

You will own Exa’s organic social presence and make it worth following. You will spend time with the people building the product, find the ideas that deserve an audience, and turn them into posts, videos, and series that people actually want to share.

This is a role for someone who can set the strategy and create content themselves. One day you might interview an engineer about a search breakthrough. The next, you might help a founder turn an idea into a post or show what an AI agent can do with Exa.

You will report to the head of communications and work closely with product marketing and our creative team.

What you'll do

•
Social strategy. Build the plan for Exa’s company channels, starting with X and LinkedIn. Give each a purpose and a point of view. Decide where else we should show up and what is worth the investment.

•
Original content. Find the stories inside Exa and bring them to life through posts, short videos, interviews, and visual content. Create recurring formats that make people want to come back. Make technical ideas accessible without losing what makes them interesting.

•
Executive presence. Work with our founders and leaders to turn their ideas into posts that sound like them. Bring them opportunities to contribute to conversations about AI, search, and building a company.

•
Launches and company moments. Own the social plan for product releases, research, customer stories, and events. Show what a new capability makes possible. Coordinate timing, assets, and reviews across company and executive channels.

What success looks like

•
More developers and technology leaders know Exa and follow our work.

•
Our channels show what Exa can do and give people a reason to come back.

•
Launch posts put new capabilities in action and bring interested people to the product.

•
Our founders and leaders share ideas that sound like them and add something to the conversation.

•
Our recurring formats build an audience, and we know what to improve or stop.

•
We move quickly from idea to publication without compromising accuracy or quality.

Who you are

•
You have at least five years of experience in social media, editorial, or content creation, including work you made yourself.

•
You can show how your strategy and creative decisions helped grow an audience.

•
You write clearly, edit rigorously, and know how to make a technical subject interesting.

•
You can film and edit short videos and create simple visual assets independently.

•
You know what works on different platforms and create for each one.

•
You are curious about AI, search, and developer tools, and can make them fun and accessible to different audiences.

•
You enjoy working with founders and engineers, can manage competing deadlines, and follow through on details.

•
You use AI tools thoughtfully and know when a story needs original reporting and human judgment.

Logistics/Benefits

•
This is an in-person role in SF.

•
Health and wellness: Premium medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus a monthly wellness benefit, and a monthly commuter benefit.

•
Fertility and family planning: Reimbursement for eligible egg freezing and related medical expenses up to a $15,000 lifetime maximum, plus 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, whether through birth, adoption, surrogacy, or foster placement.

•
Life at Exa: Lunch and dinner served daily, an office stocked with snacks, coffee, and health supplements

•
Visa sponsorship: We sponsor visas for exceptional candidates and welcome applicants from all backgrounds and locations.

Exa is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related conditions, criminal histories consistent with applicable law, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

d.description:
About Esper

Esper revolutionizes device management by redefining what it should be: a driver of business growth. With advanced and modern capabilities, automation replaces outdated workflows, re-provisioning becomes obsolete, and managing by exception transforms efficiency, resulting in increased efficiency, improved ROI, and bolsters security for device fleets of all sizes. Esper has been recognized as number 735 on Inc. Magazine's 2025 5000 fastest-growing private companies in America, and 133 on the 2024 Deloitte Technology Fast 500. Some of the world’s most innovative brands, like Google, Doordash, Taco Bell, Clinical ink, SF 49ers, and Intelity, rely on Esper to deliver exceptional device experiences. Esper partners with the leading mobile device hardware manufacturers, solution providers, and distributors globally.

About The Role

Esper is entering its next chapter: new products, new industries, and a brand ready for a bigger stage. We are looking for our first VP of Enterprise Marketing to define how the world's leading restaurant and retail brands experience Esper.

Our buyers are a select group of technology and operations leaders at some of the largest brands in the world. Your job is to make sure each of them knows Esper, trusts Esper, and thinks of Esper first. You will create experiences senior leaders want to be part of, build a brand that feels premium, technical and genuinely useful, and make sure Esper is present wherever those leaders gather.

You will also get to build marketing the way it should be built today: AI-native from day one, with a small, talented team and the tools to do the work of a much larger one.

You will report to our COO and Revenue Lead and join the revenue leadership team, working closely with Sales, Partnerships, OEM, Customer Engineering and Product. This role is for a builder who wants real ownership and wants to see the impact of their work in the room.

What You'll Do

• Own the enterprise marketing strategy. Define and execute a focused marketing strategy aligned with Esper's growth priorities, identifying the industries, accounts, channels and investments that will deliver the greatest business impact.
• Create experiences leaders remember. Design and host invitation-only Esper experiences for senior technology leaders, make every flagship industry moment count, and build Esper's own gatherings for customers and partners.
• Open doors at the top. Create memorable, high-touch programs that start conversations with executives at the brands we most want to work with.
• Turn engagement into opportunity. Partner closely with Sales on account-based strategies that build executive relationships, accelerate enterprise opportunities, and contribute to qualified pipeline and revenue growth.
• Shape the brand. Lead creative direction across every touchpoint so Esper looks and sounds like the premium, technical leader it is, while staying open and developer-friendly.
• Put Esper in front of the industry. Host Esper's own experiences, win speaking slots for Esper's leaders and customers at industry events, and run press and analyst relations, so Esper becomes a recognized name in restaurant and retail technology.
• Build an AI-native marketing engine. Use AI to understand which companies and leaders are engaging with Esper, and to research, personalize and orchestrate outreach at a scale a small team could never reach alone.
• Bring our story to the right people. Partner with Product, who create our content and product story, to put it in front of the leaders who matter most.
• Invest with conviction. Own the marketing budget, decide where it goes, and show the return.
• Lead and grow the team. Coach a small, capable team and build the function for what comes next.

Qualifications

• 10 or more years in B2B marketing, including leading enterprise or field marketing for technical products sold to large organizations.
• You have built a marketing function or a new motion from the ground up, and you can point to the results.
• You have created experiences for senior executives that people still talk about.
• Strong creative instincts and a body of work that shows taste.
• At ease with executives and press, and comfortable hosting and presenting to executive audiences.
• Hands-on with AI: you build with it, not just buy it.
• Commercially minded: you connect every program to business outcomes.
• High agency and a bias to action.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in an ecosystem-led motion with OEMs, ISVs or payment partners.
• Account-based programs aimed at Fortune 1000 operators.

Salary Band

$300K - $400K OTE

Perks & Benefits

• Medical, Dental, Vision 90% covered by the company
• Life insurance
• FSA (Medical & Dependent)
• 401K with a company match that vests immediately
• Pet insurance discount
• Unlimited time off policy with a mandatory 2 weeks off (minimum)
• Family Benefits: Maternity, Parental, Adoption, & Surrogacy leave
• Stand up desks with 36” curved widescreen monitors for each employee
• Team hikes and other fun events (e.g. mini-golf, bowling, board game nights, trivia, outdoor events, etc.) on a monthly basis

Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Esper we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

d.description:
Who we are

AMCS is a leading software provider to the Waste & Recycling industry. Our AI-enabled platform connects every stage of a waste or recycling operation, from customer management and routing to billing and business insight. We serve commercial and industrial, municipal, residential, construction and demolition, and metal recycling businesses. Our customers protect margins, run more efficiently, and grow sustainably. We're headquartered in Ireland, with teams across Europe, North America, and Australasia, and we're backed by EQT.

We've kept the Irish roots and start-up mentality we began with. Our culture is built on connection – to our work, our customers, our colleagues, and our community.

The role

We're hiring a Team Lead to run our EMEA field marketing team. You'll do two jobs at once. You'll lead and enable the in-region team, and you'll stay hands-on, building and running the demand programmes that win and expand our strategic accounts.

You'll work closely with EMEA sales leaders, customer success, and global marketing. Your goal is simple: turn account plans into pipeline and revenue.

Primary Responsibilities

To lead the EMEA field marketing team, you'll:

• Lead, coach, and develop a regional team of field and event marketers
• Set clear priorities and expectations, and hold the team to them
• Give the team the playbooks, tools, and context they need, and clear blockers fast
• Act as the face of marketing in-region, trusted by sales leaders, country teams, and customers
• Manage the EMEA field budget and coordinate with our agencies & local partners
• Use AI tools to raise team productivity, from campaign planning and content localisation to reporting, and set the standard for how the team uses them
• Stay hands-on, building and running priority account programmes yourself alongside the team
• Work with EMEA sales leaders to select and tier strategic target and install base accounts
• Map the decision-makers in each account and tailor messaging to them
• Run account-based programmes such as executive roundtables, customer events, hosted dinners, and site visits
• Plan and run tradeshow, conference, and owned-event presence, with clear goals set before we commit spend
• Adapt global campaigns to regional markets, regulations, and buyer behaviour in waste, recycling, and transport
• Partner with customer success and sales on cross-sell, upsell, and win-back plays in our existing customer base
• Own regional field targets for pipeline sourced, pipeline influenced, account engagement, and event return on investment (ROI)
• Track results in Salesforce and our marketing platforms, and say plainly what's working and what to stop
• Keep a live regional plan with clear status on every programme
• Bring regional insight back to global strategy, messaging, and the product roadmap
• Partner with global field marketing, demand generation, product marketing, content, and brand
• Share what works with your peers in North America and Australasia
• 10+ years of B2B marketing experience in enterprise software or technology, with a track record in field marketing, account-based marketing, or regional growth
• Experience marketing into long, complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders and executive buyers
• Experience leading and enabling a team, ideally across several countries
• A hands-on approach: you're as happy building a campaign as you are leading the people who run it
• A record of building and running account-based campaigns against a named account list, in partnership with sales
• Strong knowledge of marketing across EMEA's countries, cultures, and regulations
• Budget management and clear ROI measurement
• Working knowledge of Salesforce and a marketing automation platform
• Clear, direct communication, including when the news isn't good
• Credibility with sales leaders as a partner who helps them hit their targets
• Hands-on experience using AI tools to help a team deliver more, and a practical view of where they help and where they don't
• Willingness to travel across the region
• Experience in a PE-backed or fast-growing software business
• Experience launching or scaling a customer event programme
• Experience building planning and reporting systems that give sales leaders clear visibility of marketing programmes

d.description:
LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.

Join us to transform the way the world works.

Job Description

This role will be based in New York, Chicago, San Francisco, Sunnyvale, Bellevue, DC, Detroit or Omaha.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

LinkedIn is searching for a Senior Planning & Performance Manager to join the Strategic Planning & Initiatives team within Go-to-Market Operations who will play a key role in leading and defining future-state business processes and driving transformational initiatives for our LinkedIn Marketing Solutions business. The Senior Manager will leverage their business and people leadership skills, superior communication, relationship building, project management and analytical abilities to lead, execute and scale operational and planning processes that are key to business success.

Candidates hoping to fill this role must be an experience people leader, proactive, collaborative, solution-oriented and comfortable managing multiple cross-functional relationships and projects concurrently. The ideal candidate can effectively communicate with executives and collaborate with a variety of people and job functions, accomplishing tasks of high complexity and scope, and perform professionally in a challenging, ambiguous, and fast-paced environment. We're seeking a leader who can recognize opportunities to drive business growth or improve processes and who can lead a team to bring these ideas to life.

Responsibilities

• Lead and develop a high-performance team.
• Coach the team on big-picture thinking and operational rigor, and mentor them with a focus on skill and career development.
• Deliver on key global processes such as annual planning; designing, building, and optimizing sales territories; forecasting; comp design and quota setting and management.
• Lead strategic and operational projects impacting the Sales and GTM Ops organization, including GTM strategy development, client intelligence, process improvement, and automation.
• Identify and track KPIs to inform leadership of the health of the business.
• Drive operational efficiency through short and long-term process optimization.
• Identify and appropriately escalate risks and recommend options for resolution.
• Develop mitigations and solutions with various stakeholders to ensure successful business outcomes.
• Proactively identify business problem statements and recommend path forward.
• Create strong collaborative partnerships with a wide range of stakeholders.
• Act like an owner and have an impact outside of core functions by demonstrating leadership, providing leverage and producing results that will help effectively scale.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

• 8+ years of experience in go-to-market/sales/business operations, consulting, investment banking, finance, strategy or analytics
• 3+ years of people management in a similar context
• Experience with data analysis/modelling (Excel, SQL) and the ability to see beyond the numbers to drive sound decision-making.
• Knowledge of MS Office (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel)
• BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications:

• Knowledge of key sales and planning processes, including Territory Planning, Segmentation, Quota allocation, Pipeline and Forecasting, Business Performance Management and Compensation design
• Exceptional problem solving and analytical skills; demonstrated ability to structure complex problems, navigate challenging data sets, develop solutions, and craft high-quality executive presentations
• Ability to effectively manage time, prioritize tasks, and work within deadlines with little supervision for themselves and the team
• Experience working in high-growth, performance focused environments
• Excellent collaboration, influence, organizational, and program management skills
• Ability to define ambiguous problems and drive towards outcomes
• Ability to think strategically with a proven track record of providing consultative and data driven solutions
• Ability to work effectively, influence and drive accountability with a broad range of cross-functional teams and stakeholders
• Strong communication skills written and verbal, including experience communicating with senior leaders
• Experience working with CRM, sales and data visualization tools
• Ability to learn new tools quickly
• Process and workflow design
• Experience working in the digital advertising or marketing industry or large-scale tech company
• AI fluency
• MBA or advanced degree preferred
• Experience Managing people managers

Suggested Skills:

• Stakeholder Management
• Communication
• Coaching
• Data Analysis & Storytelling
• Prioritization

LinkedIn is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

The pay range for this role is $159,000 to $258,000. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor.

The total compensation package for this position may also include annual performance bonus, stock, benefits and/or other applicable incentive comp

Job Type

Description

Paylocity is an award-winning provider of cloud-based HR and payroll software solutions, offering the most complete platform for the modern workforce. The company has become one of the fastest-growing HCM software providers worldwide by offering an intuitive, easy-to-use product suite that helps businesses automate and streamline HR and payroll processes, attract and retain talent, and build a strong workplace culture.

While traditional HR and payroll providers automate basic HR processes such as payroll and benefits administration, Paylocity goes further by developing tools that HR and businesses need to compete for talent and deliver against the expectations of the modern workforce.

We give our employees what they need to succeed, including great benefits and perks! We offer medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and a 401(k) match, as well as perks that support you, your family, and your finances. And if it’s career development you desire, we provide that, too! At Paylocity, people matter most and have always been at the heart of our business.

As part of the Sales & Marketing team, you’ll help us solve challenges and succeed as you grow and understand the unique needs of our clients and tailor easy-to-use solutions to deliver the performance they need.

With a position in Sales & Marketing, you’ll strengthen our relationships with clients, anticipate their needs, and think outside the box to unlock new possibilities.

Position Overview

This role leads the development and execution of product marketing strategies to achieve business objectives, focusing on product positioning, messaging, and go-to market plans. This is a highly visible leadership role within the organization which will have a significant impact on the long-term growth of a fast-growing business.

Primary Responsibilities

The below represents the primary duties of the position, others may be assigned as needed. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

• Set the vision and strategy for Product Marketing, establishing the priorities, operating model, and measures of success needed to support company growth, customer acquisition, and expansion.
• Build strong, trusted relationships with senior Product and Sales leaders, serving as a strategic partner who connects product strategy, market needs, and the realities of how we sell. Bring a clear point of view, influence decisions, and create alignment across these organizations.
• Own the company’s product and portfolio narrative, translating our platform, product strategy, and innovation into clear, compelling stories for customers, prospects, sales teams, analysts, and the market.
• Lead the company-wide development of product positioning, messaging, value propositions, and competitive differentiation across products, customer segments, and the customer lifecycle.
• Partner deeply with Product leadership throughout the product lifecycle, bringing customer research, market and competitive intelligence, win-loss insights, and commercial needs into product strategy and prioritization, not just go-to-market execution.
• Build a disciplined, scalable go-to-market and launch approach for new products, capabilities, and strategic initiatives, creating alignment across Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer teams on priorities, roles, readiness, and measures of success.
• Partner closely with Sales leadership to understand what is happening in the field and translate product strategy into a clear, differentiated story Sales can confidently take to market. Ensure teams have the positioning, proof points, competitive insights, training, and tools they need to win.
• Lead high-visibility launches and integrated campaigns that demonstrate innovation, differentiate Paylocity, build market awareness, and contribute to pipeline, revenue, adoption, and customer expansion.
• Partner closely with Demand Generation, Brand, Content, Communications, and Events to translate product strategy into compelling stories and programs that build demand and drive growth across the portfolio.
• Own Analyst Relations, building strong relationships with key industry analysts and leading the strategy for how we communicate our product vision, portfolio, innovation, and differentiation. Partner across Product, Sales, Communications, and executive leadership to ensure analysts have a clear and compelling understanding of our strategy, capabilities, and market position.
• Establish clear methods for measuring the business impact of Product Marketing, using market response, pipeline influence, win-loss insights, product adoption, customer feedback, and revenue outcomes to continuously improve strategy and execution.
• Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of product marketers. Create clear ownership, strengthen the team’s capabilities, and prioritize resources against the company’s most important growth opportunities.

Education And Experience

State the minimum education, experience, skills, and certifications/training required to successfully perform the job.

• 10+ years of marketing or product management experience at a fast-growing B2B SaaS company
• BS/BA degree in Marketing, Business, Engineering, or related field, MBA highly preferred.
• People-focused leader with proven ability to build creative, collaborative teams; develop people; and link performance to overall business objectives.
• Exceptional writer and storyteller with a demonstrated ability to translate complex products and market dynamics into clear, differentiated positioning, messaging, and narratives that resonate with customers, Sales teams, executives, and industry analysts.
• Excellent cross group collaboration

Why we are hiring now

Radical has already served thousands of cancer patients, with an average patient rating of 9.4/10 and growing organic demand. Now we want to reach millions.

We are hiring our first organic growth leader to build the engine that gets Radical in front of every cancer patient who could benefit from it, without buying our way there. You will own how patients and their families discover Radical through content, search, community, creators and word of mouth, why they trust us, and what makes them tell someone else about us.

The people who need Radical are often searching at 2am after a hard appointment, asking ChatGPT what their scan means, or reading a support group thread. We want Radical to be the clear, trusted answer in those moments.

You will start with organic growth, then help decide which channels to scale next, including paid. This is a senior individual contributor role with direct access to the founders. You will be expected to execute yourself, learn quickly, and then build a team around what works.

What you will own

Build Radical's organic content engine

Create the content and distribution system that reaches cancer patients when they need help and earns their trust: short-form video, founder-led posts, explainers from our oncologists and care team, and live sessions across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn and X. You will find the messages, formats and voices that consistently produce patients. Reach and views matter, but success is measured by booked calls and patients who activate and keep using Radical.

Turn patients into a sustainable growth channel

Build referral, word-of-mouth and community programs that patients want to share with others facing cancer. Work with patient communities, advocacy organizations and caregivers. You will work closely with patients and the care team to understand what creates trust and how to support sharing without exploiting a sensitive moment in someone's life.

Connect organic to the rest of the funnel

Partner with product on the landing pages and first steps organic visitors see, and with our growth marketing team, who run paid, to boost what is already working. Track every organic channel through to booked calls and activated patients, and stop investing in what does not move them.

Own search and AI-answer visibility

Make Radical the trusted answer when patients and families search Google, YouTube, ChatGPT and other AI assistants for help with a diagnosis, a second opinion or treatment options. Build content that is clinically accurate, reviewed by our care team, and genuinely useful on its own.

Make founders and partners a distribution channel

Run founder-led content with Simone and the team, and co-posting with our investors, partners and advisors, including Vinod Khosla, Mayo Clinic and NCCN oncologists. Find the podcasts, newsletters and creators our patients already trust, and earn coverage there instead of chasing traditional press.

Build an AI-native growth operation

Use AI to speed up research, scripting, editing, creative iteration, audience analysis and reporting. Build lightweight automations that let one person produce like a team without lowering quality. Cancer communication requires a particularly high bar.

About Radical

Radical is building an AI oncologist so that where you live doesn't determine whether you survive cancer. Our models are trained on multimodal data from more than 12 million patients at leading institutions, including the Mayo Clinic Platform.

Today, thousands of patients rely on Radical for expert second opinions and 24/7 nurse navigation. Long term, we aim to become the primary oncologist for the 80% of patients not treated at top cancer centers, taking full risk with payors to deliver care end to end.

We are backed by more than $20M from top investors, including Vinod Khosla, Mayo Clinic and NCCN oncologists.

What Radical offers

•
Competitive base salary of $160,000–$210,000, based on experience.

•

•
Visa and relocation support, including O-1 and H-1B support where applicable.

An Equinox membership and free meals in the office.

Quarterly company offsites. Past trips include Costa Rica and Las Vegas.

The opportunity to build Radical's organic growth function from the beginning.

Who we are looking for

You have spent five or more years building organic consumer growth through content, community, creators, search, referrals or partnerships at an early-stage or breakout company.

You are likely to do well here if you:

•
Have built an organic content engine yourself that scaled from zero to tens of millions of views and turned that attention into users.

Are an executor. You can set a strategy, script and ship the first piece, read the numbers and improve it yourself. You create clarity when there is no playbook.

•
Have strong creative and editorial judgment, and can make complicated or frightening subjects clear without making them simplistic.

•
Are comfortable owning a number and explaining why organic is ahead of or behind plan.

•
Have made a founder or expert the face of a brand, or run a creator or ambassador program that drove measurable signups.

•
Have grown traffic from search, YouTube or AI answers in a category where accuracy and trust matter.

•
Use AI and automation to multiply your output without lowering the quality of the work.

Healthcare experience is helpful but not required. Experience in another sensitive or regulated category, such as mental health, fertility or finance, is a plus. You should want to work very closely with cancer patients.

Your experience is mainly in paid acquisition or media buying. This role is about earned and owned growth.

d.description:
An Introduction to Primer

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Watch our showcase >

Read up on our $100m Series C

Learn more about our culture >

Which team will you be joining?

Following our Series C, we’re in a big year of hiring, and the GTM roles you own will directly shape how Primer grows across EMEA and APAC.

Talent exists to build a predictable hiring engine that lets Primer scale without compromising on who we hire, and we care about clarity, calibration and consistency more than volume. Part of that is defining what great looks like before a role opens, then assessing it through structured, repeatable processes. Automation that takes low-value work out of the process is something we value, so your time goes on the problem solving and decision making that matters.

What will you be doing?

•
You’ll lead GTM hiring across EMEA and APAC, from role definition and calibration through to offer and close.

•
You’ll work with Sales, Partnerships, Marketing and Customer Success leaders on hiring strategy, org design and headcount planning, so that what “great” looks like is agreed before a job opens.

•
You’ll make candidate experience feel human at the moments that matter, and help shape Primer’s employer brand across both regions.

•
You’ll keep the funnel honest. Pipeline health, conversion and hiring timelines are on your desk, and you’ll flag risk before it becomes a missed hire. Automation and AI will take the repetitive work off your plate.

•
Sourcing here is research-led. You’ll build talent maps and write outreach that a senior person would actually reply to, adapting to how each market recruits.

•
Market intelligence is part of the job. You’ll track talent availability, compensation and competitor hiring across both regions, and use it to shape decisions rather than report on them afterwards.

•
You'll design interview processes that are built to give a clear, consistent signal on every candidate, wherever they are based.

•
You’ll help hiring managers run their own processes well, and you’ll handle right to work, visa, employer-of-record and data rules across markets, knowing when to escalate.

What we’re looking for

Must-haves:

•
Hands-on experience hiring across GTM roles (Sales, Partnerships, Marketing and Customer Success), ideally in high-growth companies.

•
Experience hiring in EMEA, APAC or both, including how talent markets, compensation and employment practices differ between them.

•
The confidence to challenge senior stakeholders and make clear calls on the trade-offs between speed, quality and team capacity.

•
Comfort with funnel data and forecasting hiring timelines, and a habit of changing approach when the numbers say so.

•
Deep sourcing craft: personalised outreach and talent mapping, not volume.

•
Experience designing or running structured interviews where the signal is consistent and comparable across candidates.

Nice to have:

•
Hiring experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments or API-first companies.

•
Practical use of AI tools to improve efficiency without weakening the candidate experience.

•
Familiarity with Ashby or other modern ATS platforms.

You may not like it here

•
Remote-first, with two regions to cover, means some calls may land early in the morning or late at night.

•
Autonomy is real. Whilst we have playbooks, you'll also need to build them. You’ll be expected to define the bar, not just follow one.

•
Headcount plans change, roles get reshuffled, and a requisition you spent weeks calibrating can be paused. You’ll need to understand and adapt without losing momentum.

✅ A typical interview process

•
An initial intro call with a Talent Partner

•
An interview with the Hiring Manager

•
Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role

•
A final, values-alignment interview

What's the culture like at Primer?

We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants.

We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities.

The work is challenging. Scaleups are a challenge, and building category-defining products is a challenge. But there's a meaningful difference between a challenge and a struggle. At Primer, the right challenge comes with the right support: strong onboarding, a collaborative environment, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. It's never something you face alone.

Our benefits

🌍 We are fully remote and globally distributed; and have been since day one
💰 Competitive share options
🌴 Flexible holiday, with 25 days minimum to be taken
🗣️ Co-working space access across major cities
📅 Workations & Company Retreat
💻 The best equipment for your role
🏠 £500 towards your home office setup
🔎 Generous learning budget
🏥 Private Medical Insurance
📈 A broad set of additional perks and benefits (depending on location)

Don’t meet every single requirement?

At Primer, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or other roles.

FurtherAI is hiring a Senior GTM Sourcer to own top-of-funnel for our go-to-market hiring in New York. You will build the pipeline that our recruiters and GTM leaders close from, and set the standard for how we find and engage sales talent.

About FurtherAI

FurtherAI builds AI agents for insurance, automating document-heavy, regulated workflows. Join a YC and a16z-backed startup, collaborating with industry experts who share your hunger and ambition. Bring pioneering AI solutions to market in complex, regulated industries and help modernize a trillion-dollar sector.

What you'll do

•
Own sourcing strategy for GTM roles, such as account executives, customer success, revenue operations and marketing.

•
Build market maps and target-company lists, and find new talent pools before a role opens.

•
Write personalized outreach that gets replies from passive candidates, and test and improve it with data.

•
Screen sourced and inbound candidates, run first-round conversations and hand qualified candidates to the recruiter.

•
Partner with our Senior GTM Recruiter and hiring managers on intake, profile calibration and compensation intelligence.

•
Keep Ashby records accurate and report sourcing metrics, such as response rate, pipeline created and conversion to interview.

d.description:
About OpenLoop

OpenLoop was co-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. Our telehealth support solutions are thoughtfully designed to streamline and simplify go-to-market care delivery for companies offering meaningful virtual support to patients across an expansive array of specialties, in all 50 states.

About the Role

OpenLoop’s mission is to bring care anywhere by powering telehealth solutions at scale.

The Sr. Staff Demand Generation Specialist owns the strategic direction and performance of paid demand generation as OpenLoop expands its self-service offerings and reaches more small and midsize businesses. As a senior individual contributor, you will turn complex growth challenges into scalable acquisition programs and guide investment decisions that improve customer acquisition and revenue growth across business units.

What You’ll Do

•
Own OpenLoop’s paid demand-generation strategy across product-led growth, SMB, and brick-and-mortar business priorities, establishing long-term direction and measurable goals for pipeline, customer acquisition, and revenue.

•
Direct channel strategy and investment across Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn and additional platforms. Independently prioritize audiences, campaigns, and spending within approved budgets while remaining hands-on in campaign execution and optimization.

•
Establish measurement requirements and performance standards with Revenue Intelligence, connecting advertising investment to customer and revenue outcomes. Resolve attribution gaps and use the findings to guide investment decisions.

•
Lead the experimentation agenda with Creative and Product-Led Growth, aligning audience, messaging, creative, and conversion testing to improve acquisition efficiency and identify scalable growth opportunities.

•
Advise the Director of Product-Led Growth, VP of Marketing, and business stakeholders on growth opportunities, channel investment, and competing priorities. Align paid programs supporting priority accounts with the broader demand-generation strategy.

•
Build reusable playbooks, testing practices, and AI-enabled workflows that improve execution quality, speed, and decision-making across teams. Share expertise and drive adoption so improvements extend beyond individual campaigns.

•
Other duties as assigned.

Who You Are

•
A strategic problem solver who connects campaign performance, customer economics, and business priorities to address complex growth challenges.

•
A thoughtful decision-maker who weighs competing opportunities, acts on imperfect information, and balances immediate results with long-term capability.

•
An influential partner who explains complex findings clearly, aligns stakeholders around decisions, and builds trust through sound recommendations and follow-through.

•
An independent owner who identifies systemic gaps, defines an approach without a prescribed playbook, and stays accountable for outcomes while helping others strengthen their judgment.

Required Qualifications

•
5+ years of relevant performance marketing or demand-generation experience, with demonstrated ownership of acquisition strategy and measurable business results.

•
Deep hands-on expertise in Meta and Google Ads, including campaign setup, optimization, testing, and budget management.

•
Experience driving customer acquisition in a high-volume SMB, B2B, or product-led growth environment.

•
Experience connecting paid-media performance to pipeline, customer acquisition, and revenue, and using those insights to inform investment decisions.

•
Demonstrated success leading complex initiatives across functions and influencing strategic decisions through functional expertise.

•
Practical experience building AI into marketing workflows, with examples of improvements to speed, quality, efficiency, or performance.

Preferred Qualifications

•
Experience managing and scaling LinkedIn, TikTok Ads and YouTube Ads.

•
Experience with Microsoft Ads, emerging paid-media channels, or paid advertising supporting account-based marketing.

•
Experience in healthcare, health tech, telehealth, or digital health.

•
E-commerce acquisition experience that complements an understanding of B2B growth and customer economics.

What We Offer

•
Competitive compensation

•
Medical, Dental & Vision

•
Flexible Spending / Health Savings Accounts

•
Generous PTO

•
401(k) with Company Match

•
Life Insurance, Pet Insurance, and more

Our Company

We have a relatively flat organizational structure here at OpenLoop. Everyone is encouraged to bring ideas to the table and make things happen. This fits in well with our core values of Autonomy, Competence and Belonging, as we want everyone to feel empowered and supported to do their best work.

Sound like a good fit? We’d love to meet you.

d.description:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As a Product Brand Designer on Harvey Creative Studio, you’ll shape how people experience Harvey’s brand, both inside the product and wherever we introduce it to the world. You’re an art director and idea generator who sees the product as a creative canvas: agent identities, empty states, welcome moments, launches, and the small details that make Harvey feel unmistakably Harvey.

You’ll develop concepts that challenge what legal software is expected to look and feel like, then carry them from early ideas through storyboards, visual systems, and finished work. You’ll partner closely with product designers to understand how features work, while bringing a distinct brand point of view to how they’re expressed. You’ll also turn product launches into compelling stories across campaigns, landing pages, and motion.

We’re looking for a brand designer with exceptional taste, bold and disruptive ideas, and the craft to make them real. You understand digital products well enough to design within them, and you know when to push beyond convention to create something memorable, credible, and distinctly Harvey.

What You'll Do

•
Creative Vision: Bring bold, disruptive ideas to how Harvey shows up in product

•
Art Direction: Art direct distinctive in-product moments, from agent identities and empty states to welcome experiences and announcements

•
Storyboarding & Styleframes: Turn product strategy and feature detail into storyboards and styleframes that carry the launch story

•
Abstracted UI: Design abstracted UI that shows how Harvey works without recreating every screen

•
Launch & Marketing Assets: Build marketing assets for launches, landing pages, and events from in-progress product designs

•
Video & Demo Production: Own the storyboard stage of product videos and demos, and keep visuals accurate when features and narratives shift late

•
Cross-Functional Alignment: Bring Product Design, Creative Studio, and Brand partner teams into alignment—communicating proactively, navigating differing perspectives, and making thoughtful calls where product and brand overlap

What You Have

•
7+ years across product and brand design, with a portfolio that shows shipped product work next to storyboards, styleframes, or launch assets

•
Exceptional brand craft in composition, typography, color, and visual storytelling, with the ability to distill a complex feature into one clear idea

•
AI prototyping experience to explore and produce creative work, including interactive prototypes built with AI-assisted tools

•
A strong creative point of view and a track record of ideas that challenge convention

•
Understanding of product design skills: interaction design, flows and states, prototyping, and close work with PMs and engineers

•
Hands-on design system experience in Figma, including components, auto layout, and variables

•
Comfort working across teams with different goals, and the judgment to know when to push on craft and when to ship

•
Clear communication and storytelling skills, and comfort presenting work and taking feedback

Compensation

$180,800 - $248,600 USD

d.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure the responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence. In support of that mission, the SMB Marketing team helps small and medium-sized businesses understand and adopt ChatGPT Business and OpenAI’s B2B solutions. We build a deep understanding of business owners and teams, shape relevant product narratives, and drive awareness, adoption, and growth.

We take a data-driven approach to understand SMB audiences, uncover customer needs, and translate AI capabilities into practical business value. We partner closely with Growth, Product Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, Product, Research, Communications, and Design to deliver a cohesive customer experience across discovery, evaluation, purchase, adoption, and expansion.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager, SMB to bring together SMB insights, market understanding, and product knowledge to shape positioning, inform product priorities, and deliver go-to-market initiatives that drive adoption and measurable business impact.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Growth, and Partnerships to understand SMB needs, translate complex AI capabilities into clear customer value, and bring new products and features to market. This role is ideal for someone who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, independently navigates ambiguity, and brings cross-functional partners together to deliver results.

In this role, you will:

•
Define the product and marketing strategy for a component of OpenAI’s SMB portfolio in partnership with cross-functional partners

•
Develop an actionable understanding of SMB segments, customer needs, buying behavior, and workflows through research, product usage, market analysis, and competitive insight to improve positioning, adoption, and product-market fit.

•
Own positioning and messaging for your product area, translating complex capabilities into compelling narratives for different SMB owners and teams across relevant industries and business functions.

•
Partner with Product and Engineering to bring customer needs and market insights into roadmap discussions and product decisions.

•
Develop and drive go-to-market plans for new products and partner integrations, owning marketing execution from planning through launch and ongoing adoption.

•
Create SMB-facing content, including product narratives, workflow demos and webinar content, one-pagers, FAQs, and launch communications.

•
Partner with Product Growth, Partnerships, and Data Science to define success metrics, assess launch and adoption performance, and turn findings into improvements.

•
Surface launch risks related to performance, safety, policy, and trust, working with the relevant teams to address them in launch plans and customer communications.

•
Align cross-functional partners around priorities, responsibilities, and timelines, making thoughtful tradeoffs and resolving blockers within your initiatives.

•
Build repeatable approaches to launches, messaging, and enablement, sharing learnings and mentoring peers to improve the team’s storytelling and execution.

You might thrive in this role if you are/have:

•
Have experience independently developing product and marketing strategies and bringing products to market, particularly in SMB software, platforms, or data and AI.

•
Have experience in structured problem solving environments including but not limited to strategy/management consulting, investment banking, corporate strategy and venture capital

•
Understand SMB needs and the partner ecosystem, includingand the market landscape, including advertiser goals and the advertising ecosystem, including measurement, targeting and relevance, creative, auctions, and performance tradeoffs.

•
Have strong understanding of SMB workflows and software adoption, with the ability to adapt product value to different industries, use cases, and customer needs. Experience with platforms, integrations, plug-ins, technology partnerships, or SMB ecosystem GTM.

•
Can turn customer research and market insights into clear positioning, actionable go-to-market plans, and recommendations that inform product priorities.

•
Communicate clearly and persuasively, translating technical concepts into differentiated positioning for a range of audiences.

•
Use qualitative and quantitative evidence—including customer interviews, surveys, adoption data, and experiments—to make decisions and improve results.

•
Bring structured problem solving and strong judgment to ambiguous challenges, independently setting priorities and managing initiatives from strategy through execution.

•
Build effective partnerships across Product, Engineering, Growth, Partnerships, and other teams, influencing decisions and driving alignment without formal authority

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. ABOUT THE TEAM

Business Marketing helps knowledge workers, developers, and business decision-makers understand and adopt OpenAI’s products, supporting both self-serve growth and our managed sales team. Our creative work makes complex capabilities clear, grounded, and human as they move from the lab into businesses and everyday work.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a hands-on Launch Producer to build and run a repeatable, scalable creative production engine for Business Marketing launches, spanning new models, products, and capabilities, as well as solutions and use cases.

You’ll help shape the right creative and video approach for each launch, then lead production from brief through delivery. Most launches center on owned and social channels, and leverage video as a primary medium to explain new products and capabilities. Our largest launches also shape broader brand marketing, requiring coordination with Integrated Marketing and Media.

This role combines building the system with running the work. You should be equally comfortable improving a workflow, leading a shoot, and partnering with a motion designer.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

•
Lead launch intake and planning, aligning creative scope, resources, and timelines with launch priorities.

•
Partner with Product Marketing, Integrated Marketing, creative leads, and subject-matter experts to translate launch goals, audiences, messaging, and technical capabilities into compelling briefs, scripts, demos, and customer stories.

•
Produce videos at varying levels of fidelity, including demos, motion graphics, sizzle videos, explainers, and talking-head or testimonial videos featuring OpenAI talent and customers.

•
Lead production end to end: budgets, schedules, resourcing, shoots, post-production, and delivery. Consolidate feedback and approvals, manage dependencies, and surface risks and decisions early so assets are ready to ship.

•
Partner with Creative Operations to assemble and manage the right production team for each launch, drawing on your trusted bench of freelancers, agencies, and production partners alongside internal talent. Set clear scopes, expectations, and quality standards.

•
Plan assets for owned and social distribution, including formats, cutdowns, and channel-specific adaptations. Coordinate usage rights, accessibility, quality control, and final delivery requirements with the relevant partners.

•
Partner with Demand teams to translate launch strategy into demand-generation creative, informing briefs, asset needs, and cutdowns while those teams own demand execution.

•
Coordinate with Integrated Marketing and Media on major launches with broader brand and paid-media implications.

•
Build reusable workflows, templates, and production approaches. Use AI-enabled tools, post-launch learnings, and asset performance to improve speed, quality, and effectiveness without adding unnecessary process.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE

•
Experience: 12+ years in integrated creative production, digital production, program management, or a related field, with a proven track record of managing complex creative initiatives.

•
A true operator’s mindset: you can build a reliable production system and keep multiple launches moving through it.

•
Strong storytelling and creative judgment, with hands-on experience leading video shoots and working with motion designers, editors, and other production specialists.

•
An established network of creative and production talent, and sound judgment about the right team, scope, and approach for each brief, budget, and timeline.

•
Fluency in post-production and delivering assets across social, owned, and demand channels.

•
Clear, proactive communication and a collaborative working style. You build trust across disciplines, make tradeoffs visible, and keep teams aligned through shifting priorities.

•
A scrappy, resourceful approach and comfort with ambiguity and tight timelines. You know when a simple demo is enough and when a launch needs a more ambitious treatment.

•
A portfolio demonstrating end-to-end production leadership across fast-turn and larger-scale work, with your specific contribution and outcomes clearly identified.

About the Team

Ads Marketing Science helps advertisers prove and improve their media performance. We build credible evidence of business impact, turn that evidence into better advertiser decisions, and develop the first- and third-party measurement solutions, insights, and programs that help Sales and clients succeed at scale.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Marketing Science Lead to build and lead our approach to advertiser measurement across Asia Pacific. Reporting to Marketing Science leadership, you’ll own the regional strategy and priorities, serve as a senior advisor to advertisers and agencies, and represent APAC’s needs in our global measurement roadmap.

This is a hands-on leadership role with broad ownership. You’ll decide where Marketing Science can have the greatest impact, establish how we support different markets and clients, and carry work from problem definition through implementation, adoption, and demonstrated value. You’ll work closely with regional Sales leadership and global Product, Engineering, Data Science, Partnerships, Legal, and Privacy teams.

Success means more credible evidence of advertiser impact, better media decisions, and regional capabilities that scale beyond individual engagements. You’ll combine strategic judgment and executive influence with the ability to get into the data and build.

In this role, you will:

•
Own the APAC Marketing Science strategy. Set the regional learning agenda, prioritize markets and advertiser needs, and make clear tradeoffs between strategic client work, measurement development, and scaled support.

•
Lead senior advertiser and agency relationships. Work with marketing, analytics, and business leaders to define what success looks like, resolve complex measurement questions, and translate evidence into investment and optimization decisions.

•
Build first- and third-party measurement capabilities. Partner with global teams and regional providers across verification, attribution, incrementality, brand lift, sales lift, visitation, and marketing mix modeling (MMM), adapting approaches to local data availability and market needs.

•
Set the standard for measurement quality. Guide study design, power analysis, diagnostics, and interpretation. Distinguish attributed outcomes from causal impact, communicate uncertainty clearly, and turn findings into practical improvements and follow-up tests.

•
Shape the partner and product roadmap. Identify APAC capability gaps, prioritize partner opportunities with Partnerships, and turn recurring advertiser needs into clear requirements for Product, Engineering, and Data Science.

•
Scale Marketing Science support. Build reusable programs, playbooks, insights, tools, agents, and automated workflows that help Sales and clients answer common questions with consistent quality and appropriate privacy protections.

•
Build regional measurement credibility. Equip Sales with clear guidance and evidence, develop useful case studies and best practices, and represent OpenAI in senior partner and industry conversations.

•
Develop regional capability. Establish ways of working across markets and time zones, mentor colleagues, and help shape future hiring and coverage priorities as the business grows.

You might thrive in this role if you:

•
Bring 10+ years of relevant experience in advertising measurement, marketing science, or a related field, with a demonstrated record of leading strategy and delivering results across multiple APAC markets.

•
Have independently built and led a regional measurement program or substantial cross-functional initiative, including setting priorities, making resource tradeoffs, and taking accountability for adoption and advertiser value.

•
Are a trusted advisor to senior advertisers and agencies, with experience turning complex or inconclusive evidence into clear recommendations and influencing consequential business decisions.

•
Bring deep expertise in one or two measurement disciplines and strong working fluency across the broader landscape. You can evaluate methodological tradeoffs, identify limitations, and engage specialists effectively.

•
Stay close to the technical work. You can work directly with large datasets using SQL and Python or R, validate analytical outputs, and use AI tools to accelerate work while maintaining rigor.

•
Understand APAC’s diverse advertiser, agency, and measurement ecosystems, and have worked across markets with different data availability, languages, and privacy requirements.

•
Have influenced Product, Engineering, Data Science, or external measurement partners to turn client needs into durable capabilities, and can lead through ambiguity without relying on formal authority.
