d.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

To help support that mission, in August we announced that Stripe had agreed to acquire OpenRouter, a leading AI model gateway and routing platform. While that acquisition is under regulatory review and has not yet closed, our intent is that this role will support the OpenRouter team following the closing of the acquisition.

About the team

OpenRouter helps developers and businesses access and use a broad range of AI models through a unified platform. This role sits at the intersection of OpenRouter and Stripe, supporting hiring across Tech, GTM, and Core teams. You’ll serve as a bridge between the 2 organizations, bringing Stripe’s recruiting standards, talent networks, and resources to OpenRouter while protecting its speed and minimizing operational overhead.

You’ll align to Tech, GTM, or Core, but you won’t be dedicated to a single job profile within that function. For example, a GTM Recruiter may support Sales, Solutions Architecture, Marketing, or other GTM roles as priorities shift. The same model applies across Tech and Core.

What you’ll do

Own full-cycle recruiting for your aligned function, moving across job profiles based on business priority, from intake and market mapping through offer acceptance and onboarding handoff. You’ll combine direct execution with consultative partnership, working closely with hiring managers to clarify needs, advise on talent markets, build and engage qualified pipelines, and move candidates through structured, timely processes.

You’ll operate with startup speed while leveraging Stripe’s infrastructure and reach. You’ll use metrics to identify risk and guide action, while keeping recruiting outcomes, not reporting or process for its own sake, at the center of the work.

Responsibilities

• Own full-cycle recruiting across the full range of roles within your aligned function, Tech, GTM, or Core, moving between job profiles as business priorities shift
• Build qualified and inclusive pipelines through hands-on sourcing across communities, referrals, events, market mapping, relationship-based outreach, and other creative channels beyond inbound applications and standard LinkedIn outreach
• Partner consultatively with hiring managers to translate business priorities into clear role requirements, search strategies, structured assessments, and timely decisions
• Use funnel metrics, market evidence, and candidate feedback to identify risks, recommend actions, and communicate progress without allowing reporting or process to substitute for recruiting
• Deliver a thoughtful candidate experience and maintain relationships with prospective candidates for immediate and future needs
• Serve as an operational bridge between OpenRouter and Stripe by absorbing coordination where possible, maintaining continuity, and reducing the time OpenRouter leaders spend navigating recruiting processes
• Flex across job profiles within your aligned function when priorities shift or additional coverage is needed

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including direct ownership of sourcing, assessment, stakeholder partnership, and closing
• Experience recruiting in a high-growth technology startup, preferably during a stage below 200 employees
• Demonstrated recruiting depth in at least 1 of the following areas: Tech, GTM, or Core, with experience recruiting across multiple job profiles or clear evidence you can move between profiles as business priorities shift.
• Demonstrated interest in and ability to personally conduct hands-on sourcing and build qualified pipelines through creative channels beyond inbound applications and standard LinkedIn outreach
• Experience partnering consultatively with hiring managers, managing multiple searches, and using recruiting metrics and market evidence to identify risk and guide action
• Ability to work through ambiguity, adapt quickly as priorities change, and balance direct execution with longer-term pipeline building

Preferred qualifications

• Experience recruiting across both startup and larger-company environments and helping teams work effectively across different operating models
• Experience supporting structured, competency-based hiring processes
• Experience recruiting across multiple geographies or advising on location strategy
• Practical experience using recruiting technology, talent intelligence, or AI tools to improve sourcing and candidate experience

d.description:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving 200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

•
The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

•
The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

•
Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

•
Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

•
Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

•
Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

•
Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Web Designer, Growth at AIOS

We are building a world-class team.

As Web Designer, Growth at AIOS, your fundamental role is to turn cold clicks into customers, designing the pages that take a stranger from an ad to a purchase.

Visual polish matters, and for this role it comes second. Mastery here is conversion craft: knowing what goes on the first screen and in what order, turning a product into an offer, putting proof exactly where the doubt shows up, and removing risk at every step. You write and test your own headlines. You carry the ad’s promise and look all the way through to checkout.

You’ll own pre-conversion across our brands: landing pages, advertorials and listicles, quiz-to-plan flows and checkout, for our GLP-1 business and for the new non-Rx products we’re launching. You’ll ship your own pages to production with AI tools, without waiting on a developer, and you’ll live with each funnel through round after round of tests until you know exactly what moves the number.

You’ll:

•
Turn every growth bet into a live, high-converting page in days, not weeks

•
Close the gap between our funnels and best-in-class DTC, starting with the friction after our UK quiz

•
Launch new products with pages built to sell to cold traffic from day one

•
Keep us ahead of what’s new in DTC, and have our version live the same week

Great performance in this role means our pages win on persuasion, not just polish, and every new product and market launches with a funnel designed to convert.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday. This is an intense, hands-on IC role within the Growth team.

You’ll report directly to our Head of Growth (David Charles).

You’ll also work most closely with:

•
CRO Lead (Michael McCann)

•
Head of Design (Ryan Wu)

•
Growth (Jake)

•
CEO (Richie)

You’ll own pre-conversion end to end, from the ad click to the purchase.

•
First screen and page order: Decide what goes on the first screen and in what order, so a cold visitor knows what this is, why it’s for them and what to do next within seconds.

•
Offer design: Turn a product into an offer: the plan, the price anchor, the value stack, bonuses and the guarantee. Plan cards, best-value picks, struck prices and gifts inside the selected plan are your tools, not afterthoughts.

•
Proof and risk reversal: Put proof where the doubt shows up, not in a reviews block at the bottom, and remove risk at each step: what happens next, who the doctor is, cancel anytime, when it arrives.

•
Headlines and copy: Write and test your own headlines rather than laying out copy someone else handed over, and explain why one beats another.

•
Carrying the scent: Carry the ad’s promise and look through to the page, working with the growth team so the creative and the landing page feel like one journey.

•
Presells and quiz funnels: Design and iterate advertorials, numbered listicles, story pages and our quiz-to-plan flow, including the results moment and a plan page that feels built for one person.

•
Engaging pages: Use native-looking media, UGC, motion and before-and-afters where compliance allows, so the page holds attention the way the ad did.

•
Ship and iterate: Ship your own pages to production with AI tools, then live with the funnel through many rounds of tests, cut what loses and double down on what wins. Recent examples in motion: the UK post-quiz back end, the DE listicle, and Wave 1 non-Rx launches (skin, hair, ED, non-clinical).

•
Stay ahead of DTC: Track new formats across ecommerce as they appear (like RYZE’s Instagram-story listicles) and bring the best of them to our funnels fast.

Need to have

•
Live pages with real spend: Your best work is URLs that ran behind paid traffic. You can share live pages, the brand, rough monthly spend and the result.

•
Direct response ecom at scale: You’ve designed pages that sold a product to cold traffic with real spend behind them. Lead gen, info products, brand sites and app UI don’t count on their own.

Test history on one funnel: You’ve spent real time on one funnel at scale, on staff or in a long engagement, and can walk through a series of tests: what won, what lost, by how much and what you’d try next.

d.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies — from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups — use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Stripe Marketing organization is undergoing a fundamental transformation in how it works. We're building a team of Forward Deployed AI Accelerators (FDAs) embedded directly with marketing cohorts to make AI the default mode for all work — not an occasional tool, but the foundation of how every marketer at Stripe executes.

Today, marketers are already achieving remarkable results — building their own data dashboards, creating agents that compress multi-day processes, and authoring tools that accelerate workflows. The FDA team exists to take what's working and systematically scale it across the entire marketing organization.

What you'll do

As a Forward Deployed AI Accelerator, you'll be embedded with a cohort of 25–45 marketers organized by functional team, shared workflow, or location. You'll build alongside them, and you'll help them fundamentally change how they operate. Your measure of success is the number of workflows you've permanently transformed and the extent to which those in your cohort start any task with an AI tool.

Responsibilities

• Identify and document the highest-leverage workflow transformations within your cohort's day-to-day work by deeply understanding their processes and outputs
• Build custom tools, agents, automations, and skills tailored to each marketer's specific responsibilities
• Coach and partner with each marketer through a progressive journey — from awareness, to first win, to regular AI integration, to full workflow transformation, to self-sufficiency
• Teach marketers to build and iterate on their own tools over time, creating independence
• Recognize patterns across your cohort and systematically scale what works — a tool built for one marketer will be reusable for their peers
• Document every tool, playbook, and transformation pattern you build so the entire FDA team uses each other's work
• Share wins visibly within your cohort and with leadership to build momentum, inspire, and celebrate success
• Track individual and cohort progress rigorously against a defined maturity model, moving every marketer toward self-sustaining, AI-first work
• Prepare marketers for an agentic future — not just prompt writing, but designing, building, and overseeing autonomous, multi-agent workflows

Who you are

We're looking for people who have already lived the transformation they'll be driving for others. You've used AI to fundamentally change how work gets done, not as a novelty, but as your default operating mode.

• You are a deep AI practitioner. You build agents, automations, and tools fluently. You don't just know what AI can do in theory. You've built things that changed how real teams operate, and the people you built for actually use what you shipped. You build in real time alongside the people you support.
• You spot transformation opportunities and execute on them. You look at a team's workflows and see where AI changes the economics: where existing work can be done in a fraction of the time, or where entirely new programs become viable that weren't worth doing before. Then you build the thing, not just the slide.
• You understand marketing work. You either have direct experience in marketing or quickly learn the workflows, deliverables, tools, and pressures of your assigned cohort. You know that understanding someone's work is a prerequisite to transforming it.
• You are a pattern recognizer. When you build something that works for one person, you immediately see how it applies to others. You think in systems, not one-off solutions.
• You are a strong communicator. You explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences, adapt your style to different people, and make progress visible to leadership and stakeholders.
• You are high-caliber, persistent, and versatile. Your skills and experience are valuable across the company. You're the kind of person who succeeds in many roles at Stripe.
• You bias toward action and speed. You'd rather show someone a working proof-of-concept on their own deliverable today than present a polished deck about what's theoretically possible next quarter.
• You are comfortable with ambiguity and evolution. This is a new team building a new operating model. The playbook will be rewritten as we learn. You thrive in that environment.

Minimum requirements

• 5+ years of professional experience in a role requiring diagnostic thinking, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration
• Demonstrated, hands-on experience building and deploying AI-powered agents, tools, automations, or workflows that real people use in their actual work, whether that made existing processes meaningfully more efficient or made previously unviable work possible for the first time
• Proficiency with AI development tools and platforms (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, custom agent frameworks, API integrations, workflow automation tools)
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences and adapt your style to different learners
• Comfort working across multiple workstreams and relationships simultaneously (you'll be supporting 25–45 marketers at varying stages of their AI journey)
• Track record of coaching, teaching, or enabling others, with evidence that people you've helped actually changed how they work

Preferred qualifications

• Experience in a formal AI transformation role where the job was substantially about identifying opportuni

d.description:
Wix makes it possible for anyone to succeed online. Since 2006, we've grown to around 4,400 employees in 22 countries, launched over 40 products, and serve over 299 million users and their visitors worldwide. At Wix, we push you to innovate and evolve in non-traditional ways. We operate in collaborative, high-performing teams, building cutting-edge products and leveraging AI to redefine how our users create, manage and grow their dreams online.

Although we're already industry leaders in web creation and business, our work is nowhere near done. Our goal is to become the main engine of the Internet so we can create a more open web for all.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Wix was built around the idea that everyone has the right to be successful, online. This same vision defines us as an employer: creating a work environment where everyone is welcome, and anyone has the right to succeed.

Job Description

We are looking for a sharp, trend-obsessed Social Media Manager to manage the social presence of some of Wix's biggest brands, including Wix.com, Wix Studio and Symphony. You will own the strategy and the craft: planning what we say and where, then creating the short-form videos that bring it to life, for both organic and paid, from A to Z.

This is a hands-on role for someone early in their career who lives on social, spots trends before they peak, and can take an idea from a first hook to a published video on their own.

On your day to day you will:

• Establish social media strategies for various Wix products across short form video platforms - TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube Shorts.
• Build and manage content calendars, balancing always-on organic content with campaign, launch and product moments
• Create short-form video content from A to Z: concepting, scripting, shooting, editing, captioning and publishing, for both organic and paid use
• Develop platform-native content that fits the nuances of each channel and each brand's voice and audience
• Partner with the paid media team to produce, test and iterate on social ad creative, including hooks, formats and variations
• Monitor trends, memes, sounds and formats, and turn them into timely content that feels native and fresh
• Track performance across channels, report on results and use insights to optimize content, formats and posting strategy
• Use AI and automation tools to speed up ideation, production and editing, and experiment with new workflows

At Wix, we believe our best work happens together. Our work model is fully in person, with 3 days a week from our New York office.

Qualifications

• 1-2 years of experience in social media, content creation or a similar role (agency, in-house at a tech/AI brand or personal brand experience all count)
• Proven ability to create short-form video end to end, with a portfolio or sample videos that show your work
• Hands-on editing skills with tools such as CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects or similar
• Hands-on experience with Ai video creation tools, like Higgsfield, Weavy or similar
• A fresh perspective on social and an intuitive grasp of trends, formats, creators and culture across TikTok, Instagram and beyond
• Natural instinct for strong hooks, storytelling and what makes people stop scrolling
• Understanding of content strategy and planning, including calendars, platform best practices and audience insights
• Familiarity with paid social creative and what makes an ad perform, or strong curiosity to learn fast
• Strong writing skills and a clear, clever tone of voice
• Analytical mindset: comfortable reading metrics and adapting based on performance
• Self-starter who ships consistently, takes initiative and thrives in a fast-moving environment
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills; fluent English (written and spoken)

Additional Information

Expected base compensation salary range $110,000 - $130,000. In addition to base pay you will receive company RSUs as part of the compensation package.Final package may vary and will be determined by various factors including location the role is expected to be performed, shift, candidate profile and ideal qualifications.

Position Summary

Sigma360 is seeking an experienced Solutions Engineer to join our Client and Partner Solutions organization. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of BSA/AML regulatory compliance rules and regulations, the ability to pull insights from large data sets, as well as a working understanding of system to system integrations, and API based approaches to systems integrations.

In this role our Solution Engineer will leverage technical and industry expertise, to confidently understand the needs of both business and technical counterparts and explain how Sigma360 can solve their problems. You will also be responsible for tailored product demonstrations, RFP responses, contributing to proposals, technical diagramming and ensuring a clear understanding of mutual expectations across prospect stakeholders and our implementation team.

Responsibilities

• Technical & Business Discovery: Lead discovery sessions with prospects to uncover pain points, technical constraints, and key success metrics.

• Product Demos & Presentations: Deliver tailored, high-impact product demonstrations that map software capabilities directly to a buyer’s pain points. Championing value based selling and building trust with prospects.

• Proof of Value: Spearhead high-impact Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Proof of Value (PoV) initiatives, which prove Sigma360’s ability to solve complex business requirements with a focus on tuning so customers can extract maximum value from the underlying data.

• Technical Validation & De-risking: Answer complex security, API, and architectural questions during the sales cycle to remove buying friction.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the voice of the customer back to Product Management and Engineering to influence roadmaps and partner closely with Account Executives (AEs) and Customer Success

Qualifications

• 4–6 years of experience in client facing roles where consultative and solutioning skills are paramount.

• 1–5 years of experience in regulatory compliance, BSA/AML compliance, sanctions screening, matching/tuning and reporting.

• 1–5 years of experience in working with API based integrations, and skills to guide developers and lead technical workstreams.

Skills

• Strong presentation & interpersonal skills.

• Knowledge of varied technology platforms that support various screening and monitoring workflows within compliance and risk workflows.

• Python, Pandas, SQL data analysis (using notebooks) and familiarity of core ML/AI frameworks.

• Ability to leverage AI tools and technologies effectively to drive operational efficiency and deliver high-quality outcomes.

• Knowledge of MS office and CRM software, preferably Hubspot.

• Talented and professional communicator, both verbally and written.

• Self-motivated, dedicated, and driven to succeed.

About the Team

OpenAI, in close collaboration with our capital partners, is embarking on a journey to build the world’s most advanced AI infrastructure ecosystem. The Compute team is central to this mission, setting the core infra strategy and implementing this vision. From site selection to the buildout process, this team sits at the intersection of commercial, technical, strategy, and operations, interacting with teams and executives inside and outside of OpenAI.

About the Role

The Community Engagement Lead will be the primary bridge between OpenAI and the communities in the Southeast United States. This role ensures that OpenAI builds strong, trust-based relationships with local stakeholders, communicates proactively about our projects, and integrates community priorities into our development approach. The role spans engagement, communications, and reputation management, and will partner closely with the Economic Development and Environmental leads.

Location: Southeast USA

Key Responsibilities

•
Build and maintain relationships with local leaders, community organizations, NGOs, and residents.

•
Develop and execute community engagement strategies for new and existing sites.

•
Represent OpenAI in public forums, hearings, and community events.

•
Partner with the Economic Development Lead on incentive compliance and community benefits.

•
Partner with the Environmental Lead on communicating environmental stewardship and sustainability efforts.

•
Develop proactive communications to address concerns, highlight benefits, and reduce risk of opposition.

•
Monitor community sentiment and advise executives on risks and opportunities.

•
Create a community engagement playbook that can scale across geographies.

Qualifications

•
8+ years in community affairs, public engagement, or corporate communications.

•
Proven track record engaging diverse community stakeholders for large infrastructure or technology projects.

•
Strong public speaking and facilitation skills.

•
Ability to manage sensitive political and reputational issues.

•
Experience integrating community benefits (workforce, education, infrastructure support) into development strategies.

•
Collaborative and adaptable, with experience working across government, community, and corporate teams.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.

OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy

At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

d.description:
About Outreach

Outreach is a leading agentic AI platform built for revenue teams. Outreach lets revenue leaders hire AI agents that act rather than advise, working as true teammates that expand capacity and embed the skills of top sellers across every go-to-market workflow, from prospecting and engaging accounts to managing deals, coaching reps, forecasting, and retaining and expanding existing accounts. By unifying sales engagement, conversation intelligence, and revenue intelligence in a single connected platform, Outreach gives revenue leaders full-funnel visibility, greater forecast confidence, and more pipeline without adding headcount. World-leading enterprise organizations, including Databricks, SAP, and Siemens, rely on Outreach to power their revenue teams. To learn more, visit www.outreach.ai.

About the Team

Managed Services sits within Professional Services. We're Outreach, CRM, and GTM technology experts who help customers get full value from the platform once implementation ends. We are trusted advisors that drive adoption, flag risk, and grow usage, so customers keep exceeding their goals.

The Role

You'll join our FDE, Managed Services team, chartered with building our customers' AI Agents beyond what was set up during implementation: opening new use cases and growing Amplify credit and product consumption.

You’ll own and expand our largest, most complex portfolio of accounts and guide customers through best practices and hands-on configuration to drive outcomes and deepen adoption. You will partner with the leaders and team to set the technical standard for the practice and be a go-to resource when other consultants hit edge cases. You'll stay technically fluent in Outreach's evolving capabilities, AI included, so you can configure and troubleshoot in real time.

The role mixes technology and business consulting with solution design and project management. You'll work closely with Customer Success and Account Executives, build rapport fast, and influence customer outcomes.

You'll own results for your book of business against Managed Services KPIs, and report to a Manager, FDE-Managed Services.

Key Performance Indicators: Manage a book of business with an average QoQ utilization rate of 70%, with a focus on Amplify credit and product consumption — ultimately supporting renewal rates and the minimization of churn and contraction.

Location: This is a remote role, based in [insert here]. There may be occasional in-person or team events and if asked to attend, it will be during local [insert here] hours.

Working Hours: This is a customer-facing role and will require working US-based business hours, with flexibility for key customer milestones.

\n

Your Daily Adventures Will Include

•

Build, configure, and tune new AI Agents (Revenue, Deal, Research, Conversation, Forecasting) beyond initial implementation to expand automation and drive credit consumption

•

Design and manage context-aware prompts for each customer's AI Agent use cases

•

Outreach is a leading agentic AI platform built for revenue teams. Outreach lets revenue leaders hire AI agents that act rather than advise, working as true teammates that expand capacity and embed the skills of top sellers across every go-to-market workflow, from prospecting and engaging accounts to managing deals, coaching reps, forecasting, and retaining and expanding existing accounts. By unifying sales engagement, conversation intelligence, and revenue intelligence in a single connected platform, Outreach gives revenue leaders full-funnel visibility, greater forecast confidence, and more pipeline without adding headcount. World-leading enterprise organizations, including Databricks, SAP, and Siemens, rely on Outreach to power their revenue teams. To learn more, visit www.outreach.ai.

About the Team

The Marketing Operations team is the engine behind how Outreach goes to market. We own the systems, data, and campaign infrastructure that turn marketing strategy into programs reaching the right buyers at the right moment. We work closely with Demand Generation, Field and Event Marketing, Product Marketing, Sales Operations, and Sales to design and optimize the processes and tools that help our go-to-market teams perform at their best. We're deeply curious about how AI and automation can sharpen our craft, and we're always looking for ways to build smarter, faster systems that give our teams a real edge.

As a Marketing Operations Specialist, you will support our marketing technology strategy by managing core systems, executing campaigns, and maintaining data quality. This role requires strong technical execution skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.

Marketing operations is where AI moves from concept to daily practice. About the Team

Business Marketing helps knowledge workers, developers, and business decision-makers understand and adopt OpenAI’s products, supporting both self-serve growth and our managed sales team. Our creative work makes complex capabilities clear, grounded, and human as they move from the lab into businesses and everyday work.

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced Art Director to develop and direct creative for OpenAI’s business audiences. You’ll turn product capabilities, customer insights, and marketing briefs into visual ideas that can carry a campaign across channels. That might mean developing the visual concept for a launch, storyboarding a film about how a customer uses AI in their work, or building a campaign system that holds together across a landing page, paid social, and a keynote.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll sketch concepts, build key visuals, and set the visual direction for designers, producers, and external partners. You’ll work closely with writers, Business Marketing, Product Marketing, and product teams to make sure the work is accurate, useful to the audience, and unmistakably OpenAI.

To us, creativity is a team sport. Ideas get better when you talk them through and build on each other’s thinking. We value curiosity over certainty, kindness over ego, and the ability to balance craft with decisiveness.

In this role, you will:

•
Lead visual concept development and art direction for B2B campaigns, product launches, customer stories, and industry events, from brief through final production.

•
Partner with writers and marketers to define the idea around a specific audience, what they need to understand, and what we want them to do next.

•
Work with product and technical partners to show how capabilities work in practice, using product imagery, demos, diagrams, and motion without overstating what the technology can do.

•
Develop campaign visual systems that adapt to different formats and audience needs, from a launch film or event keynote to a product page, paid campaign, or sales presentation.

•
Art direct photography, illustration, motion, and video. Make work yourself when the project calls for it, and give clear direction to internal teams and external partners when others are producing it.

•
Maintain a high visual bar across touch points and help evolve how the OpenAI brand shows up for business audiences.

You might thrive in this role if you:

•
Have 8+ years of art direction or related creative experience in-house, at an agency, or both, with a portfolio that shows your role in developing concepts and taking them through production.

•
Have experience creating work for business or technical audiences, with examples of making a complex product, service, or idea clear and compelling.

•
Bring strong visual design fundamentals in typography, composition, imagery, and systems, and can apply them across digital, social, film, and experiential work.

•
Can build a strong campaign idea and show how it adapts across formats without losing what makes it distinctive.

•
Can explain your creative decisions to marketing and product partners, work through feedback, and make sound tradeoffs when priorities or timelines change.

Nice to Have

•
Experience with AI, enterprise software, developer tools, or other emerging technologies.

•
Experience art directing customer stories, product demos, or keynote and event creative.

•
Motion design, video art direction, or on-set experience.

About the Team

The Growth team helps people and businesses discover, adopt, and get lasting value from ChatGPT and other OpenAI products. We partner with Brand Marketing, Product, Engineering, Data Science, Finance, and Creative to connect marketing investment with customer and business outcomes. Our brand data infrastructure brings together media, audience, creative, and research data so teams can plan, measure, and improve brand investment across markets.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Brand Data Infrastructure Lead to own the data foundations that make brand marketing measurable and scalable. You will define how brand media, campaign, creative, audience, and research data are organized, connected, validated, and made available for decisions. This hands-on role combines brand and media expertise with practical data fluency, turning fragmented platform and partner outputs into dependable datasets and repeatable workflows.

This role sits within Growth Marketing and works closely with Brand Marketing, Media Operations, Growth Platform’s solutions engineering team, Data Engineering, and Data Science. You own Brand’s data roadmap, business definitions, source requirements, data-quality acceptance, and adoption. Engineering partners own production architecture, connector and pipeline implementation, instrumentation, and technical incident resolution. Data Science owns statistical methodology and model development.

Your first priority is to establish consistent campaign and creative taxonomies, dependable media and measurement feeds, clear data-sharing arrangements, and trusted reporting inputs. Build a foundation that supports TV/CTV, online video, social, audio, out-of-home, and other brand channels, with the coverage and history needed for brand tracking, lift studies, incrementally, and marketing mix modeling.

In this role, you will:

•
Own the Brand data infrastructure roadmap. Translate brand strategy, media plans, and measurement needs into prioritized data capabilities, source integrations, quality improvements, and reporting foundations. Balance business value, global coverage, delivery dependencies, cost, and sustained adoption.

•
Define shared data models and taxonomies. Establish consistent campaign, creative, channel, partner, audience, and market definitions, identifiers, reporting grains, and time conventions. Align stakeholders on how datasets connect and how metrics should be interpreted across platforms and markets.

•
Set source and integration requirements. Define the fields, granularity, history, coverage, refresh cadence, and reconciliation needed from platforms, agencies, publishers, and measurement vendors. Partner with engineering on data contracts, integration priorities, acceptance criteria, and ownership throughout the data lifecycle.

•
Enable Brand channels and partner data. Lead data readiness for TV/CTV, video, social, audio, out-of-home, and emerging channels. Ensure new partners and campaigns provide usable delivery, spend, audience, creative, and geographic data, working with Media Operations and channel owners on setup and reporting requirements.

•
Make Brand measurement data ready to use. Coordinate the datasets and metadata required for brand tracking, brand lift, geo experiments, incrementality studies, and marketing mix modeling. Work with Data Science on study requirements and comparability, and connect media and research outputs with relevant product and business outcomes.

•
Own vendor data access and governance readiness. Lead the marketing side of partner evaluation, onboarding, and service reviews. Define required data, delivery terms, permitted uses, and responsibilities with Legal, Privacy, Security, and Procurement, then make those requirements usable for engineering, vendors, and marketing teams.

•
Establish data quality and dependable operations. Set expectations for completeness, freshness, consistency, and reconciliation. Use source reports and delivered datasets to identify missing feeds, taxonomy gaps, duplication, and reporting discrepancies; assess business impact, coordinate resolution, and validate recovery with the accountable technical or vendor owner.

•
Build usable data products and handoffs. Partner with data and analytics teams on curated Brand datasets, reporting inputs, documentation, and self-service access. Maintain definitions, lineage, training, and support procedures so Brand leaders, regional teams, and measurement specialists can use the data consistently with less manual reconciliation.

You might thrive in this role if you:

•
Bring 8+ years of experience in marketing data, brand or media measurement, marketing technology, analytics operations, or related roles, including hands-on ownership of data capabilities that improved marketing decisions.

Familiarity with SQL-based analysis is valuable; deep coding expertise is not required.

About LiveFlow

LiveFlow is on a mission to redefine how businesses manage their finances. We combine AI and automation with hands-on accounting experts to run month-end close, reconciliations and reporting for multi-location businesses, especially restaurant and hospitality groups.

We have raised over $21M from top-tier investors including YC, YC Continuity, Valar, Seedcamp, WndrCo, Moonfire, Bradley Horowitz (VP Product, Google) and more.

We help thousands of companies streamline their financial workflows, and we have hundreds of 5/5 ratings on G2.

Our founding team previously worked at one of the fastest-growing fintechs, Revolut.

The mission for the role

We want every restaurant owner in New York to know about LiveFlow, and it’s your goal to help us make that happen.

Here’s what you’ll do

• Lead, run and execute our door-to-door launch across New York.

• Hire and motivate a team of 10–20 brand ambassadors who will visit restaurants in person.

• Build an exceptional team culture among the brand ambassadors.

• Host owner dinners, chef roundtables and industry events.

• Work with sales to generate a high-quality pipeline and ensure high conversion.

• Team up with restaurant groups, suppliers, POS companies and creators to get us warm intros and get owners talking.

What we’re looking for in you

• You have experience leading field marketing teams.

• You can quickly hire brand ambassadors to work for you.

• You have a good network in New York City and can make things happen quickly.

• People are drawn to you and follow you, and you can motivate a team of ambassadors.

• It’s a big bonus if you’ve worked in restaurants or hospitality, or led field marketing for a restaurant or hospitality business.

Why join us

• You’re joining us at the inception stage, effectively from day 0, so you’ll have an immense impact on the business.

• You get the autonomy to run the show. We expect you to be self-guided and able to work very autonomously.

• We work hard to stretch you and expand your capabilities by giving you challenging goals and missions.

Location & compensation

• New York City.

• Fully in person, with a lot of flexibility on where you work during the day, as you’ll spend most of your days outside the office.

• $100,000–$130,000 per year.

About Alex AI

Our mission is to unlock human potential by accelerating hiring.

Alex AI is a platform of AI agents for recruiting. Our agents interview candidates, coordinate next steps, and keep recruiting systems up to date, working together so employers hire great people faster. Customers include First Student, Mattress Firm, and Upwork.

About the Role

We're hiring our first product marketer, a hands-on role, to refine and amplify the story of Alex. You'll be the connective tissue between our product and the market, owning how we communicate the value we provide, how our brand shows up, and how Alex brings that story to customers.

You'll work with our founders, product, and customers to sharpen our messaging and brand, then build out the sales training, demos, customer proof, and launch material that carry it. You'll join customer conversations, learn what buyers actually ask and where the story falls short, and make sure it works both in the room and out in the world.

Product marketing is the core of this job, and as our first marketer you'll shape everything around it too: how we show up at conferences, which channels we bet on, and what the marketing function becomes as we grow.

Alex is an early-stage company. We operate at an exceptionally fast pace, but with pragmatic intention and thought. Roles will blur and your scope will be wide. Many things remain to be figured out, and it's imperative that you are open to and excited by that.

This is a full-time IC role based in-person in our San Francisco office 5 days a week, with travel for conferences. You will report to the Head of Product.

What You'll Do

•

Own the story, end to end: sharpen Alex's customer story with our founders, grounded in concrete use cases, and refine the voice and creative direction. Then bring it to life twice: in the materials you create, and in the AI resources you put in everyone else's hands to compound your impact. For example, when a seller builds a pitch deck with Claude the night before a meeting, it should come out on message, on brand, and accurate, because you put the right story, proof, and design in place for both of them to draw from.

•

Make every seller fluent: own the core materials, talk tracks, demo guides, competitive positioning, objection handling, and customer proof. Train reps and check that they can use it all in real conversations.

•

Turn every ship into a story: build the AI systems that turn product releases, sales calls, and customer conversations into refined messaging, seller briefings, website copy, and launches, continuously, so the story never goes stale between releases.

•

Close the loop with customers: use customers response, seller adoption, and real deal feedback to improve the story. Bringing customer questions back into the product.

•

Run the room: lead our conferences, from planning and budget through onsite execution and follow-up with Sales.

•

Own what ships: you write the deck, the page, and the talk track yourself. Whatever drafted it, you decide what's true, what's good, and what goes out under our name.

What You'll Bring

•

You're an excellent writer with strong product judgment and creative taste. You can show two or three examples of a message and brand you shaped, explain why it was right for the domain, how sellers used it, and the results it delivered.

•

You learn products deeply, teach clearly, and stay hands-on from the first idea through the the measurement of results. You demonstrate this in how well you know the products you've worked on and why they were built the way they were.

•

You build systems that do your work when you’re not in the room. You can show one, whether an AI resource or a knowledge base your team relies on, and say how it could be improved.

•

You're wonderfully curious in a manner that fosters healthy debate, uncovers new information, and draws those around you closer.

•

You bring a balanced perspective that grounds "vibes" in quantitative and qualitative evidence you gather yourself.

Why Join?

•

Direct founder access

•

Meaningful ownership

•

Medical, dental, and vision insurance

•

FSA, DCFSA, HSA options

•

Flexible paid time off (PTO)

•

401(k) plan

•

Fully paid parental leave program

•

Commuter benefits

•

In office lunch

•

Dog-friendly office

What am I waiting for?

If you’ve gotten this far and building from zero-to-one excites you, we want you to apply. Your first conversation will be with Alex, our AI recruiter.

Alex is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

d.description:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Role

AI is changing what it means to run enterprise pre-sales. Building a custom demo, standing up a proof-of-concept environment, or drafting responses to a security questionnaire used to mean days of manual configuration and copy-paste from old RFP answers. Increasingly, that first-draft work can be directed rather than done by hand: AI can generate demo environments, draft PoC configurations, and produce a first pass on technical RFP responses.

The job shifts with it. Instead of building every demo and proof point from scratch, you specify exactly what a prospect needs to see, direct AI to build the first draft, and apply the judgment AI can't: does this PoC actually prove the thing this customer's IT security team will ask about, does this demo reflect how their approval hierarchy actually works, is this RFP answer technically accurate or just plausible-sounding.

As Omnea's AI Sales Engineer, you're the technical authority in our enterprise sales process, working alongside Sales to win some of the world's largest companies. You run discovery, build and direct demos and PoCs, and become the trusted technical advisor a prospect leans on to decide whether Omnea is real. You're deep in the modern finance and procurement stack - ERPs, CLMs, GRC, AP automation - and you use that expertise to judge what AI produces, not just to present it.

This is a founding Sales Engineering role in Seattle, New York, Washington DC, Vancouver or Toronto as we build the team there from scratch, working closely with Sales, Product, and the Customer team who take a deal from signed to live.

What You'll Do

•
Own technical discovery and demos: Run technical discovery sessions with prospects, direct AI to build a first-draft demo environment tailored to what you've learned, then adapt it based on what only a human would catch - a workflow quirk, a compliance requirement, a stakeholder's pet objection.

•
Drive PoCs end to end: Scope and own proof-of-concepts in collaboration with Product and the Customer team, directing AI to configure the environment fast and applying your own judgment on whether the PoC actually proves what the prospect needs to see to move forward.

•
Answer the hard technical and security questions: Direct AI to draft first-pass responses to RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires, then validate every answer against the prospect's actual requirements - a wrong answer here can lose the deal or create a problem after signature.

•
Be the bridge between Sales, Product, and Customer: Translate what you're hearing in the field into product feedback, and hand off cleanly to the Customer team so nothing gets lost between a signed contract and a live deployment.

•
Build the pre-sales toolkit: Keep demo environments, technical documentation, and RFP libraries sharp, using AI to draft and refresh materials as the product evolves, and refining what works based on what's actually landing with prospects.

About You

We don't expect you to know how to do all of this on day one. TL;DR: you're technical enough to be a genuine authority in the room, customer-facing enough to be trusted by a CFO or a CISO, and comfortable directing AI to do the heavy lifting so you can focus on the judgment calls only you can make.

•
3-7 years in sales engineering, solutions engineering, or technical consulting, ideally in B2B SaaS

•
Ideally you have experience in the modern finance or procurement stack - you understand procurement and AP automation, and have demoed, implemented, or administered tools like ERPs, CLMs, or GRC platforms

•
Comfortable directing AI tools to produce first-draft demos, configurations, and RFP responses, with the judgment to catch what's wrong before a prospect sees it

•
A strong technical foundation: you can learn a complex software platform fast and go deep enough to answer hard security and architecture questions

•
An excellent communicator who can simplify technical concepts for multiple stakeholders from CFO, CPO to CISO.

•
A proactive problem-solver with real troubleshooting instincts and a customer-first mindset

•
Comfortable owning RFPs, RFIs, and IT security questionnaires end to end, including the technical requirements that come with them

•
Based in Seattle, New York, Washington DC, Vancouver or Toronto

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a go

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Role

Solution Consulting sits at the center of how Omnea wins - deals are complex, cycles are competitive, and multiple stakeholders (finance, procurement, legal, risk) all need to be convinced simultaneously. You are the person who takes a messy, high-stakes, multi-threaded sales process and makes the future state obvious and credible, working strategically with the world's largest logos. You'll be sitting across the table from C-suite executives at companies going through massive transformation projects, at the center of decisions that reshape how they operate.

You'll help shape how we sell, what our demos look like, how we structure technical validation, and how the function scales as the team grows.

You'll own & define the technical and business case throughout the sales cycles - from discovery through demo(s), supporting RFPs, and defining the solution approach. That means translating a prospect's current-state, disconnected tools, broken workflows, poor adoption, into a compelling, specific vision of what Omnea makes possible, and building tailored demos across an expanding product surface spanning orchestration, risk, compliance, legal, sourcing, and AP. You'll partner directly with our GTM team to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder multi-country deal - and act as the voice of the market back into product and GTM: what's working, what's not, and what needs to change.

What You'll Do

•
Own the technical strategy on our largest, highest-stakes enterprise deals: lead deep discovery across Heads of Procurement, IT, Security, and Finance, and translate what you uncover into a technical narrative compelling enough to justify a strategic investment, not just a tool purchase.

•
Multi-thread every stakeholder in the deal, from operational users to economic buyers, and navigate the political dynamics between teams that have never had to agree on a system before.

•
Scope, design, and own proof-of-concept projects end to end, combining a prospect's current state and processes within the Omnea platform to validate what that specific buying committee needs to see - not only a demo can run smoothly.

•
Present the outcome of a PoV and the roadmap to full implementation directly to executives up to C-level, framing the conversation around measurable ROI rather than a features checklist.

•
Build the reusable collateral, solution patterns, and demo frameworks that outlast your own deals: what you create should make every SE who joins after you productive faster than you were.

•
Mentor teammates on customer engagement and technical strategy, and help define what a great Solution Consultant at Omnea actually looks like.

•
Work hand in hand with Product: Bring competitive intelligence and prospect insight back from the field, and work with Product to shape what we build and how we position it.

What's Different About This Role

•
This is a career-defining chance to help shape Omnea's GTM and Solution Consulting function in the UK, at a company that's still writing its playbook rather than handing you one.

•
You'll own complex enterprise deals end to end, working directly with AEs and senior customer stakeholders, which means you'll influence not just how individual deals get won but how the entire Solution Consulting function operates as it scales.

•
We're a flat, high-bar team where senior hires are expected to be self-directed from day one: you won't be eased in with a slow ramp or a junior support structure, you'll be trusted with real ownership immediately.

•
The company is on an incredibly strong growth trajectory with enterprise momentum behind it, which means the scope for you to create visible, immediate impact is significant rather than incremental.

•
Expect a genuinely meritocratic culture, one with high standards and direct feedback, where performance is recognized quickly and equity upside reflects the level of ownership and impact you actually have.

About you

Someone who thrives in this role is highly ambitious, genuinely energized by ambiguity and wants to influence how this function works. They're also an exceptional individual contributor first: whatever they've been trusted with before, they've delivered on it.

•
3-7+ years in enterprise sales engineering, solutions engineering, or senior technical consulting, ideally in B2B SaaS

•
A track record supporting high-contract-value enterprise deals - you know that winning one takes strategic positioning and deep discovery.

•
Comfortable working across large organizations with stakeholders at every level

•
Experience owning strategic accounts, mentoring others, or shaping solution strategy in a high-grow

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. ## About the team

The Platform Velocity Sales team works with B2B Software Platforms to help them facilitate payments for their customers using our Stripe Connect product. Software Platforms, also known as B2B Indirect, are software platform businesses who serve other businesses. You will work with the next wave of startup platforms already using Stripe. As a key member of the Stripe Platforms team, you will manage and elevate relationships with a named account list while identifying new growth opportunities and ways Stripe can exceed expectations. If you’re motivated, smart, persistent, and a great teammate, we want to hear from you! ## What you’ll do

As an Account Executive (Existing Business), you will create partnerships between Stripe and the most innovative and fastest-growing software platforms in the world by helping them to understand how Stripe’s online commerce infrastructure can make payments a competitive advantage for their businesses. ### Responsibilities

• Directly manage and cultivate a named account list while crafting comprehensive account plans aimed at winning and expanding business with upper middle market and enterprise companies.
• Build and sustain key relationships with C-level executives, ensuring the orchestration of appropriate executive touchpoints.
• Contribute to the development of our platform partnership strategy by establishing repeatable processes and scalable engagement models.
• Develop outbound strategies to create and nurture new business opportunities.
• Own the complete sales cycle, from lead generation to closing sales with upper middle market and enterprise clients.
• Coordinate and support the implementation of sold platforms and facilitate their effective utilization of Stripe products.
• Foster relationships with executive stakeholders at both new and existing clients.
• Collaborate with leaders across various functions (such as Engineering, Product, and Finance) to conduct complex product workshops and financial analyses.
• Lead and contribute to team initiatives aimed at developing and refining our sales process.
• Engage with Product and Engineering teams to shape and drive product strategy.

Who you are

You are an adept salesperson and relationship manager capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization, including the CTO, COO, and CFO. You have experience working with Startup, SMB, and Mid-Market companies. You have an in-depth understanding of the buyer journey and can lead a complex, multi-party sale in a highly consultative manner. You are used to building value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require deep product understanding combined with technical knowledge. You are naturally analytical and enjoy digging into business models and helping customers quantify their investment decisions. You get excited about prospecting and are capable of independently leading a sales cycle from start to finish. Finally, you enjoy building – you like to actively participate in the development of our sales process, the articulation of our value proposition, and the creation of key tools and assets. If you’re motivated, smart, persistent, and a great teammate, we want to hear from you! ## Minimum Requirements

• A minimum of 3-6 years of sales or prospecting experience, ideally within a technology company, showcasing a consistent record of top performance.
• Directly manage and nurture a named account list and develop account plans for winning and expanding business with upper middle market and enterprise companies.
• Build and maintain key relationships with C-level executives while orchestrating the right executive touch points as well.
• Contribute to shaping our platform partnership strategy and building repeatable processes and scaled engagement models.
• Develop outbound strategies to create and nurture opportunities.
• Own the full sales cycle from lead to close for upper middle market and enterprise companies.
• Develop relationships with executive stakeholders at new and existing clients.
• Work with company leaders from multiple functions (e.g., Engineering, Product, and Finance) to lead complex product workshops and financial analyses.
• Lead and contribute to team projects to develop and refine our sales process.
• Engage with Product and Engineering teams to help drive product strategy.

About Black Forest Labs

We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.

Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use.

Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next.

What You’ll Work On

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, ML Infrastructure & Inference at BFL, you will:

•
Build custom endpoints and pipelines on top of FLUX for our customers: multi-step workflows, prompt harnesses and upsampling, pre- and post-processing, moderation and safety layers, and combinations of FLUX with VLMs and other models

•
Take customer use cases from scoping to proof of concept to a production endpoint, running on BFL's or the customer's infrastructure

•
Own the deployment of FLUX models and custom pipelines into customers' production environments, from on premise to BFL-hosted integrations, including serving setup, GPU sizing and scaling

•
Profile customer workloads, apply existing inference optimizations to hit cost and latency targets, and partner with BFL's inference team on deeper optimization work

•
Build evaluation sets and harnesses against customer requirements, and catch quality regressions across model versions

•
Help customers adapt models to their use case through finetuning and LoRA training pipelines on their own or BFL's infrastructure

•
Advise customers on deployment architecture and on the trade-offs between BFL-hosted and self-hosted setups (cost, latency, security, compliance)

•
Feed field learnings back to BFL's research and platform teams, and turn repeated customer work into reusable tooling, reference architectures and documentation

•
Act as a technical thought leader within the FDE team, setting standards for applied and deployment work and mentoring other engineers

What We’re Looking For

•
6+ years of engineering experience, with significant time building and running ML systems in production

•
Hands-on experience building and serving ML models in production, from model code to API (e.g. PyTorch, model serving frameworks, GPU workloads)

•
Experience building applied ML systems end to end: pipelines combining multiple models, evaluation, and safety or moderation components

•
Solid infrastructure skills: Kubernetes, containerization, observability, and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, Azure)

•
Experience working directly with customer engineering teams in complex enterprise environments, including security reviews and regulated or air-gapped setups

•
Strong Python skills and comfort reading and modifying model code

•
Ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, internally and externally

•
Willingness to take on Technical Deployment Lead (TDL) responsibility for strategic accounts, owning the technical relationship and delivery end to end

•
Willingness to travel occasionally, nationally and internationally, for team offsites and customer engagements

Nice to have

•
Prior knowledge of diffusion models and/or flow matching, and relevant finetuning and distillation techniques

•
Inference optimization experience and a track record of improving latency, throughput or cost per generation

•
Experience with LLMs or VLMs for prompt harnesses, captioning or evaluation

•
Experience with open source tooling from the FLUX ecosystem such as ComfyUI, diffusers and common trainer frameworks

•
Experience serving video generation models

•
Open-source contributions to inference, serving or diffusion model projects

•
Previous experience as a forward deployed engineer, solutions architect or ML platform engineer at an AI lab or cloud provider

How We Work Together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. This role is based in San Francisco, and you’ll join us in the office at least 2 days a week, or one full week every other week.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

•
Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

•
Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

•
Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

•
Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

Closing

If this sounds like work you'd enjoy, we'd love to hear from you.

Compensation

USD 273-395K + equity, depending on profile

About the Role

As a Data Science Leader, B2B Marketing & Demand Generation, you will partner with our B2B Marketing organization and help accelerate how businesses discover, adopt, and grow with AI.

You will be a strategic partner to our B2B Marketing leadership team, bringing a deep understanding of the B2B landscape and a point of view on how to grow a business. You will help shape our marketing strategy, identify our biggest growth opportunities, and build the data, measurement, and intelligence capabilities needed to turn those opportunities into impact.

The opportunity spans the full customer journey, from building awareness and engaging buying groups to generating demand, partnering with Sales, and helping customers adopt and expand their use of OpenAI. You will build and lead a team of data scientists and work closely with Marketing, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Finance.

We’re looking for people who bring strong B2B marketing expertise, a track record of influencing growth strategy through Data Science, and experience building and developing high-performing teams.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

•
Be a strategic partner to B2B Marketing leadership. Bring insights, recommendations, and a clear point of view to the most important business decisions. Help leaders understand where we are winning, where we have opportunities, and where to focus next.

•
Shape our growth strategy. Identify the audiences, accounts, industries, and customer journeys where we can have the greatest impact. Connect market opportunity and customer signals to marketing and go-to-market priorities.

•
Build a full-funnel view of the business. Connect awareness, engagement, demand, pipeline, conversion, adoption, and expansion. Make it easier for teams to understand how customers move through the journey and where we can improve their experience.

•
Measure what matters. Build a thoughtful approach to measuring brand and demand generation, combining experiments, causal inference, marketing mix modeling, and other methods. Help leaders understand both near-term outcomes and longer-term effects, with clarity on uncertainty and tradeoffs.

•
Develop buying-group and account intelligence. Bring together customer and account signals to understand who is engaging, where buying groups are developing momentum, and how Marketing and Sales can better reach and serve them.

•
Improve the path from self-serve to enterprise adoption. Partner across Marketing, Sales, and Product to understand when businesses are ready for a deeper relationship and how to support the transition to broader deployment and sustained usage.

•
Build AI-native intelligence capabilities. Partner with Engineering and product teams to turn insights into scalable tools, recommendations, and workflows that help marketers and go-to-market teams make better decisions.

•
Build and develop a high-performing team. Recruit and grow exceptional talent, set a high bar for analytical rigor and business impact, and create an environment where people can do their best work.

You might thrive in this role if you:

•
Have experience leading Data Science, Analytics, or a related team in a B2B business, with a track record of influencing growth strategy and business decisions.

•
Have a strong understanding of B2B marketing and go-to-market, including demand generation, account-based marketing, enterprise sales cycles, and complex buying groups.

•
Have experience measuring marketing effectiveness using experimentation, causal inference, and other approaches, and the judgment to choose the right method for the question.

•
Have experience connecting marketing, sales, product, and customer data to understand the full customer journey.

•
Have a track record of building strong partnerships with senior leaders, challenging assumptions constructively, and turning complex analysis into clear recommendations.

•
Have experience hiring and developing high-performing teams, including leaders and senior individual contributors.

•
Are comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment, moving between strategy and execution, and building capabilities where the path is not yet defined.

We’d be especially excited if you bring:

•
Experience building predictive models, account intelligence, or recommendation systems that have been adopted by business teams.

•
Experience with product-led growth or self-serve-to-sales motions alongside enterprise go-to-market.

•
Curiosity about AI and a desire to use it to rethink how marketing and go-to-market teams operate.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

About the team
OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team partners with our customers to turn research breakthroughs into production systems. We embed with users to solve high-leverage problems, move fast from prototype to deployment, and surface reusable patterns that shape our platform. We operate at the intersection of field delivery and internal development, working closely with Product, Research, and Go-To-Market (GTM).

About the role
As a foundational FDE manager, you’ll lead FDE through high-stakes, ambiguous customer deployments and own technical and business value outcomes end to end. You’ll grow a team that can operate under pressure and help OpenAI learn from the field.

You’ll partner closely with Product, Research, Sales, and GTM to ensure fieldwork informs roadmap priorities, drives new exploration, and supports safe deployment at scale. Your decisions will influence how OpenAI is trusted by the customers closest to our deployment work. Your success will be measured by how consistently your team ships, how clearly you deliver signal to Research and Product, and how durable your team and delivery model prove to be.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. This role also will require travel up to 25%.

In this role you will

•
Lead and grow a team of FDE delivering production systems with frontier models

•
Own end-to-end delivery outcomes through clarity, speed, tight coordination, and technical quality

•
Codify what works into tools, playbooks, and roadmap inputs that create leverage for both OpenAI and our wider developer community

•
Notice early indicators and raise them with urgency, whether in product behavior, customer environments, or delivery practices

•
Use judgement to distinguish what requires action and what does not

•
Set a high bar for FDE performance and support each person’s growth through direct, actionable feedback

•
Define how we staff and support field teams that can scale without added complexity

You might thrive in this role if you

•
Bring 8+ years of engineering or technical delivery experience, including 2+ years managing high-performing FDE or customer-facing engineers

•
Have led high-pressure technical projects from prototype to production

•
Write and review production-grade code across frontend and backend using Javascript or Python

•
Simplify complex work and make fast, sound decisions under pressure

•
Elevate team performance through clarity, not process

•
Operate with urgency in ambiguous or evolving environments

•
Translate field experience into sharp, actionable feedback for Product and Research

•
Build deep trust with your team by modeling calm, focus, and judgment when it matters most

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity.
