d.description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

Our National Security Vision:

Our vision for national security customers rests on two tenets: help build the domestic industrial might to deter conflict and win a robotic war of attrition if necessary; and apply the best of our dual-use technology foundation to equip our soldiers with world-leading capability.

About the Role:

We are hiring an Industry Marketing leader for our National Security business. This person is accountable within Marketing for making Skydio known, trusted, and chosen with the Department of War (DoW), key civilian agencies and our military allies around the world. You will own marketing strategy, messaging, product launches, and go-to-market enablement for the global national security business. This role is based on our headquarters at San Mateo and has high visibility with the executive leadership team

How you’ll make an impact:

•
Own the national security marketing strategy, plan, and messaging.

•
Work closely with Marketing partners to lead an integrated program across brand, product marketing, field, and events.

•
Craft the messaging and positioning that translates Skydio’s autonomy, products, and industrial capability into mission value for DoW and other federal customers

•
Lead go-to-market for new product launches, ensuring Sales, Communications, Policy, and product and channel partners are fully enabled.

•
Equip Sales, Mission Success, and other internal customer champions with sales tools, competitive positioning, and content that articulate Skydio’s differentiation.

•
Build content grounded in the different customer vertical’s terminology, while maintaining political and regulatory savviness

•
Create product experiences that bring Skydio solutions to life for current and future customers.

What makes you a good fit:

•
8-10 years in B2B or B2G product or industry marketing with proven success launching products with measurable pipeline impact.

•
Exceptional writer with comfort rolling up your sleeves and building from 0-1.

•
Ideally fluent in or willing to learn defense and federal procurement, colors of money and budgeting, and credibility from senior government officials down to frontline drone operators.

•
Required military service or significant hands-on experience working with defense organizations. You must be proficient in how military organizations evaluate and procure technology.

•
This position may require access to export-controlled technology, technical data, and/or controlled information, including information subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Export Administration Regulations (EAR), and/or U.S. government contract requirements. Candidates must be eligible to access such information without additional U.S. government authorization, unless the company determines that any required authorization can be obtained

Compensation: At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual base salary range for this position is $190,000 - 235,000. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company's success. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. This position and all associated benefits are subject to applicable federal, state, and local laws, as well as the Company’s policies and eligibility criteria.

*Compensation for certain positions may vary based on the position’s location.

At Skydio we believe that diversity drives innovation. We have created a multidisciplinary environment that embraces the power of diverse perspectives to create elegant solutions for complex problems. We are committed to growing our network of people, programs, and resources to nurture an inclusive culture.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by federal, state or local anti-discrimination laws.

For positions located in the United States of America, Skydio, Inc. uses E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit https://www.e-verify.gov/

d.description:
Senior Field Marketing Manager

We're looking for a Senior Field Marketing Manager to own Field Marketing at Jellyfish and shape how we show up in person for engineering leaders and executives.

You'll own the field strategy end-to-end, including program planning, prioritization, budget allocation, and measurement. Partnering closely with Sales leadership, Product Marketing, and Customer Success, you'll build a portfolio that balances trade shows and conferences with enterprise and strategic account programs. You'll measure success beyond pipeline, including deal acceleration and retention, and bring the insights leadership needs to make field investment decisions.

The ideal candidate has built and led field programs in high-growth B2B SaaS companies with enterprise sales motions.

Let's talk about what you'll do:

Field Strategy & Planning

•
Own the Field Marketing function and define the program approach within business priorities.

•
Allocate time, budget, and effort across field channels based on business impact.

•
Build account-aware programs, including enterprise plays, open opportunity and strategic account meetups, on-sites, and customer programs.

Measurement & Insights

•
Define success criteria and post-program evaluation for every initiative.

•
Measure impact across pipeline, deal acceleration, and retention.

•
Identify trends across regions, segments, and programs, and adjust strategy proactively.

Cross-Functional Leadership

•
Align Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success around field initiatives.

•
Communicate field strategy, performance, and recommendations to executive leadership.

•
Serve as the trusted voice for Field Marketing and mentor teammates as the team grows.

Let's talk about what you need to excel:

•
[6–8+] years of field or event marketing experience in B2B SaaS.

•
Experience building account-based field programs for enterprise audiences.

•
Advanced knowledge of Salesforce, reporting, and measurement frameworks.

•
Experience influencing senior and executive stakeholders without direct authority.

•
A strategic thinker who uses strong judgment in ambiguous, high-impact situations.

•
Ability to travel 3–5 times per quarter for events.

A list of job experiences and qualification requirements is great, but humility, a performance-driven attitude, and a team-player approach are most important to us. We love to have fun and win in the process. We only hire people who have a passion for building great companies in an environment where a sense of humor is a must.

Occasional travel may be required.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the US. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

We are aware that third-party recruiters may contact candidates about Jellyfish opportunities without our authorization. Please know that not all individuals or agencies claiming to recruit for Jellyfish are affiliated with or authorized by our company.
We encourage candidates to verify opportunities through our official careers page and exercise caution when responding to unsolicited recruiting messages. If you have any concerns about the legitimacy of an outreach, please contact our Talent Acquisition team directly.

Let’s talk about us!
This is all about you, but you want to know a little about us. Jellyfish is the leading intelligence platform for AI-Integrated engineering, helping more than 1,000 companies including DraftKings, Keller Williams and Blue Yonder, leverage AI to transform how they build software. By combining the industry’s deepest engineering dataset with context-rich intelligence, Jellyfish helps R&D organizations understand what’s driving impact, adopt proven industry best practices, and make smarter decisions across AI adoption, planning, delivery, and engineering performance.

d.description:
A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Notion, Linear, Ramp and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

We're looking for a brilliant Brand Designer who knows B2B SaaS, moves fast, and can make great work happen without a lot of fuss.

What that looks like day to day

We're looking for an experienced Brand Designer to join us on a 12-month fixed-term contract, covering maternity leave.

Our brand design function was built from scratch over the last two years and the foundations are strong - a visual identity, an events design system, SEV0, a rolling drumbeat of launches and campaigns. This isn't a holding-pattern role. You'll take what we've built and run with it, across our website, social, events, launches and our flagship conference. Where you see something that should be better, you'll be trusted to make it better.

We're looking for someone who's done this kind of work before, ideally for ambitious B2B SaaS startups or established software brands. You'll have great creative instincts, an eye for the details and, crucially, the ability to get brilliant work out the door quickly. We move fast, priorities can change, and there's always something new around the corner. You'll know when to sweat the small stuff and when to just get things done.

Own brand design across all touchpoints - website, social, ads, guides, reports, events and swag - keeping quality and consistency high through a busy launch and campaign calendar.

Lead the design for our events programme, including our flagship conference SEV0 - booths, banners, printed collateral, swag and the event design system.

•
Keep things moving - juggle multiple projects, turn around great work quickly and know how to prioritise when everything feels important. We're a fast-moving startup, and we need someone who can keep up without compromising on craft.

•
Be an advocate for consistency and craft as we scale and grow the incident.io brand. You'll have the judgement to know when something needs more attention and when it's ready to go.

•
Partner with the marketing team on both tactical and long-term projects, bringing your own perspective on how we should develop our brand.

•
Collaborate with the wider design team as we know an amazing product is the foundation for a great brand, and compelling design can be the foundation for both.

Who you are

•
You've got solid B2B SaaS experience. You've designed for B2B software companies before, whether in-house, freelance or on a contract basis. Ideally, you've worked with established SaaS brands or fast-growing startups, and you understand how to make complex, technical products feel exciting and accessible.

•
Your portfolio speaks for itself. You've got exceptional brand and marketing design work to show us, including websites, campaigns, launches, guides and presentations for B2B SaaS audiences. You care about the little details and know how to make a brand feel brilliant across every touchpoint.

•
You move fast and get stuff done. You've worked in fast-paced environments, ideally startups, and know how to balance speed with quality. You're pragmatic, comfortable juggling competing priorities and don't need everything perfectly mapped out before getting started.

•
You're confident picking up an established brand. You don't need to rebuild things from first principles to make an impact. You can get up to speed quickly, understand what's working and find ways to make it even better.

•
You've got strong digital design skills. You're brilliant in Figma, comfortable with Adobe tools for print, and care just as much about the quality of a one-pager or piece of swag as you do a big campaign.

•
You're a natural collaborator. You enjoy working closely with Marketing, Product Designers and engineers, sharing work early, taking feedback on board and sweating the details to make sure the finished thing is as good as it can be.

•
You're organised and comfortable with ambiguity. Startups can (occasionally!) be chaotic. You can figure things out as you go, make good decisions independently and keep things moving without needing lots of direction.

Bonus points

•
You have experience with motion design / animation.

•
You've designed booths, installations or other creative for conferences and events.

•
You're comfortable working with frontend engineers and getting hands-on with HTML/CSS where needed.

•
You've covered a role on an FTC or contract basis before and know how to get productive fast.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

•
Market-leading private medical insurance. The proper kind, so you're never weighing up your health against a bill.

•
Competitive PTO. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

•
Enhanced 401k. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

•
Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

•
Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI

About the Role :

You will be the Finance partner to Sales and the CRO office. You will own commercial governance on every non-standard deal, build CleverTap's deal desk from the ground up, and drive cash collection across our global entities. As we move toward usage-based and AI-linked pricing, you will make sure every deal is priced, structured and billed in a way that protects margin and converts to cash.

What will you do :

Deal Desk and Pricing Governance

•
Build and run the deal desk: discount authority matrix, payment-term policy, non-standard terms library and an SLA-driven approval workflow.

•
Review complex enterprise deals for margin, discount depth, contract terms, billing structure and revenue recognition impact, working with Legal and Accounting.

•
Design pricing and packaging guardrails for usage-based and AI-linked products, including credits, overages, minimum commitments and true-ups, and model their effect on gross margin and cost to serve.

•
Track discount leakage, deal velocity and approval cycle time, and report them to the CRO office every month.

Revenue Analytics and Planning

•

Collections and Working Capital

Work with Accounting, Accounts Receivable, Sales and Customer Success on escalations, credit risk and provisioning.

Monitor customer payment trends and recommend actions that improve working capital.

d.description:
Merge is the leading provider of agentic tools and customer-facing integrations for frontier LLMs, Fortune 500 organizations, and B2B SaaS companies.

Our platform offers two core products: Merge for Product, and Merge for Workforce. Merge for Product enables teams to ship AI features and integrations at massive scale. Merge for Workforce helps engineering teams govern AI access at the company level. Merge's enterprise-grade platform handles the entire integration lifecycle, from authentication and security to monitoring and maintenance. Thousands of companies trust Merge to accelerate product development, unblock sales, reduce customer churn, and save engineering resources—allowing them to focus on their core product.

Who are we looking for?

As a Solutions Engineer, you are the technical partner on every deal. Our Account Executives own the relationship and the commercial side. You own the technical win: understanding what a prospect's engineers actually need, spotting risks early, and proving Merge solves their problem.

This is a pre-sales role. You will spend most of your time in front of customers, roughly 15 to 16 hours a week on sales calls, alongside prep, follow-up and work with our Product and Engineering teams. Pipeline comes to you through our AEs, so there is no cold calling or prospecting.

You will be a generalist across both product lines, credible with a CTO building AI into their product in the morning and a CISO rolling out AI agents to employees in the afternoon. You will work mid-market and enterprise deals, including strategic accounts where proofs of concept run across quarters.

What you will do:

•
Run rigorous technical discovery. Ask the questions that uncover a prospect's real technical needs and the risks to the deal before anyone demos anything.

•
Give tailored demos. Build demos around the prospect's problem, not a feature tour.

•
Own proofs of concept. Run POCs that typically last two to three weeks, with clear plans, check-ins several times a week in shared channels, and honest timelines.

•
Win the technical decision. Partner with your AE so the technical win and the commercial win land together.

•
Unblock deals fast. Use AI to build quick fixes and demo apps during a POC. Treat bigger product gaps like a PM would, bringing feedback to Product and Engineering with context and priority.

•
Teach and support. Run technical workshops for prospect engineering teams and help find new use cases on renewals and expansions.

The Ideal candidate will have:

•
2+ years of pre-sales experience as a Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer or similar at a SaaS company with a technical product and technical buyers.

•
Technical depth. You read code comfortably and can explain what it does. You understand APIs, authentication, webhooks, pagination and data models, and can reason through edge cases in API docs. You don't need a CS degree or to write code every day.

•
Sales presence. You are comfortable owning a room alongside your AE, you read buying signals, and you move deals forward. You are energized by spending a big part of your week with customers.

•
Customer-facing poise. You stay calm under tough technical questions and build trust with developer, IT and security buyers.

•
AI as part of how you work. You use AI tools every day in real workflows, such as researching prospects, prepping tailored demos, building POC fixes with a coding agent, or automating follow-ups. Using a chatbot for search or summaries is not enough for this role. Tell us what you've built.

•
High ownership. You own the outcome of the technical win, chase blockers across teams, and follow a POC through to the end.

Compensation

•
The cash compensation range for this role is $155,000 - $185,000.

•
Actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications. In addition to cash compensation, all employees receive an equity compensation package.

Merge on the Rise:

Linkedin's Top Startups 2025

Forbes Next Billion Dollar Startups 2023

G2 Fastest Growing Products 2024

Benefits

•
Unlimited PTO + 10 company holidays

•
Quality health, vision, and dental insurance

•
401K Plan

•
$200 one-time home office stipend

•
Free dinner when working past 7pm

Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system.

The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.

At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day.

Mission

As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you will deliver fast, reliable, API-driven integrations for our largest customers by translating business workflows into scalable, repeatable technical solutions. You will partner closely with Sales and Customer Success to deliver best-in-class integration experiences that drive adoption and long-term success. This role is primarily customer-facing, with a strong focus on solution design and customer outcomes rather than traditional software development. You'll build integrations primarily with low-code tools, using light scripting where needed.

What You’ll Do

•
Independently design, build, and deliver complex, scalable, and secure integrations between Choco and customer systems using low-code tools (e.g. n8n and Tray.ai).

•
Own complex and strategic integration projects end-to-end, from technical discovery and solution architecture to go-live, ensuring quality, scalability, and long-term reliability.

•
Partner with Account Executives in pre-sales by leading technical discovery, proofs of concept, and integration scoping, advising on feasibility and solution design for complex customer requirements.

•
Act as a technical escalation point, troubleshooting critical integration issues, proactively identifying risks, and driving sustainable solutions.

•
Collaborate closely with Customer Success, Implementation, and Product teams, providing technical guidance, documenting integration designs, and influencing product improvements based on customer needs.

•
Mentor junior Solutions Engineers, providing technical guidance, sharing expertise, and supporting their development through complex projects.

•
Drive continuous improvement of integration architecture, processes, and best practices to increase delivery efficiency, quality, and scalability globally.

•
Independently make technical and architectural decisions within complex projects, escalating only major strategic decisions requiring broader alignment.

What You Bring

•
5+ years of experience in solutions engineering, IT/ERP consulting, or systems integration.

•
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

•
Experience managing end-to-end API integrations, including requirements gathering, solution design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing support across multiple customer environments.

•
Experience with low-code or automation tools such as n8n, Zapier, and Tray.ai.

•
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a collaborative, solution-focused mindset.

•
Excellent communicator with the ability to make complex ideas clear and simple.

•
This position requires in-office attendance 3 days per week in our Paris office.

Nice to Have

•
Experience with the ERP or ordering systems common among food and beverage distributors.

•
Background in food distribution, supply chain, or B2B SaaS.

•
Comfort using AI tools to speed up discovery, documentation, and integration builds.

What you get

•
Work on digitalizing core operating systems for food distributors, automating orders, sales and payments in a system that still largely runs on calls and spreadsheets.

•
Work with an AI product with proven product–market fit, already embedded in distributor workflows and directly affecting order accuracy, speed, and margins.

•
Join a global team across 6 countries and 40+ nationalities, building a company that has raised $300M+ and reached unicorn status (~$1.2B valuation) with the ambition to define this category end-to-end.

•
In return, you get real ownership, equity, and the support to do your best work, including competitive compensation, health and wellbeing support, and long-term benefits like a sabbatical (all localized by office).

•
Collaborate with people who want to own outcomes in a messy, real-world system and make it work at scale.

If you want to work on real problems, take ownership, and raise the bar, we should talk.

Choco is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. We are committed to ensuring that our technology is available and accessible to everyone. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

d.description:
About FirstWork

FirstWork is an applied AI company building the next generation of workforce operations technology.

We work with companies across staffing, logistics, healthcare, and retail that manage large frontline workforces. These businesses deal with complex, highly manual processes involving hiring, onboarding, document verification, compliance, training, and ongoing workforce management.

We're using AI agents to automate these workflows, working alongside human teams and integrating with the systems businesses already use.

Having raised $15M in our Series A, led by Earlybird Venture Capital, bringing our total funding to $20M, we're entering an exciting phase of growth. With established enterprise customers and a growing product footprint, we're expanding beyond hiring and onboarding to build a comprehensive AI-powered workforce operations platform.

About the Role

We're looking for a Content & Community Manager to lead Firstwork's content engine and build our community across the UK and Europe.

In this role, you'll set the editorial direction for everything Firstwork publishes, write the pieces that matter most yourself, and run our UK and European events and community. You'll work closely with our Founding Marketing Lead, who is also UK-based, as well as our global go-to-market team.

What you'll do

•
Lead day-to-day marketing content production for Firstwork: own the content calendar, the voice and the quality bar across our blog, LinkedIn, YouTube and newsletters

•
Write and edit our most important long-form work, including research reports built on Firstwork Labs data, buyer guides and customer stories.

•
Support our AEO and SEO strategies with optimised content

•
Support our founders and GTM team with their own LinkedIn presences.

•
Work with our Marketing Lead to organise and run our UK and European events and community, from industry events to hosted roundtables.

•
Work with our PR agencies in the UK, Europe and the US on story angles, bylines and commentary.

•
Brief and edit freelance writers, and brief our design and video agencies.

•
Report monthly on organic reach, citations in AI answers and the pipeline content influences.

What we need

•
5+ years in B2B content, including at least 2 years owning content strategy and the editorial calendar for a B2B tech company.

•
B2B technology experience. Experience in HR tech, staffing or workforce operations is a plus.

•
A portfolio of writing that senior business buyers want to read.

•
A record of growing organic reach or content-influenced pipeline, with numbers.

•
Experience turning data and research into stories and reports.

•
Experience managing freelance writers, and running a content process that uses AI tools alongside them.

•
Working knowledge of SEO and how AI answer engines choose their sources.

•
Some experience running events or building a community.

•
Builder mentality, comfortable starting at 0 and quickly getting to 1, using AI tools and systems to get there.

•
Creative mindset - you’re not content to roll out the same playbook every time, you want to push the boundaries.

•
Willingness to travel across the UK and Europe for events.

Nice to have

•
A network in UK staffing (APSCo, REC) or European HR.

•
Experience in marketing AI products

Why Join FirstWork?

•
Own the content strategy: Shape FirstWork's editorial direction and brand voice across multiple channels.

•
Build market presence: Play a central role in growing our brand and community across the UK and Europe.

•
Experiment and innovate: Explore new approaches to content, SEO, AEO, and AI-powered marketing.

•
Work globally: Collaborate with founders, marketing leaders, and go-to-market teams across international markets.

•
Make an impact: Create content and communities that build credibility, engage enterprise buyers, and contribute to business growth.

Firstwork is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status.

d.description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the Role

Skydio is seeking an experienced physical security professional to join our team as Solutions Engineer – Commercial Site Security. Commercial Solutions Engineering is the technical arm of Skydio's commercial go-to-market motion. We sit between the customer and the product: translating industrial and security problems into deployable programs, proving capability in the field, and making sure Skydio's products are integrated and flown at scale across sites that were never designed with drones in mind.

Coverage is tiered by customer size rather than by territory, so the team is measured on technical win rate, trial and proof of concept outcomes, program expansion inside existing accounts, and the requirements we push back into the product organization.

Solutions Engineers are critical members of the Skydio organization and work closely with Account Executives, Engineering, and Product to support deal progression, customer confidence, successful deployments, and the long-term success of commercial sUAS programs. Internally you are, in every sense, the voice of the customer.

This is a remote role. Travel of approximately 50 to 75% is required to support customer engagements, field activities, deployments, team onsites, and company events.

This role reports to Senior Manager, Commercial – Site Security.

About the Team

Commercial Solutions Engineering is the technical arm of Skydio's commercial go-to-market motion. We sit between the customer and the product: translating industrial and security problems into deployable programs, proving capability in the field, and making sure Skydio's products are integrated and flown at scale across sites that were never designed with drones in mind.

Coverage is tiered by customer size rather than by territory, so the team is measured on technical win rate, trial and proof of concept outcomes, program expansion inside existing accounts, and the requirements we push back into the product organization.

Solutions Engineers are critical members of the Skydio organization and work closely with Account Executives, Engineering, and Product to support deal progression, customer confidence, successful deployments, and the long-term success of commercial sUAS programs. Internally you are, in every sense, the voice of the customer.

How You'll Make an Impact

•
Collaborate with enterprise security customers to understand their security operations and develop tailored drone solutions as a trusted expert and an integral member of the account team.

•
Deliver Security Command demonstrations tied to customer scenarios while explaining support capabilities, operating limitations, and features accurately.

•
Work with the customer to design dock coverage models, autonomous patrol missions, detection zones, and customer-operated, managed-service, or hybrid workflows specific to their requirements.

•
Own trial execution from start to finish including baselines, measurable success criteria, scope, dates, while coordinating resources and support to maintain the scorecard.

•
Validate supported VMS, intrusion detection, and access-control workflows with enterprise customer IT and integration partners.

•
Translate field observations into prioritized feedback for Product and Engineering, connecting reproducible issues and workflow gaps to customer impact.

•
Own site assessment quality for accounts. Solutions Engineers are the responsible individual for verifying dock placement prior to deployment along with power and networking requirements.

•
Coordinate operating approvals and BVLOS, multi-drone, and other waiver requirements for the airspace and operations your customer falls under.

What Makes You a Good Fit

•
5+ years of relevant experience in commercial security operations, security systems integration, or customer-facing technical roles serving enterprise security teams.

•
Practical understanding of perimeter protection, alarm verification, SOC/GSOC workflows, guard operations, and incident response.

•
Experience deploying and supporting physical security technology, with the ability to troubleshoot hardware, connectivity, video, and configuration issues.

•
Strong understanding of drone technology, sUAS operations, and regulatory compliance.

•
Excellent problem solving skills and the ability to think critically in high-pressure situations.

•
Exceptional written and verbal communication with operators, technical stakeholders, security executives, including candid conversations about limitations.

•
Ability to manage concurrent opportunities within a Sales organization, prioritize technical effort, and coordinate customer and partner commitments.

•
Lead by example. Willing to do whatever is needed to get a customer situation resolved.

Nice to Have

•

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Global Executive Content and Experiences team creates experiences for executive audiences that build advocacy and trust, strengthen relationships, and generate revenue. We develop content and programs that help Stripe attract, grow, and retain our most strategic users.

What you’ll do

As an Executive Briefing Content Strategist on the Executive Briefing team, you’ll turn account research, business insights, and Stripe’s product capabilities into tailored content for executive briefings. Your work will help executive audiences understand how Stripe can support their business objectives and create new opportunities for growth.

You’ll partner with Executive Briefing Managers and colleagues across Product Marketing, Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Stripe’s executive leadership to develop materials that educate and inspire existing and prospective users. Through compelling narratives and visual storytelling, you’ll help build trust in Stripe as a financial infrastructure partner.

Who you are

Preferred qualifications

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 700 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

d.description:
Adaptional is building AI for insurance. Insurance is one of the largest industries globally, and still manages work with manual data entry, outsourced teams, human error-checking, and 30-year-old software. We are building a platform that delivers the claude-code experience for insurance teams, beginning with the $2 trillion+ property casualty claims market.

Adaptional’s founders are ex-xAI (SpaceXAI) and Clipboard and previously exited a YC-backed insurance startup. The company raised a YC-led $10m seed round, one of the largest ever insurtech seeds to date. We are working with top-10 insurance companies and are building a multi-product roadmap rapidly.

Founding GTM

You will be Adaptional's first business hire. Today, sales is founder-led; your job is to make it scale. You'll work directly with the CEO to convert pipeline into revenue, own customer implementations end-to-end, and build the commercial machine (GTM strategy, sales process, and eventually the customer implementation and support team) from scratch.

This is a builder role, not a manager role. There is no playbook, no ops team, and no one to delegate to yet. You'll do whatever the business needs each week: prepping a carrier pitch, running a customer onboarding, standing up the CRM, writing the first success playbook, then building the teams to scale these functions.

What you'll do

• Work alongside the CEO on active enterprise sales: pipeline management, deal prep, follow-through, and conversion

• Own relationships with our insurance customers: onboarding, expansion, and day-to-day account management

• Build the GTM foundation: sales process, pipeline infrastructure, outbound motion, and customer-facing materials

• Stand up our early customer success and support function, then hire and lead the first team

• Take on whatever else matters most. This is a true generalist seat with expanding scope

Who you are

• An exceptional generalist who relishes hard problems. You've come from private equity, consulting, or business school, or you've done a similar founding/early role at a startup

• You’ve done something extraordinary

• 2-4+ years of experience in a high-performance environment

• High ownership and comfort with ambiguity: you figure things out without a playbook and follow through without being managed

• Strong written and verbal communicator. You'll be in front of executives at some of the largest insurance companies in the world

• Excited to work intensely in person in San Francisco

Compensation

Highly competitive cash and equity, based on experience and skill level. Founding-hire equity. You'll own a meaningful piece of what you build.

Numeral is transforming how taxes get done. Digital businesses are currently bogged down by a painful web of regulations across 47 states and 50+ countries. We’re eliminating this burden so teams can focus on their core mission.

We’re the largest and fastest-growing AI-native tax solution. Started in 2023, Numeral has raised over $57M from Benchmark, Mayfield, Y Combinator, and many others. We now serve over 3,000 paying customers and have more than tripled our revenue every year in our history.

We’re primarily hiring in our SF and NY offices, but do hire remotely in some cases.

About the role

We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer who thrives at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer success. You'll work directly with customers to solve complex technical problems while building the software that makes those solutions scalable.

This is a unique hybrid role. Roughly half your time will be spent working directly with customers, onboarding teams, supporting enterprise implementations, and partnering with Sales and Customer Success on technical engagements. The other half will be spent building software—shipping features, automating workflows, improving our platform, and owning engineering projects from design through deployment.

You'll become an expert in how customers use Numeral and use those insights to make the product better every week.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys both solving technical problems with customers and writing production code.

What you'll do

• Partner with Sales and Customer Success on technical customer conversations, implementations, and onboarding.

• Debug customer issues across APIs, integrations, and production systems.

• Design and build product features, internal tooling, and automations that improve both customer experience and engineering velocity.

• Own engineering projects end-to-end, from gathering requirements through implementation and deployment.

• Work directly with customers to understand complex workflows and translate them into product improvements.

• Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

• Help improve our APIs, integrations, developer experience, and operational tooling.

• Become a trusted technical advisor for some of our largest customers.

What you'll bring

• 2–5 years of software engineering experience.

• Strong programming skills in JavaScript/TypeScript (Node.js preferred), or experience in another backend language with a willingness to learn.

• Experience working with SQL databases such as PostgreSQL.

• Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication.

• Comfort working directly with customers and explaining technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Ownership mindset—you enjoy taking projects from idea to production.

• Startup mentality: comfortable with ambiguity and excited to wear multiple hats.

Even better

• Experience building APIs or backend services.

• Familiarity with AWS, Docker, Redis, or modern cloud infrastructure.

• Experience working with SaaS integrations or enterprise customers.

• Background in fintech, accounting, payments, or tax technology.

• Experience working in an early-stage startup.

What we offer

• Competitive salary and equity—you'll share directly in the company's success.

• Full medical, dental, and vision coverage.

• Wellness perks like Headspace and the Peloton One App.

• 401(k) to help you build long-term financial security.

• Lunch and snacks when you're in the office.

• Regular team offsites and company events as we grow.

• A culture built on ownership—your work matters, and people will see it.

Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra

About Truemeds

Truemeds is a technology-driven healthcare platform founded in 2019, on a mission to make quality medicines affordable and accessible across India. Its core philosophy, “Naam ki nahi, Kaam ki Medicine,” reflects its focus on helping customers save on medicine expenses through scientifically matched alternatives to branded medicines.

Truemeds at a Glance:

• 10M+ downloads on Google Play.
• Coverage across 21,000+ pincodes.
• 30 lakh+ doctor consultations facilitated.
• Backed by investors including Accel, Peak XV Partners, WestBridge Capital, and Info Edge Ventures.
• Raised $85 million in a Series C funding round in August 2025.

Explore Truemeds:

• Website: https://www.truemeds.in/
• Android App: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.intellihealth.truemeds
• iOS App: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/truemeds-medicine-health/id6742731113
• LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/truemeds-india/

Truemeds promotes a culture centred on ownership, innovation, agility, data-driven decision-making, and collaboration. Employees work across functions to solve business challenges and improve healthcare accessibility.

About the Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced performance marketing professional to drive customer acquisition and business growth across paid media channels. The role offers ownership of marketing budgets, channel strategy, creative experimentation, and campaign performance.

Role Overview

We're looking for a sharp, data-driven Performance Marketing Manager to own and scale paid marketing initiatives across media channels and emerging platforms. The role involves managing budgets, optimizing acquisition costs, driving experimentation, and improving campaign efficiency while ensuring sustainable business growth.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of performance marketing, attribution, and unit economics, with the ability to translate data into actionable strategies that drive customer acquisition, retention, and lifetime value.

What You'll Do

1. Channel Ownership

• Plan, launch, manage, and scale campaigns across major media channels and emerging platforms.
• Test new channels, campaign types, and ad formats in a structured manner, scaling or discontinuing them based on performance.
• Own channel strategy, bidding, budgets, media planning, creative strategy, and key growth initiatives.

2. Budgets and Unit Economics

• Own monthly and quarterly marketing budgets, allocating spend across channels to achieve CAC, ROAS, and payback targets.
• Forecast campaign spend and outcomes, and track weekly budget pacing against planned targets.
• Optimize campaigns for downstream business outcomes, including first orders, quality users, repeat orders, retention, and customer lifetime value, rather than focusing solely on top-of-funnel metrics.

3. Measurement and Analytics

• Work with Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs) such as AppsFlyer and Singular, GA4, and internal data systems to ensure accurate attribution and event tracking.
• Build and maintain dashboards and regular reports covering channel, campaign, and cohort performance.
• Design and execute incrementality, holdout, and A/B tests to distinguish actual campaign impact from attributed performance.
• Account for reporting delays and attribution limitations when evaluating campaign effectiveness and making optimization decisions.

4. Creative Strategy and Funnel Optimization

• Brief, test, and iterate on ad creatives in collaboration with design and content teams, using performance insights to guide creative development.
• Develop and share creative performance reports with stakeholders, identifying what works, what doesn't, and opportunities for improvement.
• Establish creative playbooks based on performance trends, audience insights, and experimentation outcomes.
• Identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency and conversion across the customer acquisition funnel.

5. People, Partners, and Stakeholder Management

• Manage agency and platform partner relationships, setting clear performance expectations and ensuring accountability against business goals.
• Collaborate with creative, product, analytics, and technology teams to improve marketing effectiveness and overall business outcomes.
• Present performance results, key learnings, and growth plans to leadership through clear, data-driven recommendations.
• Ensure all advertising activities comply with platform policies and applicable healthcare advertising guidelines.

What You Bring

• 3–5 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing, managing paid media campaigns across multiple channels.
• Strong understanding of performance marketing metrics, including CAC, ROAS, payback period, retention, repeat orders, and LTV.
• Experience with Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs) such as AppsFlyer or Singular, along with a solid understanding of attribution fundamentals.
• Proficiency in GA4, Excel/Google Sheets, and performance reporting dashboards.
• Demonstrated ability to manage and scale marketing budgets while maintaining acquisition efficiency and business profitability.
• Experience in campaign experimentation, A/B testing, creative optimization, and performance analysis.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights.
• Experience managing agency partners and collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Good to Have

• Familiarity with SKAdNetwork (SKAN) and data-driven attribution methodologies.
• Experience using analytics tools such as Mixpanel.
• Prior agency experience in performance marketing.
• Experience in healthcare, e-commerce, or consumer-focused businesses.

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies — from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups — use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Stripe Marketing organization is undergoing a fundamental transformation in how it works. We're building a team of Forward Deployed AI Accelerators (FDAs) embedded directly with marketing cohorts to make AI the default mode for all work — not an occasional tool, but the foundation of how every marketer at Stripe executes.

Today, marketers are already achieving remarkable results — building their own data dashboards, creating agents that compress multi-day processes, and authoring tools that accelerate workflows. The FDA team exists to take what's working and systematically scale it across the entire marketing organization.

What you'll do

As a Forward Deployed AI Accelerator, you'll be embedded with a cohort of 25–45 marketers organized by functional team, shared workflow, or location. You'll build alongside them, and you'll help them fundamentally change how they operate. • Prepare marketers for an agentic future — not just prompt writing, but designing, building, and overseeing autonomous, multi-agent workflows

We're looking for people who have already lived the transformation they'll be driving for others. You've used AI to fundamentally change how work gets done, not as a novelty, but as your default operating mode.

• You are a deep AI practitioner. You build agents, automations, and tools fluently. You don't just know what AI can do in theory. You've built things that changed how real teams operate, and the people you built for actually use what you shipped. You build in real time alongside the people you support.
• You spot transformation opportunities and execute on them. You look at a team's workflows and see where AI changes the economics: where existing work can be done in a fraction of the time, or where entirely new programs become viable that weren't worth doing before. Then you build the thing, not just the slide.
• You understand marketing work. You either have direct experience in marketing or quickly learn the workflows, deliverables, tools, and pressures of your assigned cohort. You know that understanding someone's work is a prerequisite to transforming it.
• You are a pattern recognizer. When you build something that works for one person, you immediately see how it applies to others. You think in systems, not one-off solutions.

• You are high-caliber, persistent, and versatile. Your skills and experience are valuable across the company. You're the kind of person who succeeds in many roles at Stripe.
• You bias toward action and speed. You'd rather show someone a working proof-of-concept on their own deliverable today than present a polished deck about what's theoretically possible next quarter.
• You are comfortable with ambiguity and evolution. This is a new team building a new operating model. The playbook will be rewritten as we learn. You thrive in that environment.

The job

Responsible for growing Homes’ membership. This role will directly drive most of the company’s revenue growth for the next few years.

The ideal candidate is customer-obsessed, ambitious, and loves solving complex problems. To be successful, you’ll need to be a high-agency, regularly flexing between being a leader, builder, recruiter, planner, individual contributor, and manager. Former founders, growth engineers, consultants, or bizops leaders would thrive in this role. The scope of this role is intentionally broad to allow for unfettered exploration of impactful work and flexibility in adjusting scope and focus at any time to maximally drive growth. You’ll span across online performance marketing, offline marketing, organic and referral marketing, supply and market expansion decisions, pricing and packaging, sales, strategic planning, and more.

Honey Homes’ mission is to replace the hassle of home upkeep with comfort and joy. This is a hard problem, but a valuable one to tackle. Our work is a complex and intensive journey spanning software, AI, human labor, and consumer preferences. Getting it right unlocks tremendous value for homeowners, and creates thousands of American jobs. We’re a small and mighty team who enjoy working together, backed by top-tier investors.

This role reports to the CEO and sits on the Senior Leadership Team. You’ll partner closely with the entire company, including Product Marketing, Sales, Product and Engineering, Ops, and the Board.

Outcomes and Competencies

•
Outcomes

•
Drive a 3x+ increase in new members by:

•
Growing awareness of Honey Homes in current and future service areas

•
Growing paid channels and launching new paid channels within target cost metrics

•
Growing and launching organic, referral, and local channels within target cost metrics

•
Informed by up- & down-funnel metrics, improving conversion from website visitor through membership.

•
Finding and removing constraints. Determine what’s limiting growth at any given moment (e.g. demand, lead quality, conversion, market capacity, sales capacity, or something else) and solve it with the team.

•
Driving expansion of service areas into new new metros, in partnership with operations

•
Iterating on pricing and packaging to maximize growth and LTV

•
Accelerating yourself and your team with AI. Create dashboards, tools, campaigns, automations and more with Claude and our proprietary integrations.

•
Become the company owner of acquisition economics by:

•
Creating a useful live model of CAC, marginal CAC, LTV, payback and cohort performance

•
Setting budgets to achieve growth goals that meet payback targets

•
Making capital allocation decisions to maximize growth and LTV

•
Build a high-performing team. Define, recruit, and hire to hit goals and deliver for our members.

•
Competencies

•
You solve problems from first principles. You’re excited to solve problems in innovative ways, and you resist “this is how it’s always been done” thinking. You find unique and as-yet unexploited ways to make make progress.

•
You’re a quantitative, full-funnel thinker. You naturally connect acquisition, qualification, conversion, retention, and LTV. CAC, payback, marginal CAC, cohorts, attribution, and forecasting are the language you use to run paid acquisition. You go deep in the data but know the point of analysis is to make better decisions. You are a data-first problem solver with excellent data analysis skills.

•
You have exceptional consumer and creative instincts. You understand that behind every conversion rate is a person making a decision. You’re curious about what makes customers act, hesitate, and trust. You pair that understanding with strong instincts around messaging, offers, positioning, and creative. You effectively work with creative partners to turn your insights into results.

•
You’re a team and company builder. You can envision what the future looks like, and it’s exhilarating to put together the parts to make that future a reality. You have hired great people in the past, and managed high-performing teams. You believe that hiring is a key part of any role, and you foster a culture of always-on recruiting. You effectively collaborate with partners across the company at all levels.

•
You use AI and technology to create leverage for yourself and your team. You use AI every day to make yourself and your team dramatically more effective. You build workflows and automations, accelerate analysis and research, increase creative velocity, and look for opportunities to personalize and experiment at a scale that wasn’t possible last year.

•
You lead like an owner. You prioritize relentlessly, create clarity across teams, and get people moving toward a shared outcome even if they don’t report to you. You care about Honey Homes’ growth, not just Marketing’s numbers, and make decisions based on what’s best for our members and the company.

•
You’re relentless. You do what it takes to win, no matter what

•
You energize others. Your attitude and leadership brings others with you on the journey every day. You create more leaders with the same zeal that you have.

We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.

Kiddom helps schools and districts deliver more equitable, effective, and adaptive learning experiences.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our Content Agents team, building intelligent systems that transform how educational content is created, managed, validated, and delivered at scale.

You’ll work at the intersection of frontend, backend, data, and AI, developing intuitive product experiences, scalable services, and AI-powered workflows that simplify complex content operations.

We’re looking for a versatile, AI-native engineer who is comfortable moving across technical domains, thrives in ambiguity, and takes ownership of problems from concept to production. You’ll help shape technical direction, challenge assumptions, and build solutions that are reliable, maintainable, and designed to evolve.

What You’ll Do

•
Build end-to-end solutions across frontend, backend, data, and AI systems, selecting the right technologies and approaches for the problem.

•
Develop intelligent workflows that streamline content creation, editing, quality assurance, and management at scale.

•
Integrate AI and LLM capabilities into production applications, balancing experimentation with reliability, safety, and performance.

•
Design scalable systems and data workflows that support complex content operations, collaboration, and data integrity.

•
Own projects from concept to production, including technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement.

•
Prototype and iterate rapidly, validating ideas through experimentation, user feedback, and measurable outcomes.

•

Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

About the Role

Most software engineers never see their code tested against reality. At Swarm Aero, that's the baseline.

We are looking for a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer to own multiple initiatives across our customer programs and lead the forward deployed engineers working on them. You will work directly with U.S. government and military customers to understand the mission, decide what our C2 and onboard autonomy software can deliver, and set the technical plan to get it into the field. You will make the feasibility calls, keep everyone involved working from the same plan, and make sure your initiatives are ready for the releases that put new capability in operators' hands.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will still write code, debug systems in the field, and be on site when the work goes live.

What You'll Do

•
Own multiple initiatives within a customer program, from early requirements through deployment. Turn mission needs into a technical roadmap for each one, and make the feasibility and tradeoff calls across them.

•
Lead the forward deployed engineers working on your initiatives by setting technical direction, breaking down the work, and clearing blockers.

•
Write and integrate C2 and onboard autonomy software for unmanned air and sea vehicles, and debug it in the field when something breaks.

•
Participate in and lead design reviews for your initiatives before work starts.

•
Run post-incident reviews after field issues, find the root cause, and put fixes in place so the same problem does not happen again.

•
Bring field data and lessons learned back to the core product team.

•
Work with partner teams to align on priorities and timelines, gather their feedback, and run internal testing before every deployment.

•
Plan how your initiatives fit into each contract release alongside core product work, and make sure they are tested and ready before the release ships.

•
Serve as the main technical contact for vehicle and sensor vendors, and lead the integration of their systems with ours.

•
Define success criteria with customers for each event, run the readiness review for your initiatives beforehand, and give the go/no-go recommendation.

•
Mentor forward deployed engineers and help with technical assessments of potential candidates.

•
Support deployments outside normal hours, including on-call response and rotational coverage aligned to mission tempo.

•
Travel domestically and internationally (up to 50%) to test sites and customer locations, and lead the team on site.

This Role Is For You If

•
You have shipped software to the field and want to own a bigger share of the outcome.

•
You like making technical calls under pressure and explaining them to people who need a straight answer.

•
You enjoy helping other engineers grow while staying hands-on yourself.

•
You can turn an ambiguous customer request into a plan a team can execute.

This Role Is NOT

•
A people management role away from the code

•
A program or project management role

•
A pilot position or vehicle operator role

•
Primarily hands-on hardware work (electronics, wiring, mechanical assembly)

Basic Qualifications

•
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field

•
7+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated ability

•
Experience leading a small team, feature crew, or sub-program through design and delivery

•
Experience building and deploying software for unmanned systems (UAS, USVs, or UUVs), including C2 or onboard autonomy

•
Experience working directly with government or military customers to turn mission needs into technical requirements

•
Experience supporting live exercises, test events, or field deployments

•
Experience shipping work as part of larger releases that combine contributions from several teams

•
Strong proficiency in at least one systems language (Golang, Rust, or C/C++)

•
Solid understanding of networking fundamentals: NAT, DNS/mDNS, UDP/TCP protocols, multicast, and firewall configuration

•
Experience with Linux system administration and shell scripting

•
Excellent communication skills for engaging with U.S. government and military customers, vendors, and internal engineering teams

•
Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% of the time, both domestically and internationally, including to remote or restricted-access locations

•
Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance

Preferred Qualifications

Active U.S. Secret security clearance or higher

•
Prior defense, intelligence community, or aerospace software experience, especially with the U.S. Navy

•
Experience integrating C2 or autonomy software onto third-party vehicles

•

Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure-as-code

•
Experience with robotics middleware (DDS/ROS2, ZeroMQ, gRPC) and Protobuf

•
Comfort operating in non-permissive or resource-constrained environments

About Abby Care: Powering the future of care at home for all of America.

Abby Care is building the leading AI-native platform for family-led care. America is facing a growing care crisis. Millions more people need care at home than ever. Over 50 million family caregivers support loved ones without the tools, training, or recognition they deserve.

We believe families are the largest untapped caregiving workforce in America, and that technology can help them deliver better care while driving stronger outcomes and greater transparency across the healthcare system.

Abby Care combines clinical oversight with an AI-powered platform to train, enable, and support family caregivers in delivering high-quality care at home. Our platform helps health plans and government partners better understand, verify, and improve care in the home. We expand access to care, reduce reliance on higher-cost settings, and help ensure public dollars are spent effectively.

We are proud to partner with leading health plans, providers, and community organizations and are backed by top VCs. We envision a future where family-led care is a core part of the healthcare system. Abby Care is building that future.

Join us in solving one of the most important challenges of our time.

The Opportunity:

Abby Care is at a significant inflection point, having recently raised our Series C, and backed by a robust team of investors to include Transformation Capital, CVS Ventures, Sequoia, Khosla and Thrive, we’re poised to reimagine how care is delivered at home - leveraging trust, transparency and quality. As the Chief of Staff, you’ll report into the CEO and work closely with the senior leadership team to drive high-impact strategic initiatives and operational rigor across the company. Astute, you understand how to navigate the business as a direct representative of your founder and CEO, and reflect that in your output and your interpersonal interactions. You move quickly when appropriate, but know when to pause and reflect, weighing implications and tradeoffs of business critical decisions. If you are excited about the opportunity to have a material, tangible impact on an organization that intends to define a new category of tech-enabled care, we’d love to hear from you.

This is an in-person role in San Francisco (4 days in office) and will require engagement on evenings and weekends as needed for the COS role.

6+ years of professional experience, ideally in management consulting, investment banking, or a similar analytical, high-accountability environment.

About Semgrep

Semgrep, the leader in code security for builders, empowers invention without friction. Teams catch, flag, and fix real issues before they ship, powered by security that learns as they build. Semgrep secures code as it’s written and provides guardrails that pave the road for developers to move fast and stay secure. Built for builders and trusted by security, Semgrep lives where developers work, delivering fixes without breaking flow, and giving security teams visibility, control, and confidence. Semgrep gets smarter as you build, with AI that learns your context to cut false positives and prioritize reachable vulnerabilities, validated by 95% of security reviewers across 6M+ findings. Semgrep makes zero false positives a reality with AppSec teams triaging 80% fewer false positives across Code and Supply Chain, dramatically shrinking the backlog.

Founded in San Francisco and backed by Menlo Ventures, Felicis Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and Sequoia Capital, Semgrep is recognized by Gartner in Application Security Testing and is trusted by leading organizations, including Vanta, Lyft, and Dropbox. Learn more at semgrep.dev.

About the Role

As a Sr. Sales Engineer at Semgrep, you’d be an integral part of a diverse team working to help developers everywhere build more secure applications. Your daily engagements with our customers would directly contribute to a more productive and durable development process that catches software vulnerabilities before they go live. You will be the technical expert working directly with our customers to understand their goals and challenges, integrate our products and services into their environments, and ensure we deliver the maximum value possible.

Prior experience in a fast-paced, tech environment is helpful, but we are more interested in your problem solving abilities than your pedigree. So if this opportunity excites you but you don’t meet the exact requirements, apply anyway!

•
Contribute to building a world-class solutions engineering organization by driving organization initiatives that help us refine and scale our workflows and processes.

You are ideal for this role if you have:

8+ years working with customers in a pre-sales, customer success, or customer/product support experience.

•
Experience communicating with executives and operating full sales cycles in large organizations.

•
A deep understanding of developer workflows and build systems, including CI / CD environments such as GitHub Actions, GitLab, Circle CI, Jenkins, and Buildkite.

Omnistrate helps software and AI companies deliver their products as enterprise-grade, fully managed services across public clouds, private clouds, and customer VPCs—without the complexity of building and operating the underlying infrastructure themselves.

Our vision: We help modern software and AI companies deliver their products across public cloud, private cloud, customer VPCs, and increasingly complex enterprise environments without having to build and maintain the underlying deployment and operations infrastructure themselves.

Founded by Kamal Gupta and Alok Nikhil, who previously built and led large-scale cloud infrastructure, Omnistrate was born from firsthand experience with the challenges of deploying and operating software in customer-controlled environments. Our mission is to help the next generation of software and AI companies build the next MongoDB Atlas, Snowflake, and Databricks by handling the infrastructure complexity behind the scenes.

We're a small, highly technical team entering our next stage of growth, where every hire has a meaningful impact on the company's trajectory. Joining Omnistrate means working directly with the founders and sales leadership to shape our positioning, identify the strongest markets, and build a repeatable enterprise go-to-market motion from the ground up.

You'll work closely with the Head of Marketing, Content, Product Marketing and Sales to translate marketing initiatives into measurable business outcomes — generating qualified leads, increasing engagement with our target audience and contributing to the sales pipeline.

Landing Page Development:

Build and maintain high-performance landing pages and forms via Hubspot, prioritizing fast load times, strong CTAs, and mobile optimization.

Copywriting & A/B Testing:

Develop compelling ad copy, social captions, and landing page variants. Continuously test and refine two to three versions to drive improved conversions in partnership with content marketing.

Work with the Sales team to refine offers, improve meeting quality, and tighten follow-up processes for marketing-sourced leads.

Prior experience running multi-channel marketing campaigns and coordinating campaigns for events/webinars

Strong communication and coordination skills, especially in remote and cross-time-zone environments

Proven ability to work in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and get things done

Familiarity with developer-focused marketing and technical buyer personas.

Experience with SEO, organic growth and content-led demand generation.

Days 31–60 – Execute & Optimize

d.description:
Asana is looking for a Head of Content Design to lead and grow our content design practice across the company. You'll manage a team of content designers working across our portfolio of products: Agentic Work Management, Service Management, Client Management, and Command. You'll set the standard for how Asana speaks to customers on every surface, from a settings page to a conversation with an AI Teammate. In this player-coach role, you'll lead the practice, develop senior practitioners, and take on some of the highest-stakes writing projects yourself while collaborating with the Asana Design leadership team to shape both what we make and how we make it.

We design the future of teamwork. Asana has a bold, ambitious mission: help humanity thrive by enabling the world's teams to work together effortlessly. Our design team is at the heart of that mission.

Asana Design is an inclusive and collaborative community. We're a diverse group of designers from different backgrounds (product, brand and content design, design operations, producers, motion design, film, copywriting). We are a team that loves combining research, data insights, and peer feedback into a human-centred design process to produce designs that are core to the power of our applications. We partner with people across Asana to create our product, shape our brand, and drive greater impact through design. We use design to solve challenges and create experiences that customers love. We also take the time to get weird and have fun along the way.

We believe every designer should have the opportunity to grow and learn by utilizing their strengths and nurturing their interests.

This role is based in our Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

• Lead, coach, and grow a team of content designers by setting clear expectations, developing their craft and careers, and building a team with a clear mission and measurable outcomes.
• Own the end-to-end quality of content across Asana's portfolio of products, including Agentic Work Management, Service Management, Client Management, and Command.
• Define and evolve Asana’s product voice, terminology, and content standards, building scalable systems—such as guidelines, patterns, design-system content, and tooling—that empower every product team.
• Establish Asana’s AI voice by defining the voice and tone for AI Teammates and agents, developing conversation design patterns, and distilling characteristics that make humans and agents feel like one team.
• Partner with Design, Product Management, Engineering, Research, and Product Marketing leaders to integrate content strategy into roadmap decisions and make content design a visible, measurable part of how Asana ships.
• Collaborate with Marketing and Brand Creative to ensure a cohesive voice and tone across the entire customer journey.
• Lead high-impact content design initiatives, including flagship launches, AI and conversational experiences, cross-product naming, and information architecture.
• Partner with Research and Data Science to validate content decisions through experiments and user studies, advocating for content improvements backed by evidence.
• Shape how the broader Asana Design organization operates as a member of its leadership team, including evolving design and content workflows alongside AI-assisted product development.

About you

• Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making
• 10+ years of experience designing content for digital products, including 4+ years managing content designers or UX writers and developing senior and lead-level practitioners.
• Proven track record of running a day-to-day content design practice—setting priorities across multiple teams, driving consistency, shipping products, and advocating for content design best practices cross-functionally.
• Demonstrated ability to build influence with Product, Engineering, and Marketing leaders so content design is embedded early in decision-making rather than treated as a final review step.
• Hands-on expertise in UX writing and content strategy for web and mobile products, covering microcopy, nomenclature, information architecture, accessibility, user education, and launch content.
• Experience designing content for conversational or AI-powered experiences, paired with a clear point of view on how products should communicate when systems generate language.
• Experience creating, governing, and scaling voice and tone guidelines and content systems—including AI content tooling—that cross-functional teams actively adopt.
• Proficiency in leveraging both quantitative and qualitative research to inform, make, and defend content decisions.
• Clear, persuasive written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to executives and cross-functional leadership.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we’ll offer

Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.
