d.description:
About the Team

We are a small and fast-moving B2B partnerships team that shapes and executes OpenAI’s most important collaborations. We work across the B2B ecosystem, including software vendors, technology platforms, and services partners, to help them bring useful AI offerings to market and reach more business customers. Working closely with Sales, Product, and partner programs, we build channels and repeatable go-to-market approaches that expand customer choice and adoption of OpenAI’s models and products.

About the Role

As a B2B Ecosystem Partnerships Lead focused on Partner Growth, you will own the onboarding, activation, and growth of a partner portfolio across OpenAI’s expanding ecosystem programs, including marketplace and Sign in with ChatGPT. This is a hands-on individual contributor role centered on partner management, joint go-to-market execution, and commercial growth. Your portfolio may span ISVs, technology platforms,, and other B2B partners as opportunities evolve. You bring a generalist’s range across relationships, business analysis, deal execution, and operational problem solving. You will build repeatable ways to support a growing partner base and take on selected strategic partnerships.

In this role, you will:

•
Identify and recruit partners across B2B segments for ecosystem programs and joint go-to-market opportunities, prioritizing customer needs, product fit, commercial potential, and readiness to participate and grow.

•
Own day-to-day relationships across your partner portfolio, tailoring engagement to partner needs and opportunity while using repeatable approaches to support a growing partner base.

•
Develop practical business and account plans with partners and Sales, with clear use cases, target customers, owners, milestones, and adoption and commercial goals.

•
Negotiate product and commercial agreements with Legal, Finance, and Product, and lead selected high-touch strategic opportunities in coordination with other partnership owners.

•
Guide partners through program onboarding, technical evaluation, integration, and activation; coordinate enablement and resolve barriers to launch, sustained usage, and expansion.

•
Execute co-selling, joint marketing, and marketplace opportunities with account teams; coordinate with cloud and other ecosystem partners where they help customers buy and deploy solutions.

•
Run regular partner reviews, identify inactive or stalled partners, and execute growth plans that improve participation, product adoption, customer demand, and relationship health.

•
Track onboarding completion, time to activation, active partners, product usage, pipeline contribution, and commercial results with Sales and Operations; use the data to focus effort.

•
Improve onboarding materials, enablement, and partner engagement practices with program and product teams; turn recurring partner issues into fixes that help the broader ecosystem scale.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

•
8+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, partner or account management, enterprise sales, or related commercial roles in technology.

•
Experience managing and growing a portfolio of B2B partners or accounts, with measurable results in onboarding, adoption, retention, or commercial expansion.

•
An understanding of B2B business models, partner channels, and how companies bring products and services to market. Experience with ISVs, technology platforms, services partners, or cloud marketplaces is a plus.

•
Strong business judgment and analytical skills: you can assess partner economics, prioritize a portfolio, and build repeatable processes that help more partners succeed.

•
Ability to work across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Legal, and Finance, build trust with partner teams, and drive progress without formal authority.

•
A generalist mindset, curiosity about AI, and the ability to learn new products and markets quickly. You can discuss integrations with technical teams and connect capabilities to customer value.

•
Clear communication, sound negotiation skills, and reliable follow-through. You are comfortable balancing relationship building, structured planning, and hands-on problem solving in a changing environment.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

d.description:
About Krea

At Krea, we are building next-generation AI creative tools.

We're dedicated to making AI intuitive and controllable for creatives - our mission is to build tools that empower human creativity, not replace it. We believe AI is a new medium that allows us to express ourselves through various formats - text, images, video, sound, and even 3D. We're building better, smarter, and more controllable tools to harness this medium. We recently took this a step forward with the launch of Krea 2, our first foundation model, built completely from scratch for aesthetic diversity and stylistic control, and with Krea 3 - our new image editing model which recently landed at #4 on every benchmarking arena, only behind ChatGPT 2.5 models and above all Google models.

We've raised over $83M and are backed by world-class investors such as a16z, Bain Capital, and Abstract. We work full-time and in-person at our waterfront office in San Francisco. We care about creativity: our team includes musicians, designers, visual artists, and engineers.

This role

We’re looking for a Partnerships Lead to own our relationships with the companies building the world’s leading AI models, including frontier labs, major tech platforms and emerging research teams in image, video, 3D and audio. You’ll bring these models into our product, often on or before launch day. You’ll negotiate the commercial terms behind them, and you’ll turn each partnership into a launch our community cares about.

The role sits at the intersection of product, partnerships, and creativity. You’ll identify and close strategic partnerships, stay deeply informed about the creative AI ecosystem, and drive partnerships from idea to implementation to launch. You’ll own a portfolio of partners end to end, working closely with leadership on priorities while running the day-to-day independently. This role requires strong product instincts, a real understanding of how generative models are built and served and the ability to manage technically complex partnerships.

What you'll do

•
Build and own partnerships with model providers and AI labs, securing early access, launch-day availability, and co-marketing for new image, video and multimodal models

•
Negotiate commercial terms with model partners, including API pricing, volume commitments, revenue share, rate limits, exclusivity windows and SLAs

•
Track release roadmaps across the model ecosystem so we know what’s coming before it ships, and bring clear recommendations to leadership on which partnerships to pursue and why

•
Plan joint launches with partners: timing, narrative, assets and announcements, working with product, growth and creative

•
Lead negotiations with GPU and cloud providers, managing credits, capacity, pricing, and SLAs

•
Work with finance so model and infrastructure deals match budget, usage and margin

•
Act as the internal owner and long-term relationship holder for each partner, and keep relationships strong across multiple launches

What we're looking for

•
5+ years in partnerships or a related role, with a track record of closing and launching deals

•
Experience working with AI model providers, foundation model labs or major tech platforms, ideally on API or model distribution deals

•
Experience negotiating technical, usage-based agreements (API pricing, capacity, credits, SLAs)

•
Familiarity with generative media, creative tools or the creative AI ecosystem, and a point of view on which models matter and why

•
Strong communication and negotiation skills

•
High ownership, autonomy, and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments

Nice to have

•
Experience at an early-stage or high-growth AI company

•
Existing relationships with GPU, cloud, or model providers

•
Prior experience at a creative tools or design software company

•
A technical background or working understanding of model training and inference

What we offer

•
Team: Work alongside a world-class team building the future of AI creative tooling

•
Impact: Significant scope and company-wide impact

•
Competitive compensation: generous salary & equity packages

•
Health & wellness: 100% health & 99% dental/vision insurance premiums covered for employees, health FSA accounts, & long-term disability coverage

•
Time off: Flexible PTO policy

•
Financial planning: 401k with a 4% company-sponsored match

•
Meals in the office: breakfast, lunch, dinner - you name it, we'll cover it

•
Transit: Ubers covered to & from the office

•
Sponsorship: We're open to sponsoring international visas where we can (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H-1B, O-1, E-3).

•
And more!

Please note the above benefits & perks are for full-time employees

d.description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the Role:

Skydio is looking for seasoned Highway Safety & Transit sUAS professionals to join our team of Solutions Engineers. In this capacity you will support State Highway Patrol, State Police, Capitol Police, Department of Transportation, and other State entities across a territory. A successful candidate has direct experience with Highway Safety & Transit sUAS operations, loves to travel, has a strong understanding of traffic management and transit monitoring concepts of operation, and is detail oriented — able to conduct thorough discovery, capture the customer feedback that guides product development, and work cross-functionally to prepare Customer Success Plans. Exceptional candidates will also bring extensive product knowledge of commonly used highway safety and transit software, including CAD, VMS, and ITS platforms, and a working knowledge of API integrations.

This is a remote role. Travel of 50 to 75% is required to support customer engagements, field activities, deployments, team onsites, and company events.

About the Team:

The SLED Solutions Engineering team is the technical arm of Skydio's state and local go-to-market motion. We sit between the agency and the product: turning operational problems into program designs, proving capability in the field, and making sure Skydio's products are used, integrated, and flown at scale.

The team is measured on technical win rate, trial and proof of concept outcomes, program expansion, site assessment quality, and the requirements we push back into the product organization.

Solutions Engineers are critical members of the Skydio organization and work closely with Key Account Leaders, Engineering, and Product to support deal progression, customer confidence, successful deployments, and the long-term success of Highway Safety & Transit sUAS programs.

How You’ll Make an Impact:

•
Collaborate with State Highway Patrol, State Police, Capitol Police, Department of Transportation, and other State entities to understand their needs and develop tailored drone solutions as a trusted expert and an integral member of the account team.

•
Conduct product demonstrations and ensure the smooth integration of technology into customer agency operations and existing data management systems, including CAD and dispatch, video management, evidence management, and streaming platforms.

•
Own site assessment quality in your territory. Solutions Engineers are the DRI for verifying a dock location before deployment, and the quality of the resulting installation reflects on the team.

•
Run proofs of concept to a standard: structured deployments tied to an active opportunity with measurable operational value, not casual evaluations.

•
Support the airspace path your programs need, including BVLOS approvals, waivers, COAs, and remote and docked operations.

•
Gather and analyze customer feedback to inform product improvements, and work closely with cross-functional teams to support the development and execution of customer projects, including Customer Success Plans.

What Makes You a Good Fit:

•
Strong understanding of drone technology, Highway Safety & Transit sUAS operations, and regulatory compliance.

•
Familiarity with Drone as First Responder concepts of operation and dock based remote operations. Professional experience is strongly preferred.

•
Working knowledge of highway safety and transit software platforms, including CAD, VMS, and ITS, and of API integrations.

•
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically in high-pressure situations.

•
Exceptional written and verbal communication. You can brief an operator, a program manager, and a chief or a city council without changing the facts.

•
Comfort operating inside a Sales organization, including the judgment to know when to commit technical time and when to decline.

Nice to Have:

•
Prior service with State Highway Patrol, State Police, Capitol Police, Department of Transportation, or as an agency sUAS program lead.

•
Experience standing up a Drone as First Responder program from waiver through go-live, and with dock-based, remote, and BVLOS operations at scale.

•
Familiarity with grant funding pathways and cooperative purchasing vehicles used by state and local agencies.

•
Working knowledge of Salesforce, Palantir, Databricks, or equivalents.

What Is Required:

•
Active FAA Part 107 Certificate.

•
Ability to travel 50 to 75% of the time.

•
Ability to lift up to 60 lbs unaided.

Compensation: At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual salary range for this position is $150,000 - $225,000*. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company's success. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. d.description:
CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

﻿Role overview

Our creative team produces hundreds of video ads, images and ad copy variations every month, and we test them across our campaigns to find out what works best. Behind all of that is a fast-moving pipeline, and we’re looking for a Creative Marketing Project Coordinator to keep it running smoothly.

You’ll be working with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers. You’ll turn ideas and requests into clear tasks, keep everyone aligned on deadlines, review the final work before it goes live, and make sure every asset gets launched and tested. Many of our workflows are already automated, and we’d love someone who enjoys finding smarter ways to work as we grow.

If you love bringing order to a busy environment, have a sharp eye for detail and are curious about the creative side of marketing, this role is a great place to grow. You’ll also be invited to brainstorming sessions and can contribute your own ideas to the creative process.

Responsibilities

Task & Pipeline Management

• Turn monthly creative requests (videos, images and ad copy) into clear, well-structured tasks in ClickUp (our project management system).
• Add briefs, guidelines and references to each task, and assign it to the right team member
• Agree on deadlines with each team and track every task from request to launch
• Keep an accurate record of all creative tests and their status at every stage

Cross-Team Coordination & Follow-Up

• Communicate daily with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers
• Follow up proactively so deadlines are met and nothing stalls in the pipeline
• Flag delays and bottlenecks early and help resolve them
• Release approved assets to media buyers and confirm they have been received, launched and reviewed

Quality Control

• Review final images, videos and ad copy before launch against briefs, client guidelines and technical specifications
• Catch typos, formatting errors and visual glitches before assets go live
• Develop an eye for visual inconsistencies, such as AI-generated artifacts, distorted details or elements that don’t make sense in context
• Collaborate with team members on final reviews and approvals

Reporting & Documentation

• Maintain structured logs of what is live, what is in testing and what has been learned
• Prepare clear status updates and reports using automated data and AI tools
• Document all tasks clearly in ClickUp per team standards

Process Improvement & AI

• Identify repetitive work and use AI tools and automations to streamline the workflow
• Help scale the pipeline to handle 100–350 tasks per month without losing accuracy
• Suggest improvements to task structure, templates and handoff processes

Creative Collaboration

• Take part in team brainstorming sessions and contribute ideas
• Turn raw concepts from brainstorms into structured, actionable tasks
• Build an understanding of our creative work and what performs well, with room to grow into the creative side over time

Must-Have Skills

• Proven ability to manage a high volume of tasks with strict deadlines and accurate tracking
• Ability to turn requests and ideas into clear, structured tasks
• Confidence in following up with many people across teams while keeping things friendly
• Sharp eye for detail when reviewing images, videos and ad copy
• Genuine interest in creative marketing and ad content

Technical Skills

• 2+ years of experience in operations, project coordination or process management
• Hands-on experience with project management tools such as ClickUp, monday.com, Asana or Trello
• Practical experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) to streamline work

[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot, based on 60,000 reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here).

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, and 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

Join us as Head of Marketing – Central Europe on a 12-month fixed-term contract to make Qonto the first business banking and finance management platform that freelancers, start-ups and SMEs think of in Germany and Austria. You will own a double-digit million euro budget and act as the right hand of Malte, our Regional Director Central Europe.

➡️ What you’ll do

•
Turn business goals into one marketing plan: Translate the Regional Director’s objectives for Germany and Austria into a marketing strategy with clear targets that you can deliver within your 12 months.

•
Own the budget: Plan, forecast and shift a double-digit million euro budget across channels, towards what proves its return.

•
Build and lead the regional team: Lead and develop a team of 10+ people across Marketing 360°, PR, Social Media and Events/Community.

•
Plug into central teams: Work with Product Marketing, CRM and Website to adapt their expertise to the German and Austrian markets, instead of rebuilding it locally.

•
Win your core segments: Position Qonto as the top-of-mind choice for freelancers, start-ups and SMEs, each with a different message and channel mix.

➡️ What we’re looking for

•
B2B marketing with B2C reflexes: You have built and run full marketing strategies in B2B, using consumer-style methods such as brand, performance and lifecycle. Experience in a regulated industry is a plus.

•
Multi-disciplinary team leadership: You have led teams of different specialists (brand, PR, social, events) and can speak each specialty’s language. You get results from people who don’t report to you.

•
German and Austrian market knowledge: You understand how German and Austrian businesses buy and bank. You are fluent in German and English, because you will work in both every day.

•
Budget and commercial results: You have managed significant marketing budgets and can show the business results they produced.

•
Stakeholder alignment: You have aligned several departments around one goal. You can build a plan in your first weeks and show measurable impact before the contract ends. We value transferable mental models. A background in fintech is a plus, but you don’t need one if you learn fast and care about what we do.

➡️ What we can offer you

•
Real budget ownership: You will manage a double-digit million euro budget across two markets and several channels. You will make the allocation decisions yourself.

•
A direct line to the Regional Director: You will work as their right hand on marketing and see how Qonto plans its growth in Central Europe.

•
A defined 12-month mission: Clear goals for the contract, agreed upfront. You will know what success looks like from day one.

•
A multi-disciplinary team: Specialists across brand, PR, social and events, brought together under one strategy.

•
Central expertise you can use: Product Marketing, CRM and Website teams are already in place, so you spend your 12 months adapting and executing, not setting up the foundations.

➡️ Your future manager

Malte brings extensive experience in scaling teams in the German market and has built collaborative relationships across sales, marketing and partnerships. As your manager, he’ll provide strategic guidance on market penetration while giving you full ownership of the marketing plan, the budget and the regional team across Germany and Austria. Malte values entrepreneurial thinking and results-driven leadership, and he has a track record of backing leaders who take ownership and drive growth through innovative marketing strategies.

[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.

[HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here

[DATA RETENTION] By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.

🔒 Your security matters to us

Recruitment scams are on the rise. Qonto will never work with third-party platforms or agencies that request payment from candidates. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Qonto, please report it to support@qonto.com.

d.description:
Certa (certa.ai) is an AI-native third-party risk management platform that unifies the full third-party lifecycle, from onboarding through continuous monitoring and offboarding. Enterprises from the Fortune 500 to fast-growing startups use our no-code platform to manage vendors, suppliers, and partners across risk, compliance, and ESG. Trusted by Honeywell, Uber, MARS, and Boeing, we've processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries.

As a Solutions Engineer in our Professional Services team, you'll play a critical role in the successful integration and customization of Certa for our clients. You'll configure the platform to meet each client's unique requirements and business use cases, and you'll be heavily involved in building the API integrations that enable seamless data flow between Certa and client systems.

What You'll Do

•
Analyze requirements & design solutions: Work with sales and client-facing teams to understand client needs, business use cases, and requirements, and take part in solution design discussions with insights grounded in both the technology and the business domain.

•
Configure the platform: Configure and customize Certa to match client needs, including setting up workflows, defining data structures, and enabling specific features and functionality.

•
Build integrations: Work closely with engineering to design, implement, and manage API integrations with external systems, ensuring smooth data exchange and interoperability.

•
Build with AI: Use Certa's AI build tooling to speed up configuration, then review, refine, and own the quality of the final output.

•
Test, troubleshoot & document: Run thorough unit testing of configurations and integrations, resolve configuration issues that come up during implementation, and maintain detailed documentation of configurations, customizations, and integration processes for the team and for clients.

•
Support clients & collaborate: Guide clients through onboarding and post-implementation, support product launches with technical help and training, work with customer support on complex issues, collaborate across product, engineering, marketing, and sales, and stay current on features and best practices to keep improving the process.

What You'll Need

•
Experience: A proven track record of implementation excellence for medium-to-large enterprise customers; bachelor's degree required, preferably in Engineering or equivalent.

•
Technical skills: Proficiency in API integration and a solid understanding of RESTful APIs and web services, plus technical expertise in relevant programming languages and platforms.

•
AI fluency: Comfortable using AI tools in daily work and able to judge when AI output is right and when it needs fixing.

•
Analytical skills: Able to grasp complex business use cases and translate them into technical solutions, and to create structure and design effective processes in ambiguous situations.

•
Communication: Exceptional communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills to work with clients, understand their requirements, and explain technical concepts clearly and concisely.

•
Mindset: Results-oriented and curious, an independent operator who takes limited direction and still lands the right action, and able to influence internal and external partners to drive priorities and outcomes.

•
Good to have: Hands-on experience with ERP integrations, JSON, and SaaS products, and with process documentation and requirements tools like Miro or Visio.

Compensation and Benefits

•
Compensation: Top of market salary + bonuses and equity

•
Time off: 49 days paid time off

•
Benefits: PTO, full benefits, retirement and wellness plans

•
Growth: Professional development support, remote workspace setup bonus

•
Team building: Annual company offsites in exciting locations around the world

Location

Certa is a remote-first company and we hire globally. We believe strongly in each team member working from the location that they choose. Should Certers wish to meet and work in person, they have 3 lively office locations they can travel to:

•
London

•
San Francisco

•
Jaipur

The perfect place for Certers to collaborate, co-work, and have face-to-face meetings.

Why Certa

•
Category leadership. Certa was named a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Third-Party Risk Management Tools - recognition that we're defining the category, not following it.

•
Industry recognition. We've been honored across the analyst and awards landscape, including Top Tech and Customer Value distinctions in The Hackett Group's 2026 Risk Management SolutionMap, the ProcureTech100 (Advanced AI and Risk Management categories), and Best Overall eProcurement Software in the FinTech Breakthrough Awards.

•
A top place to work. Certa was named one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers in the US. We're a fast-growing company where you'll wear many hats, ship quickly, and shape decisions that matter.

•
Real scale with strong backing. We've processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries. We're well-funded by leading investors including Fin Capital, Vertex Ventures, and Point72 Ventures, on the back of an oversubscribed Series B, headed towards Series C.

We're excited to meet you!

Certa celebrates difference. We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer, and all qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

d.description:
Commodity Managers work with Engineering teams to make sure Google has the supplies and equipment to put into production the innovative products coming from our Engineering teams. As a Commodity Manager, you use your wide industry knowledge and strategic supplier relationships to optimize our total cost of ownership for our global -- and growing -- infrastructure. The scale at which Google operates means that savings on just one piece of hardware can have a huge impact on Google's bottom line.

As an Advanced Silicon Sourcing and Strategic Partnerships Manager, you will be part of the team directly defining the forward-scanning commercial pillar of Google’s Silicon Sourcing Center of Excellence (SSCE).

In this role, you will lead engineering-specific initiatives and serve as the domain technology and commercial architect for Advanced Packaging (2.5D/3DIC), Optical I/O, and Chip-to-Rack Thermal Technologies within SCoE’s Advanced Silicon Sourcing and Strategic Investments pillar. Your primary mandate is to de-risk multi-generational hardware bottlenecks 3–5 years ahead of High-Volume Manufacturing (HVM) by leading upstream technology sourcing, ecosystem development, and strategic partnerships.

You will collaborate closely with custom silicon architects and platform hardware engineers to structure and drive proof-of-concept (PoC) engagements, Statements of Work (SOWs), and Joint Development Agreements (JDAs) with emerging startups, Tier-1 foundries, Outsourced Assembly and Test (OSATs), and Research and Development (R&D) institutes. Through these partnerships, you will validate disruptive packaging, optical, and thermal technologies using engineering and manufacturing silicon test vehicles.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next-generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $188000 - $274000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

d.description:
At Google, research-focused Software Engineers are embedded throughout the company, allowing them to setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly. Ideas may come from internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.
From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, engineers work on real-world problems including artificial intelligence, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more. But you stay connected to your research roots as an active contributor to the wider research community by partnering with universities and publishing papers.
Deepmind Robotics’s mission is to solve AGI in the physical world. We’re a team of scientists, engineers, machine learning experts, and roboticists advancing the state of the art in embodied AI. Building robots that are useful alongside humans is one of the most difficult and important problems in the world today. Robotics infrastructure is a critical part of this mission, offering unique and exciting challenges.
We're looking for a research engineer to contribute to the future of robot learning. You will work closely with research scientists and engineers across DeepMind to develop the infrastructure that powers our robotics research. You will build dataset and training pipelines for model evaluation, and implement robot learning algorithms to accelerate research.
Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.
We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

d.description:
About Oper

Oper, a European Fintech company, is a leader in cloud-based digital mortgage software. We provide personalized journeys for borrowers and lenders. Oper's technology streamlines the mortgage application process, eliminates paperwork, and increases transparency.

The fastest growing part of our business is Herman, our AI agent for mortgage origination. Herman reads documents, checks them, and works a credit file the way an analyst would, inside the regulated workflow of a real bank. It runs on sovereign EU infrastructure, because our clients cannot send mortgage data anywhere else. Phase by phase, it automates more of the origination process: first employed borrowers, then the self-employed, and onward. This is not a chatbot bolted onto old software. It is agentic software doing real work in a regulated environment.

A passionate and engaging team of around 30 stellar Fintech operators works vigorously to transform European mortgages by enhancing efficiency and alleviating borrower anxiety. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Motive Ventures, we have raised EUR 14 million, placing Oper at the forefront of revolutionizing mortgages in Europe. Oper currently has offices in Zürich, Switzerland, and Antwerp, Belgium.

Now, we're looking for an AI Solutions Engineer to join our AI Squad and help shape the future of automated mortgages in Europe and beyond.

Your Mission

You'll join the AI Squad, the team building Herman. This is a hands-on, hybrid role spanning AI engineering, product management, and solutions architecture. You'll scope and build working AI prototypes, take them in front of real banks to pressure-test against live mortgage workflows, and work alongside the team to turn these into working Herman features. You own delivery end-to-end: from a rough use case to a shipped capability, communicating progress clearly the whole way. This is an applied role, not a research one. We want a builder who can both code and collaborate, who is comfortable in front of a client in the morning and deep in a codebase in the afternoon.

Tasks

What you'll do

• Scope and build working AI prototypes - LLMs, RAG, agentic automation, and integrations - that solve concrete origination problems.

• Engage directly with clients: run workshops, gather requirements, demo, and iteratively refine solutions against the real workflows of regulated banks.

• Define and manage AI use cases, structuring them functionally so they can scale beyond a single client.

• Work closely within your team to turn validated prototypes into production features.

• Own delivery timelines and communicate progress clearly to both clients and internal stakeholders.

Work AI-native

Building agentic software is the job, and we expect you to build the way you ship: AI-first.

• Write code AI-first: agents produce the bulk of your code under your direction, while you own the architecture, integrations, review, and quality. We measure your output in shipped value, not hand-typed lines.

• Build agentic workflows that do real work: scaffolding prototypes and integrations from a spec, generating and running tests, drafting evaluation harnesses, and reviewing diffs.

• Use modern AI tooling as the default way you build, configure, and debug, not as an occasional helper.

• Aim for a delivery cadence a non-AI-native engineer simply cannot match, and help us raise the bar on what an AI-native delivery function looks like at Oper.

Requirements

What you'll bring

• 4 to 6 years of experience in software development, with hands-on AI/LLM work.

• Strong with Python and modern AI tooling: LLMs, RAG, agent frameworks, orchestration, and evaluation.

• Able to structure projects functionally and own delivery end-to-end, from scoping to shipped feature.

• Comfortable being client-facing: running workshops, gathering requirements, and translating ambiguity into working software.

• Comfortable working with flexible and loosely defined requirements, bringing your own structure where needed.

• Genuinely AI-native: agents already write most of your code and you build agentic workflows to multiply your output. You can name the tools, the workflows, and the concrete recent projects where AI gave you real leverage.

• Excellent communication skills.

• Creative and analytical mindset.

• Ambition to learn, experiment, and grow while staying humble and open-minded.

• Fluency in English; additional languages (e.g. Dutch, German) are a plus.

• Experience in a relevant industry (financial services) and thriving in a scale-up environment are a plus.

This is an applied, client-facing, cross-functional role. We are not looking for researchers, "idea people," or internal-only engineers.

Location & Setup

• Belgium-based candidates: hybrid setup with 2 to 3 days per week in our Antwerp office

• Working in CET hours

• Reporting to the CTO

• Close collaboration with the AI Squad, Product, and client-facing teams

Benefits

As a fast-growing fintech, we're building a team where you can truly make an impact.

We offer:

• Competitive annual salary, depending on experience

• Employee stock options

• 25 vacation days per year + 1 paid mental health day

• Dynamic international team with 12 nationalities

• Supportive, inclusive, and collaborative culture

• Learning & Development budget with dedicated time for growth

• Structured onboarding with a dedicated mentor

• Travel budget to collaborate with teams in Antwerp

• Annual company-wide Team G2G in an inspiring location

• Extra-legal benefits depending on your location

• Full support with local administration

• Health insurance and pension scheme

• Flexible working hours

• All equipment needed to do your best work

The position is also open for freelancers.

d.description:
THE ROLE

You will be the CEO’s right hand in Brazil. You start at his side and end up running the Brazilian market yourself. You shadow Marius in the first customer meetings, then you lead with him in the room, then you run accounts alone. The role is built so that you outgrow it.

dehaze AI identifies chronic disease risks on already existing health data. Thanks to us, our customers, fully integrated health insurers, save ~10% of their yearly health budget. We have signed the first customers in Brazil and plan to grow 10x year over year. Brazil is our most important market today, and the person we hire here will define how dehaze wins it.

Your job is to sell. Health insurers, Unimeds and municipal health secretariats don’t buy from a deck. They buy from a person they trust, after months of in-person meetings, WhatsApp follow-ups and dinners. You are that person. You open the doors the CEO cannot open from Munich, you stay with every deal until it closes, and you turn what you learn in the field into the playbook for how dehaze sells in Brazil.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Your core focus is growing customers in Brazil.

•
Open doors: You research, prioritize and reach the right people at health insurers, Unimeds and municipal health secretariats. You identify the internal champions and get us into the room with the decision makers.

•
Lead the room: You are comfortable in front of C-level decision makers. In the first months you shadow Marius in every meeting. Then you lead with him in the room. Then you run the account alone.

•
Push deals over the line: Materials, proposals, follow-ups, contract reviews with legal counsel. You prepare every customer conversation, you own the follow-through, and you don’t let a deal drift.

•
Build trust over long cycles: Enterprise health deals take months. You stay with them: in-person visits, WhatsApp follow-ups, dinners, the small things done right over a long time. You build relationships fast and you keep them.

•
Be on the road: Our customers are spread across Brazil. You travel a lot, and you like it.

•
Be the CEO’s eyes and ears on the ground: You catch what he cannot catch from Munich. You translate not just language, but context. You bring problems early and with options, not late and without.

•
Grow into Country Manager Brazil: Over time you take over management scope: the team, the entity, the market.

WHO YOU ARE

•
2-4 years in a high-output environment. A top consulting firm (McKinsey, BCG, Bain or similar) or startup business development. Structured, analytical, strong academic record. The context matters less than the intensity and the trajectory.

•
A real seller, not only an analyst. You are comfortable leading meetings with C-level decision makers and pushing deals over the line. We will test this in the interview with a live customer role-play.

•
A relationship builder. You build trust over long enterprise cycles with health insurers, Unimeds and municipal health secretariats. You are comfortable cold-calling, comfortable being the youngest person in the room, and comfortable staying with a deal for months.

•
Hungry and independent. You don’t wait for instructions. You see a gap, you fill it. You want to move from shadowing to leading to running accounts alone as fast as you can prove you’re ready.

•
Mobile. You travel a lot and you are happy to.

•
Languages: Native-level Portuguese is non-negotiable. Fluent English is required. You will be the voice of dehaze with every customer, regulator and partner in Brazil.

NICE-TO-HAVES

•
Exposure to the health sector: insurers, Unimeds, hospitals, public health, healthtech

•
Experience selling to or working with the public sector in Brazil

•
Familiarity with ANS and LGPD obligations for health data

•
An existing network in the Brazilian healthtech ecosystem

WHY DEHAZE

•
Learn from the best: Work directly alongside serial healthtech entrepreneurs and one of Europe’s leading professors in medical AI. The founding team has built and exited 3 health startups and operated in hyperscaler environments. A shortcut to a decade of learning.

•
Technological frontier: Our proprietary AI builds on a novel architecture unlocking already existing health data. You’ll be at the forefront of technology that fundamentally changes how chronic diseases are identified.

•
Intense speed and impact: We plan to 10x our ARR in the first year. Not a platitude but the actual plan, with a pipeline to back it. You will carry a big part of it.

•
Global scope, real ownership: Technology and science are built in Germany. Our biggest market is Brazil. You drive the decisions that define how we win it.

•
Country-lead trajectory: Competitive salary plus equity participation (VSOP) reflecting the path to Country Manager Brazil. We want you to build this with us, not just work for us.

No cover letter templates. No generic applications. If you can’t articulate why this specific role at this specific company in 5 sentences, we’re probably not the right fit.

ABOUT DEHAZE

dehaze is building proprietary AI infrastructure to identify risks of chronic diseases earlier and more precisely on already existing health data. We save integrated health insurance companies 10% of their health spend and help patients live a healthier life.

Our proprietary technology works where others can’t: on unharmonized already existing health data. Founded by 3 serial entrepreneurs, we are backed by institutional investors and operate across Brazil, with expansion into the US and Europe planned.

About Pasito

Pasito is the AI native workspace for carriers, brokers, PEOs and employer groups. Backed by top tier VCs and accelerators such as Insight Partners, Y Combinator, and Google Ventures, Pasito is the next AI category-defining firm reimagining the roles of brokers, carriers, PEOs, HCMs, and GAs to deliver the benefits plans millions of Americans already rely on.

We sell through four channels: carriers, brokers, PEOs, and direct employers. Brokers are one of our biggest growth channels, and this role builds that channel's next layer.

The role

The Sales Manager, Broker Partnerships, leads Pasito's broker sales team and owns the team's annual quota. You'll manage a team of Account Executives and Business Development professionals, coach them to hit their numbers, and lead the team's coverage of broker firms ranked #11-100 nationally.

This is a full-time leadership role, not a player-coach seat: you carry no personal book and win through your team. You'll report to the VP of Sales and work closely with marketing, RevOps, and product.

What you'll do

Lead and develop the team

• Hire, onboard, and coach Broker AEs; run weekly 1:1s, pipeline reviews, and deal strategy sessions

• Set rep-level targets and activity standards; manage performance against them

• Build a repeatable broker sales motion: discovery, demo, proposal, and partnership launch

Own the number

• Own the broker team's annual quota and deliver an accurate weekly and quarterly forecast

• Keep pipeline coverage at 3x the quarterly target and the CRM clean and current

• Report team performance to leadership in the weekly GTM review

Own the territory strategy (brokers ranked 11–100)

• Set account strategy for 90 mid-market national and super-regional broker firms and assign them across the team

• Make sure the team maps each firm's org chart: benefits practice leaders, producers, account managers, and operations

• Act as executive sponsor on key meetings and late-stage deals; drive expansion across offices, practices, and employer groups

Shape the broker channel

• Bring broker feedback to product and marketing to shape roadmap, pricing, and enablement

• Partner with marketing on broker events, conferences, and campaigns

What you bring

• 5+ years of B2B SaaS or benefits-tech sales, with 3+ years managing quota-carrying reps

• A track record of hitting team quota, with numbers you can walk us through

• Experience selling to or through employee benefits brokers and consultants

• Working knowledge of the benefits ecosystem: carriers, brokers, employer groups, enrollment, and renewals

• Enterprise and partnership selling skills: multi-threading, long cycles, and multiple stakeholders

• Disciplined forecasting and pipeline management in a CRM (HubSpot preferred)

• A coach's mindset: you make reps better, not just close their deals

Nice to have

• Existing relationships with benefits practice leaders at top-100 broker firms

• Experience at a BenTech or InsurTech company

• Experience building a sales team or motion from an early stage

What’s In It For You

•
Meaningful ownership: Own revenue outcomes in a category-defining AI company

•
Real impact: Help modernize how benefits are sold, communicated, and delivered

•
Growth: Join at a pivotal stage and grow with the company as we scale distribution

•
Competitive compensation: Salary, commissions, meaningful equity, and full benefits: medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, life insurance, and PTO

•
Remote-first: Work from anywhere in the U.S. with a highly collaborative team

Equal Opportunity

Pasito is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe great teams are built through diversity of background, perspective, and experience, and we’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

•
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

•
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

•
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

•
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

•
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

•
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

•
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

•
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

•
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

•
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

•
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

•
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

•
Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

•
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for a senior B2B Growth Marketer to build and scale demand generation for ElevenLabs in India. This is a hands-on, in-country role focused on generating enterprise pipeline, growing our brand with technical buyers, and creating programs that become benchmarks for B2B marketing in AI.

Your work will shape how Indian businesses discover, evaluate, and adopt ElevenLabs. The goal is to build repeatable marketing engines that make ElevenLabs the top choice for every enterprise.

What you'll do

•
Build integrated B2B marketing campaigns end to end across India's priority industries from strategy and messaging through execution and measurement.

•
Localize and execute programs across ABM, content, events, webinars, partner/customer marketing, executive branding, product launches, and outbound - choosing the right channel for the problem rather than owning a single function.

•
Adapt global campaigns and messaging for the Indian market, and feed local insights (buyer behavior, competitive dynamics, regulatory context) back to the global team.

•
Partner closely with local sales and the global product marketing, growth, and design teams to keep messaging consistent and execute high-impact campaigns.

•
Own pipeline generation and campaign performance for the market, using data to measure results, run experiments, and continuously improve what works.

Requirements

•
5 to 7 years of experience at a high-growth technology company - you've built and scaled B2B demand generation programs that created measurable enterprise pipeline, and you know what moved the needle.

•
Ownership Pedigree: You have implemented growth and marketing projects from start to finish and held yourself accountable for the ROI.

•
Deep knowledge of the Indian market: its enterprise buyers, media landscape, and business culture, ideally with an existing network.

•
Work well without much process. This role spans multiple marketing functions and needs someone who sets priorities, spots opportunities, and moves quickly as our first marketer in the market.

Who We Are

4M Analytics is building the first Subsurface World Model: an AI platform that uses visual reasoning and large-scale data fusion to turn the undocumented world beneath our streets into one living, intelligent map. We make reliable utility data accessible to the construction industry, government agencies, and utility owners, and we are changing how infrastructure is understood and protected.

We are Series C, backed by Insight Partners, Viola, and F2, with 120 people across Tel Aviv and Austin, Texas. The problem is massive, the momentum is real, and we are moving fast.

The Opportunity

Joining the Utility Owners Business Unit means you are at the forefront of a mission-critical expansion. You will have a direct impact on how major utilities manage their subsurface risk, preventing catastrophic damage and saving lives. This role offers a unique career trajectory: as a foundational hire, you have the opportunity to grow into owning broader product areas, leading new segments, or shaping our entire AI-product strategy as the business scales.

Over the past several years, 4M built significant business around Departments of Transportation (DOTs) — we now serve 10-12 DOT customers, and we did it deliberately: hire someone close to the customer, learn the workflow cold, and build the product the market actually needed. We're now applying that same intentional playbook to a new frontier: the Utility Owners segment.

This is a hybrid, next-gen role, combining classic Product Management with hands-on AI Building. You'll spend your time close to utility owner customers, absorb their workflows and pain points first-hand, and turn what you learn directly into working software — prototyping with modern AI tools, validating with real customers, then handing proven concepts to engineering to take to production fast. You're the connective tissue between the market and the product, fluent in the language of both the customer and the developer.

This is a deliberate, foundational hire. You'll report directly to the VP Product, work hand in hand with Engineering, and have the mandate to define what winning the Utility Owners segment looks like.

What You'll Do

•
Live in the market. Run continuous discovery with Utility Owner customers — calls, site visits, workflow shadowing — to build a first-hand understanding of their pain points, workflows, and business drivers.

•
Find the patterns, the opportunity, and turn it into a product. Think like a founder to map the market landscape, identify where the biggest pain points and budget reside, and synthesize customer feedback into a scalable product roadmap and clear productization strategy.

•
Define the strategy for winning the segment. Own the "where to play / how to win" for Utility Owners — target sub-segments, positioning, and the wedge that gets us in — in close partnership with the CEO, Chief Growth Officer, and engineering leadership.

•
Build beautiful products, fast. Use AI-native tools (Claude,Cursor etc.) to go from idea to a working, demonstrable Alpha in days or even hours — and if the customer validates it, Engineering makes it production-viable.

•
Bridge market and engineering. Be the connective layer between customers and the engineering pod. Translate validated concepts into something engineering can take to production, and stay involved through the handoff.

•
Own the outcome, commercially. Define what success looks like for the segment in business terms — adoption, revenue, land-and-expand — and track progress against it, partnering with Growth on how we take it to market.

•
Master a regulated, technical domain fast. No utility expertise required, but you'll rapidly get fluent in civil infrastructure, damage-prevention, and the regulatory landscape well enough to be credible with customers.

What You Bring

•
Relevant educational background (BA/BS/BE/MBA). This could be in business, computer science, or even architecture/industrial engineering.

•
7+ years of experience spanning reputed management consulting and/or product management at a B2B SaaS, data, or AI-native company.

•
A genuine builder's mentality: you can independently design, prototype, and ship working software using modern AI tools. For example, you might have a portfolio showcasing a deployed web app built with AI. You understand what the AI is generating well enough to reason about it and correct it - this is required, not solely dependent on "vibe coding." Prior engineering experience or a technical degree is a strong plus, not a must.

•
Comfortable operating in a 0-to-1, forward-deployed capacity - shaping a brand-new product and market directly with executives and customers, without an existing playbook to lean on.

•
The "Strategic Builder" balance: We exceptionally value the intersection of strategic consulting instincts - the ability to decompose complex business problems - and the gritty, hands-on skills required to build the solution yourself.

•
Sharp, credible communicator who translates cleanly between customer needs and engineering, and who's comfortable working shoulder-to-shoulder with the CEO and Chief Growth Officer as well as in front of customers.

•
Flexibility to travel on-site to customers as needed, as well as to our Austin, TX offices.

﻿AI-First Mindset

﻿We're building an AI-first product culture, and we're looking for product builders who are genuinely excited about working this way. This role is for you if you use tools like Claude daily to prototype, iterate, and demo functioning software yourself.

Standout Attributes

•
Candidates who pair top-tier consultancy experience along with hands-on product experience are an exceptionally strong fit.

•
Your own side project, startup, or open-source work built substantially with AI tools — don't just tell us, show us!

•
Prior exposure to utility infrastructure, civil/damage-prevention work, or the regulatory landscape (permitting, compliance, fines, risk on infrastructure projects).

•
Own complex integrations. Enterprise APIs, utility GIS, national field-technology platforms, and the ticketing networks the industry runs on. Expect undocumented behavior, legacy systems, and messy data.

Turn field learning into a product. Understand the difference between a one-off request and a reusable platform capability. Partner with core engineering so field wins become a scalable product.

•
Lead. Set your own priorities, manage your time, and make architecture calls without a finished spec. As the product scales, you’ll also mentor engineers as the US team grows.

•
Be an integral part of the R&D organization. Our engineering center is in Israel. You'll keep it close across time zones - clear updates, tight collaboration, and shared standards.

•
Fluency with AI coding, agentic flows, and modern development practices to move faster.

•
Experience with IoT, mobile, or field hardware.

•
Experience with utility, energy, transportation, AEC, or industrial software.

Location and Travel

We prefer candidates open to hybrid, 3 days a week in our Austin, TX offices. We will also consider fully remote candidates based in the US who are open to regular travel to our Austin, TX offices.

Expect regular travel to customer and field sites, plus several trips a year to our R&D center in Israel.

﻿

Come work with us!

Ready to build the future of subsurface infrastructure? We encourage you to apply even if you don't check every single box above. We are looking for potential, curiosity, and a bias for action above all else. We look forward to meeting you!

• A track record of signing restaurants yourself, with numbers you can share: outlets signed per month, live rate, retention.

• Existing relationships with Bangalore restaurant owners and managers.

• Comfort with deal maths and simple spreadsheets.

• Energy for field work. This is not a desk job.

Nice to have

• Understanding of card payments at restaurants (terminals, merchant IDs, settlement).

• Experience with restaurant billing systems like Petpooja or Restroworks.

• Kannada.

Our growth today comes from developers who found the repo, installed it, and told someone. Your job is to make far more of them find it.

This is a writing job for someone who likes software. You don't need to be an engineer, but you do need to be the kind of person who installs the tool, breaks it on purpose, and finds the story in what happened. The best thing we can publish is a developer explaining something true and specific about debugging agents — that's the bar, and you'll hit it weekly.

We move fast, debate hard, and execute even harder. You'll work in person with me at least 3 days a week. You won't own everything in one summer — you'll pick a channel with me and own that number end-to-end. There's a path into our full-time Founding GTM role; be aware that role adds calls and pipeline to the writing, so converting means growing into the commercial half too.

What You’ll Do

•
Write the things developers actually read — technical deep dives, postmortems, and docs-as-marketing about what breaks in production agents and how to see it. Not thought leadership; specific, useful writing with real traces and real code in it.

•
Run the launches — Hacker News, Product Hunt, Reddit, and X. You'll write the post, prepare the assets, be in the comments answering people all day, and do the follow-through that turns a spike into retained users.

•
Own SEO and GEO — comparison pages and problem-first pages that rank, and getting TraceRoot cited by ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity when someone asks how to debug an agent. This is a compounding channel and it will be substantially yours.

•
Show the product, don't describe it — short demo clips, screenshots, and walkthroughs that make the thing obvious in ten seconds; plus dev-influencer collabs, hackathons, and a Discord where people actually get answers.

•
Know what worked — track which post, page, or launch actually drove installs and traces, and say so honestly, including when the answer is "none of them." We'll set you up in PostHog; you don't need to build it.

Requirements

•
You write, and people read it: a blog, a newsletter, a thread that went somewhere, docs, a README people thanked you for. Any of it counts. Send it.

•
Technically curious enough to be credible: you can install TraceRoot yourself with Claude Code, read a stack trace, and explain what happened without a hand-holder. You do not need to write production code for this role.

•
You have taste in developer content: you know why a post lands on Hacker News and why marketing copy gets torn apart there, because you read those threads for fun.

•
Fast and prolific: you'd rather ship six pieces and learn which two worked than polish one for a month.

•
Strong sense of ownership and bias for action: you own outcomes, not tasks, and you make things happen without waiting for a roadmap or a content calendar.

Preferred Experience

•
You've done this unpaid already: grown an open-source project, run a technical blog or newsletter, or written docs for something people use.

•
In the community: you're around people building agents, and you know who the voices are.

•
LLMs as a tool, not a topic: you use model APIs to research, draft, and repurpose — and you know exactly where that stops working and you have to write it yourself.

To Apply

Send two things:

•
Two sentences on the first experiment you'd run to get more agent-building teams onto TraceRoot.

•
A link to something you built — a repo, a script, a scraper, a landing page, a Discord bot, an outreach system. It does not need to be a growth project and it does not need to be impressive; we just want to see you ship.

d.description:
About Atlys

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.

Atlys is changing that.

We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we’re still early.

The Role

We’re looking for a Content & Campaign Operations Intern to keep a high-volume content engine moving, from the first conversation to the final video. You’ll work with our marketing team on influencer videos and customer stories, and make sure creators and customers always know what happens next.

This is a hands-on, in-office role at our Delhi HQ. It suits someone who enjoys content and coordination equally and likes closing loops.

The Job

•
Find the right creators: Shortlist influencers whose content and audience fit Atlys, and help shape a storyline for each one that feels true to them.

•
Drive videos to go-live: Coordinate with our agency for each creator through the shoot, edit and go-live stages, working towards 180 videos live every month.

•
Pitch customer stories: Reach out to travellers who got their visas through Atlys, explain the testimonial project and pitch the perks, including hotel vouchers and other Atlys benefits.

•
Run testimonial shoots: Bring interested customers on board and coordinate shoots at their location or the Atlys office with the customer, agency and internal team.

•
Close every loop: Track feedback, revisions, follow-ups, confirmations and deadlines across both projects, so no conversation gets lost and every video moves towards going live.

The Ideal Candidate

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

•
Take ownership, follow up without being chased, and spot delays and blockers before they slow things down.

•
Write clear, engaging, grammatically sound copy, whether it’s a message, a content brief or a basic script.

•
Speak articulately and are comfortable talking to people on calls and in person.

•
Know what makes a creator, angle or storyline interesting, and stay on top of internet trends, memes and pop culture.

•
Can manage many conversations at once, keep trackers up to date and hold deadlines.

We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.

What you can expect

Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

Here’s what you can expect:

•
Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.

•
Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.

•
A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.

•
Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.

•
Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.

•
Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.

•
Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.

•
An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

Come build the intelligence layer for global travel

About LiveFlow

LiveFlow is on a mission to redefine how businesses manage their finances.

We have raised over $21M from top-tier investors including: YC, YC Continuity, Valar Seedcamp, WndrCo, Moonfire, Bradley Horowitz (VP Product, Google) and more.

We are helping thousands of companies to streamline their financial workflows and we have hundreds of 5/5 ratings on G2.

Our founding team previously worked at Europe's fastest growing fintech, Revolut.

About the role

We're hiring a Field Marketing Lead to own field marketing end-to-end. One of our core verticals is Restaurant & Hospitality businesses, and your mission is to get every restaurant owner in New York City to know about us.

Here’s what you’ll do

•
Lead, run and execute our door-to-door launch across New York.

•
Hire and motivate a team of 10–20 brand ambassadors who will visit restaurants in person.

•
Build an exceptional team culture among the brand ambassadors.

•
Host owner dinners, chef roundtables and industry events.

•
Work with sales to generate a high-quality pipeline and ensure high conversion.

•
Team up with restaurant groups, suppliers, POS companies and creators to get us warm intros and get owners talking.

What we’re looking for in you

•
You have experience leading field marketing teams.

•
You can quickly hire brand ambassadors to work for you.

•
You have a good network in New York City and can make things happen quickly.

•
People are drawn to you and follow you, and you can motivate a team of ambassadors.

•
It’s a big bonus if you’ve worked in restaurants or hospitality, or led field marketing for a restaurant or hospitality business.

Why join us

•
You get the autonomy to run the show. We expect you to be self-guided and able to work very autonomously.

•
We work hard to stretch you and expand your capabilities by giving you challenging goals and missions.

Location & compensation

•
New York City.

•
Fully in person, with a lot of flexibility on where you work during the day, as you’ll spend most of your days outside the office.

•
$100,000–$130,000 per year.

d.description:
About Tessera Labs

Tessera is an AI-native platform for enterprise transformation. The multi-agent platform delivers governed execution across ERP, CRM, HCM, and finance systems, cutting timelines from years to weeks and costs by more than half. Built on deep expertise across SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, Workday, and other systems of record, Tessera combines the reliability of an integrator with the speed of an AI-native platform.

For decades, enterprises have struggled with fragmented business systems, where migrations have consumed hundreds of millions of dollars, data stayed inconsistent and unreliable, and business processes slowed under manual review. Tessera was founded to change that, for SAP and every other system enterprises depend on. The name itself — a tessera, a single tile in a mosaic — reflects our mission: unifying the disparate pieces of the enterprise into a coherent whole. Tessera is an AI-powered, multi-agent platform that harmonizes systems and lets teams work in plain English.

Role Summary

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) for our Applied Data & ML capability. You will work directly with enterprise clients to turn fragmented, multi-system enterprise data into trusted data products and production ML models.

You will collaborate closely with client teams, SMEs and Tessera product engineers to translate complex business logic into data pipelines, canonical data models and applied ML solutions, and you will feed proven patterns back into the Tessera platform.

The role requires strong experience in SQL, Python, data modeling and applied machine learning, combined with the judgment to own ambiguous client problems end to end. This is a mid- to senior-level role.

This role owns delivery quality on your engagements: validation, reconciliation to source and stakeholder sign-off.

Why Join Tessera

•
Build at the frontier of applied AI. Work on a multi-agent AI platform that automates complex business workflows across SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, Workday, Snowflake, MuleSoft and more, and help bring real AI automation to the enterprise.

•
Shape the platform, not just the project. The pipelines, canonical models, mapping rules and ML components you build become reusable parts of the Tessera platform, and your field input goes straight to our product and R&D teams.

•
Work on real enterprise data. Harmonize master and transactional data across ERP, CRM, HCM and finance systems, and take ML models from feature engineering to production.

•
See more in a year than most see in five. You will work across several enterprise customers and landscapes, alongside senior functional architects, Forward Deployed Engineers and AI engineers.

•
Own real outcomes. You will work in a software platform company where engineers are trusted with decisions, and where the measure of success is what customers adopt and keep using.

Key Responsibilities

1. Deploy with Clients

•
Embed with client teams to scope data and ML problems, map source systems and deliver working outcomes in weeks.

•
Own delivery quality, including validation, reconciliation to source and stakeholder sign-off.

•
Turn repeated client patterns into reusable components for the Tessera platform.

2. Build and Harmonize Enterprise Data

•
Design and develop scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL, Python and dbt to ingest and transform data from enterprise platforms, including ERP, CRM, HCM and finance systems.

•
Design canonical enterprise data models and cross-system mapping rules that standardize master and transactional data.

•
Implement validation, reconciliation and monitoring to resolve duplicate, inconsistent and legacy data.

3. Apply Machine Learning

•
Engineer features and build models on enterprise data for use cases such as forecasting and anomaly detection.

•
Deploy models to production and monitor them.

Required Qualifications

•
5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, ML Engineering or Applied Data Science.

•
Enterprise data harmonization, migration or analytics experience across ERP, CRM or finance systems.

•
Experience in client-facing, consulting or forward-deployed roles.

•
Advanced SQL, and strong Python for data pipelines and ML workflows.

•
Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines and processing large-scale enterprise datasets.

•
Relational and dimensional data modeling.

•
dbt for transformation, testing and documentation.

•
Cloud platform experience (AWS, GCP or Azure).

•
At least one ML model built, deployed and monitored in production on business data.

•
Feature engineering from structured and time-series enterprise data, and model evaluation and monitoring.

•
Working knowledge of core enterprise data domains and business processes, such as finance, supply chain and master data.

•
Systems thinking: the ability to understand complex enterprise systems and business processes, and to turn business rules into data and ML solutions that work across platforms.

•
Client ownership: comfortable working directly with client engineers, functional consultants and business stakeholders, scoping ambiguity, and pushing back with evidence.

•
Data problem solving: strong analytical skills to diagnose and resolve enterprise data and model performance challenges.

•
Ownership and execution: the ability to take ownership of complex problems and deliver production-grade solutions that scale across enterprise environments.

Who This Role Is Not For

If you prefer to work on clean, well-documented datasets inside a single platform team, this is not the role: the data here is fragmented, duplicated and spread across ERP, CRM, HCM and finance systems. If you would rather hand a pipeline or model over than own it through validation, reconciliation to source and client sign-off, the same applies. And if you are not comfortable working directly with client stakeholders, scoping ambiguity and pushing back with evidence, you will not enjoy this role.

Preferred Qualifications

•
Hands-on experience
