d.description:
About Exa

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders & dropouts alike.

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

We are looking for a Head of Product Marketing to be the bridge between what we build and how the market hears about it.

About the Role

You'll lead the product marketing function: hiring and managing product & technical marketers who ship content for both customers and our sales team. This is a player-coach role, so you should enjoy being in the trenches with the team, able to write positioning, frame launches, evaluate competitors, and pitch customers.

This role demands a technical background since you will spend time with engineers, and you will need to understand retrieval, agents, and APIs. It is also imperative that you be fluent with AI tools, both to drive team productivity and to understand how our AI-forward customers are doing their jobs.

This role bridges product marketing to the product/engineering org. The person in this role will ensure that our fast-moving product roadmap translates into a steady stream of high-impact launches, announcements, and demos. Conversely, this role should bring market feedback into the prioritization process. You will be the person to surface valuable features and evaluate competitive positioning, with the ultimate aim of building the world’s best search engine for AI agents.

This role is based in-person at our San Francisco HQ.

What You'll Own

The launch calendar

Own the conversion of the engineering roadmap into a sequenced calendar of launches, announcements, and demos. Decide what gets a moment and what ships quietly, and make sure every launch that deserves attention gets a coordinated one. Success is measured by launch cadence and the reach of launch (coverage, signups, developer buzz).

Competitive intelligence

Document the competitive landscape: who is shipping what, where we lead, and where we need to be wary. Help train our sales team to educate customers how Exa can best meet their needs. Success is measured by our win rate.

Positioning and messaging

Own the positioning and messaging architecture for Exa. Maintain a consistent structure, and fill it in yourself for major releases. Success is measured by clarity and consistent adoption.

Content for website home & product pages

Ensure our website tells the story: the homepage, product, industries, and use case pages. You own the message, navigation, and page structure, while Digital Marketing owns the site mechanics, performance, and conversion surfaces. Success is measured by website freshness and visitor satisfaction.

Interlock with product

Be the trusted channel between marketing and product/engineering. Sit close enough to the work to know what's coming, translate engineering features into market vernacular, and synthesize market signals to shape our roadmap (such as win/loss, customer needs, adoption by segment, etc). Success is measured by market share and customer consumption.

Team leadership

Manage, coach, and grow the product marketing team, starting with 4 headcount today. Set the bar, develop people, and build a function that ships without you in the room. Success is measured by the caliber of the team and by their output trajectory under your stewardship.

What Success Looks Like

•
Positioning is consistent, technically credible, and used across the company.

•
Launches increase in reach and impact

•
Competitive gaps are surfaced and prioritized with evidence

•
The website is compelling for developer audiences, leading to high conversion

•
Sales is well-supported with assets and training for high win-rate and fast sales cycles

•
PMM team grows in capability, able to ship when you’re out-of-office

•
Engineering welcomes your collaboration because you make the product better.

You Should Have

•
8+ years in product marketing or product management at a B2B technology company, with meaningful time on the more technical, roadmap-facing end.

•
A genuinely technical background. You can hold a conversation with engineers about retrieval, agents, and APIs, and you have the credibility to push Engineering on competitive gaps.

•
Experience managing a team of 3 or more, with evidence you developed people.

•
A track record turning a roadmap into launches with impact.

•
Deep competitive intelligence experience, synthesizing signals into decisions about what to build or how to position.

•
Excellent writing. You can still write positioning when it counts.

•
Evidence of influence without ownership: a time you changed what a product team prioritized using market evidence, without having authority over the roadmap.

•
A proven AI builder mindset: you've shipped tools & assets using agents, not just used ChatGPT.

Nice to Have

•
A background as an engineer, or a computer science or technical degree, before moving into marketing or product.

•
Experience at an API-first, infrastructure, or developer tools company.

•
Domain depth in search, retrieval, RAG, or agent frameworks.

•
Experience as the marketing counterpart to a founder-owned roadmap, and a track record of making that relationship productive.

•
Experience building a product marketing function from small beginnings at a high-growth startup.

Exa is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity

Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

The Mission:

We are living through the most significant technological shift since the dawn of the internet. At Kong, we aren't just watching the AI revolution, we are building the infrastructure that makes it possible. We are the intelligent nervous system for modern architecture, seamlessly connecting APIs, microservices, and LLMs for the world’s most ambitious brands.

As enterprises race to integrate AI, they face a wall of complexity. We are the bridge. We help the global 2000 modernize their legacy systems and securely unlock the power of AI across their entire organization. This isn't just sales; it’s architecting the future of global commerce.

The Role: Impact & Ownership

We are looking for a strategic, high-achieving, and disciplined Enterprise Account Executive to join our world-class team. At Kong, we don't leave success to chance. We are a "master the craft" company. We rely on proven frameworks, deep technical curiosity, and collaborative execution.

If you thrive when navigating complex, high-stakes deals and love the challenge of selling transformational technology to visionary CTOs and Chief Architects, you’ve found your next home.

What You Will Achieve

•
Pioneer New Markets: Lead the full sales cycle to welcome new six- and seven-figure enterprise partners into the Kong ecosystem.

•
Master the Framework: Use the MEDDIC methodology not just as an acronym, but as a strategic tool to uncover value, mitigate risk, and drive predictable success.

•
Navigate the C-Suite: Orchestrate complex, multi-threaded sales cycles, building deep trust with everyone from lead engineers to C-level executives.

•
Collaborative Excellence: Partner with our expert Solutions Engineering team to prove the massive ROI and technical superiority of the Kong platform.

•
Define Your Legacy: Maintain a pristine pipeline and deliver accurate forecasts that help shape the strategic direction of our sales organization.

What You Bring to the Journey:

•
A Track Record of Excellence: 5+ years of experience selling complex enterprise software platforms, with a history of consistently exceeding goals and reaching the top tier of your organization.

•
Technical Curiosity: You have a passion for infrastructure, DevOps, or AI-enabling technologies. You don't just sell the product; you understand the "why" behind it.

•
Strategic Discipline: You value a structured approach. You know that sustainable, scalable success comes from mastering the playbook and executing with precision.

•
Executive Presence: You are a compelling storyteller, capable of articulating the strategic business value of AI and APIs to the world’s most sophisticated technical leaders.

•
Resilient Drive: You bring the persistence, grit, and proactive mindset required to win in a high-velocity, competitive landscape.

Why You’ll Thrive at Kong:

•
Category-Defining Technology: Sell a product that engineers genuinely love and that the world’s largest companies need to survive an AI-first world.

•
Uncapped Opportunity: A competitive base salary paired with an aggressive, uncapped commission structure that rewards those who go above and beyond.

•
Exponential Growth: We are scaling fast and we invest in our people. If you want to grow your career, we provide the path, the training, and the mentorship to get you there.

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

•
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

•
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

•
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

•
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

•
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

•
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

•
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

•
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

•
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

•
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

•
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

•
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

•
Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

•
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're hiring a GTM Lead to own how ElevenLabs builds outbound pipeline in North America. This isn't a traditional SDR management role. You'll lead a team of SDRs, build the AI agents and workflows that work alongside them, and stay close enough to the work to prospect and sell yourself.

You'll join at an exciting point: a strong SDR foundation is in place, new starters are joining, and more hires are planned as we grow. You'll define the next version of outbound here: what gets automated, what stays human, and how we break into new accounts and segments. Then you'll build it. We're an AI company, and our outbound motion should prove it.

This role is measured in pipeline dollars and revenue, not activity. If you've carried a closing number, built something real with AI, and get energy from developing people and watching your team win, we'd love to hear from you.

In this role you will:

•
Own outbound pipeline for our Corporate and Mid-Market segments in North America, with targets set in pipeline dollars and revenue

•
Lead and grow a team of SDRs, with more headcount planned

•
Stay hands-on as a player-coach: prospect, open new accounts, and coach in the moment

•
Build the AI agents, automations and signal-based workflows that let a lean team cover a large market, starting with ElevenLabs' own products

•
Run go-to-market experiments across segments, channels and markets, and double down on what works

•
Build onboarding, enablement and coaching that grow SDRs into future closers

•
Partner with Account Executives, sales leadership, marketing and RevOps on targets, ICP and a clean handoff to AEs

Requirements

•
8+ years in B2B software or technology sales, including time in a closing seat (AE, account manager or full-cycle seller) where you carried a number and beat it

•
Experience leading people: managing SDRs, AEs or a mix, or building a sales function from the ground up

•
You build with AI, you don't just use it: you've shipped agents, automations or workflows that changed how you or your team sells, and you can walk us through them

•
Recent, hands-on outbound experience with technical and business buyers

•
You work from the numbers that matter (pipeline dollars, conversion, win rate, deal size) and you know CRM and modern outbound tooling well

•
A track record at fast-growing companies; you're comfortable with ambiguity and pace

•
Clear, concise communication, and a coaching style that makes people better

Bonus

•
Early-stage or Series A–D startup experience, especially as a founding AE or first go-to-market hire

•
Exposure to voice AI, AI agents, customer experience, or developer tools and APIs

•
You've already built something with ElevenLabs

•
Experience with globally distributed teams

Location

This role is remote-first and can be done from anywhere in the United States. You must be able to work in ET, CT, MT or PT time zones. We prefer candidates based in San Francisco.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About FirstWork

FirstWork is an applied AI company building the next generation of workforce operations technology.

We work with companies across staffing, logistics, healthcare, and retail that manage large frontline workforces. These businesses deal with complex, highly manual processes involving hiring, onboarding, document verification, compliance, training, and ongoing workforce management.

We're using AI agents to automate these workflows, working alongside human teams and integrating with the systems businesses already use.

Having raised $15M in our Series A, led by Earlybird Venture Capital, bringing our total funding to $20M, we're entering an exciting phase of growth. With established enterprise customers and a growing product footprint, we're expanding beyond hiring and onboarding to build a comprehensive AI-powered workforce operations platform.

About the Role

We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to work at the intersection of product engineering, customer implementation, and applied AI.

In this role, you'll work directly with enterprise customers to understand their hiring, onboarding, and compliance workflows and translate those requirements into working solutions using FirstWork.

You'll own client implementations end to end, from discovery and solution design to integrations, automation, deployment, and ongoing support. You'll build integrations with external systems, configure AI-powered document verification workflows, develop automations, and work closely with our product and engineering teams to solve customer-specific challenges.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you'll write code, solve real-world technical problems, interact directly with customers, and see the impact of your work in live enterprise environments.

What Makes This Opportunity Exciting?

•
Work at the intersection of AI and engineering: Build practical solutions using AI agents, automation, APIs, and integrations.

•
Own implementations end to end: Take responsibility for turning complex customer requirements into working product experiences.

•
Solve real-world technical challenges: Work with diverse enterprise systems, complex workflows, and compliance requirements.

•
Work directly with customers: Collaborate with stakeholders ranging from recruiters and compliance teams to senior executives.

•
Shape the product: Bring customer learnings back to engineering and help turn repeated implementation challenges into reusable platform capabilities.

What You'll Do

•
Lead enterprise client implementations from discovery through go-live, translating business processes into working hiring and onboarding workflows in FirstWork.

•
Build and maintain integrations with ATS, VMS, payroll, and HR systems using REST APIs, webhooks, and file-based data synchronization.

•
Design and configure AI-powered document verification pipelines for identity documents, licenses, certifications, and country-specific compliance requirements.

•
Build RPA automations for systems that lack APIs, including workflows such as timesheet entry and credential uploads.

•
Write scripts for data mapping, migrations, debugging, and reporting.

•
Investigate production issues, identify root causes, and collaborate with product and engineering teams to implement fixes.

•
Lead client calls, product demonstrations, and implementation status updates, communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

•
Work closely with customers to understand their operational challenges and recommend practical technical solutions.

•
Share customer feedback and implementation learnings with the product team to help build reusable features and improve the platform.

What We're Looking For

•
2–6 years of experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, implementation, or technical consulting.

•
Strong Python and SQL skills, with the ability to read, understand, and debug existing code.

•
Hands-on experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and third-party system integrations.

•
Ability to understand complex or loosely defined business processes and translate them into clear technical solutions.

•
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.

•
Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

•
A strong ownership mindset and the ability to drive implementations through to successful go-live.

•
Comfort working across time zones with US and European clients.

Nice to Have

•
Experience with HR tech, staffing, ATS, or HRIS platforms such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, or Salesforce.

•
Exposure to workforce compliance workflows, including I-9, W-4, right-to-work checks, background checks, or credentialing.

•
Experience with RPA tools, n8n, or workflow automation platforms.

•
Experience using LLMs for document extraction, validation, or AI-powered automation.

•
Previous experience in a startup or customer-facing technical role.

Why Join FirstWork?

•
Build real-world AI solutions: Work on practical AI applications that automate complex enterprise workflows.

•
Combine engineering with customer impact: See how the systems you build directly improve business operations.

•
Take ownership: Drive implementations from initial discovery to production deployment.

•
Work across technology and product: Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and enterprise customers.

•
Grow with FirstWork: Join a growing applied AI company and help shape how enterprise AI solutions are built and deployed.

Firstwork is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status.

d.description:
About Atlys

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.

Atlys is changing that.

We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we’re still early.

The Role

Our partners - card networks, banks, airlines, travel platforms, fintechs - are mostly many times our size. The job is to get a decision-maker to take the call, then build a construct that works commercially for both sides.

The second part is the hard part. A visa is a low-frequency purchase. A partnership only works if you find the moment in the partner's own customer journey where we belong, and structure the economics so they have a reason to care. There's no playbook.

The Job

•
Own a portfolio of live partnerships - deepen them and grow what they generate.

•
Take 4–5 new partnerships live every month, with most partnerships going from first conversation to live in about two weeks.

•
Run longer-term partnerships that may span months, multiple geographies, and involve product, legal and procurement teams.

•
Write cold outreach that gets a reply from someone senior.

•
Build the commercial construct, not just the relationship.

•
Drive go-live across product, operations and legal to ensure partnerships move from conversation to execution.

•
Own the numbers on every relationship you hold and stay accountable for the outcomes of your partnerships.

The Ideal Candidate

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

•
Have 0–2 years of experience. Exceptional fresh graduates are welcome.

•
Have no degree or institution filter - we care about what you can do, not where you studied.

•
Write exceptionally well. This is the highest-weighted skill for this role.

•
Can reason from first principles and build a deal structure when there is no precedent to follow.

•
Can be the most junior person in the room and still run the conversation confidently.

•
Have strong commercial judgement and can think about what creates value for both Atlys and the partner.

•
Are patient, input-driven and comfortable with outcomes that can be lumpy while the work remains consistent every day.

•
Take strong ownership and are comfortable building something without a predefined playbook.

•
Communicate exceptionally well and can build relationships with senior decision-makers.

We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.

What you can expect

Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

Here’s what you can expect:

•
Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.

•
Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.

•
A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.

•
Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.

•
Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.

•
Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.

•
Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.

•
An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

Come build the intelligence layer for global travel

d.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Global Affairs team builds relationships with communities to help ensure that artificial intelligence benefits people broadly. The partnership team works with organizations and leaders across education, workforce development, labor, faith, civil rights, and other communities. We build partnerships that help people use AI in ways that matter to their lives, strengthen the organizations serving their communities, and ensure their experiences and concerns help shape OpenAI’s work.

About the Role

We’re looking for a resourceful partnerships professional who combines strong external relationship skills with the judgment and organizational ability to move complex initiatives forward.

You will manage designated external relationships and lead the day-to-day delivery of partnerships across the team’s portfolios and Working with portfolio leads, you will translate agreed objectives into practical programs, represent OpenAI in partner conversations, coordinate internal contributions, and carry commitments through delivery.

You will also step into emerging priorities: helping launch a new collaboration, advancing an existing partnership, preparing a senior leader for an external engagement, or coordinating a project involving several teams. Your portfolio will evolve with team priorities, with clear ownership and agreed outcomes for each assignment.

This role requires someone who enjoys building relationships and doing the detailed work that makes those relationships productive. You should be comfortable working independently, learning unfamiliar issues quickly, and knowing when to seek expertise or escalate a decision.

In this role, you will:

•
Own external relationships. Build and manage trusted relationships with nonprofit organizations, civic leaders, community institutions, and other partners across a range of diverse perspectives and communities.

•
Develop and deliver partnerships. Translate shared interests into practical collaborations with clear objectives, scope, responsibilities, timelines, and measures of success.

•
Represent OpenAI externally. Lead partner meetings and briefings, participate in convenings, and communicate clearly about AI’s opportunities and safe and responsible use.

•
Contribute across the team’s priorities. Take ownership of defined projects across different portfolios, support colleagues during major initiatives, and help establish new areas of engagement.

•
Connect partners with internal expertise. Work with policy, product, safety, legal, communications, and education colleagues to develop substantive engagements and secure the contributions needed for delivery.

•
Turn stakeholder insight into action. Identify concerns and opportunities, synthesize what we hear, bring relevant feedback to internal owners, and close the loop with partners.

•
Deliver funded partnership programs. Translate agreed commitments into feasible workplans with clear owners, milestones, and outcomes. Work directly with partners and portfolio leads to resolve program questions, coordinate implementation, and assess results, including recommendations for improvement or renewal.

•
Coordinate partnership implementation across teams. Bring together relationship owners and colleagues in policy, legal, finance, procurement, product, and communications to move agreements, funding processes, and program launches forward; track dependencies, resolve or escalate blockers, and keep partners and internal teams informed of progress.

•
Maintain reliable follow-through. Manage workplans, partner commitments, budgets, and approval processes for your projects; surface dependencies and risks early and recommend solutions.

•
Exercise sound prioritization. Assess incoming opportunities against team goals, recommend where to invest time and resources, and adjust plans as circumstances change.

You might thrive in this role if you:

•
Bring 6+ years of relevant experience in partnerships, external affairs, public policy, campaigns, government, nonprofits, or community engagement, or equivalent experience demonstrating these capabilities.

•
Have independently managed external relationships and delivered complex partnership programs, including scoping commitments, coordinating multiple teams, managing budgets, and evaluating outcomes.

•
Combine political and stakeholder judgment with strong execution skills, including navigating disagreement and sensitive issues.

•
Can build credibility with people whose experiences and views differ from your own.

•
Write clearly, communicate confidently, and translate complex topics for nontechnical audiences.

•
Are organized and responsive, can manage several projects at once, and take responsibility for completing commitments.

•
Work effectively across teams without formal authority and make thoughtful decisions about when to act independently and when to seek alignment.

•
Enjoy a varied portfolio and can move between relationship development, strategic thinking, and hands-on delivery.

•
Are curious about AI and its implications for communities, public institutions, and economic opportunity.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and E

About TypeSafe

We’re building prod, not god. TypeSafe AI is a truly novel AI lab building machine-native intelligence infrastructure for automation – designed to make decisions within software by combining the intelligence of LLMs with the efficiency and reliability of code into a new shape of AI: System One Models.

Our first public model, Jev, was launched just 2 months ago. Adoption has been incredibly rapid, and we now count around one-third of the Fortune 500 as users.

We’re a small, fast-moving team from OpenAI, Google Brain, and Meta/FAIR, backed by top-tier investors like Andreessen Horowitz and Sequoia.

About the role

As one of TypeSafe’s first Forward Deployed Engineers, you’ll be helping to shape how the FDE function delivers value to our customers. You’ll be customers’ primary technical partner, helping them turn promising ideas into production software built on Jev. You’ll work closely with developers and enterprise teams to identify valuable use cases, prove performance, and grow adoption across their organizations.

You’ll also build with Jev yourself: creating internal tools, exploring new applications, and turning what you learn into demos, cookbooks, and product feedback. This is a hands-on role for an engineer who loves understanding customer problems and helping people build.

What you’ll own

•
Help customers discover and develop great use cases for Jev. Understand their workflows, identify where Jev can deliver meaningful value, and help unblock engineering teams technically – whether writing a doc or cookbook, jamming with customer engineering teams, or getting hands-on with code.

•
Growing our developer education efforts at scale. Use your insights to create high-impact cookbooks, documentation, example repos, technical blogs, visual explainers, and case studies that help more developers succeed.

•
Give confident, engaging technical demos and talks whether to engineering execs or at community events. Support hackathons, answer questions, and build lasting relationships with people using TypeSafe.

•
Be a collaborative and trusted technical partner with AEs on technical discovery, demos, and evaluation results that drive deals to success.

We are looking for people who

•
Have great product sense: can intuit what customers are trying to achieve, and what can really move the needle for them

•
Are strong, hands-on engineers: can rapidly prototype eye-catching demos for a customer call, write evaluation scripts, and understand data across a wide range of customer domains.

•
Enjoy working closely with customers: asking thoughtful questions, understanding their goals and organizations, and building relationships.

•
Have sound technical judgment. You understand representative datasets, baselines, precision and recall, thresholds, and failure analysis, and can explain where a model is useful and where it falls short.

•
Communicate clearly with developers and business stakeholders, whether through a technical conversation, a demo, documentation, or example code.

•
Have built in a customer-facing technical role, such as an FDE, solutions engineer, or sales engineer; or bring product engineering, applied AI, or founder experience with a strong customer focus.

•
Thrive in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment: we’re a small team, and you’ll be helping to evolve how FDE works at TypeSafe. You should be able to autonomously navigate that ambiguity to find the points of highest leverage and impact.

Life at TypeSafe

We’re a small, flat, close-knit team dedicated to real-world impact preparing the world for Transformative AI. Our team works fully in-person in our San Francisco office near Embarcadero station. We love what we do and care about our work a lot.

We strive for excellence and craftsmanship and won't stop until we get there. When the team wins, we all win, and we enjoy collaborating and inspiring each other to grow as a team and as individuals.

We also value emotional honesty, kindness, and bringing your whole self to work. We build machines; we don't try to be machines.

We want you to be able to do the most impactful work of your career at TypeSafe and help define our future as a company.

We provide

•
100% covered health insurance

•
Daily lunch and dinner

•
Visa sponsorships

•
401(k) plans

About the team

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team partners with customers to turn research breakthroughs into production systems. We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development.

About the Role

As a Manager of our Deployment Leads in APAC, you’ll lead and grow a team of DLs through high-stakes customer deployments, owning technical and business outcomes end to end. You’ll help build the function as you lead it, navigating significant ambiguity to define its scope and ways of working.

You’ll partner with FDE, Product, Research, and GTM to balance customer-specific solutions with reusable capabilities and ensure field insights inform product priorities. Drawing on your experience leading complex technical deployments and products, you’ll guide decisions on scope, feasibility, sequencing, and delivery readiness, helping your team make sound tradeoffs and build lasting customer trust.

Success will be measured by the impact of your team’s deployments, the growth of your DLs, and how effectively the team and delivery model scale.

This role is based in Singapore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. This role will require travel up to 25%.

In this role, you will:

•
Lead and grow a team of DLs delivering production systems with frontier models

•
Own end-to-end delivery outcomes, from scoping through production, adoption, and handoff

•
Set direction and build trust across technical teams, GTM, and customer executives

•
Codify what works into practical playbooks, consistent delivery practices, and product roadmap inputs

•
Set a high bar for DL performance through hands-on coaching, actionable feedback, and career development

•
Make staffing decisions, develop future DL leaders, and build a team that scales without unnecessary complexity

You might thrive in this role if you:

•
Bring 8+ years of customer-facing technical delivery or product leadership experience, including 2+ years managing high-performing teams.

•

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

•
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

•
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

•
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

•
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

•
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

•
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

•
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

•
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

•
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

•
Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

You blend that with sales, solutions engineering, or product marketing experience, so you can teach sellers how to use a product, how to demo it, and how to pitch it.

This role sits within GTM Enablement and reports to the Product & Technical Enablement Lead. You will work in close partnership with:

•
Product marketing and engineering teams (keeping content accurate as the platform ships)

•
GTM enablement (aligning on shared onboarding infrastructure)

You will support product enablement for our go-to-market teams across Agents, APIs, and Creative, with the most day-to-day focus on API and Creative launches. This is a full-stack role on a lean team: you’ll build content, deliver training, design practice environments, and flex across products as needed.

What you’ll do

•
Support new product launches: get an early heads-up from product marketing, research, and engineering, follow releases from alpha through GA, and have training ready before launch day, not the week of

•
Build launch workshops: go beyond what shipped and why it matters, with hands-on workshops on how to use the product, how to demo it, and how to pitch the value

•
Support competitive enablement: turn product marketing battlecards into trainings, simulations, and demo workshops, so sellers can answer parity, differentiation, and value questions with confidence

•
Support product certification: help define what “product certified” means for GTM teams, and build the playbooks and training content that raise product confidence across the whole field, not only new hires

•
Support everboarding and onboarding: keep training tied to new releases and capabilities, and keep content current as products ship

•
Craft realistic practice environments: demo certifications, role-play scenarios, and customer simulations with scored feedback, built on our own agent technology

•
Operate AI-natively: use ElevenLabs’ own voice and agent technology to build training and practice environments; default to AI tools to build faster, and teach others to do the same

•
Measure what matters: define and track the percent of sellers certified within 2 weeks of GA, demo and pitch quality scores, and win rate and stage progression against named competitors, and use the data to improve each launch

Requirements

We’re looking for someone who knows our products well and can teach sellers to demo and sell them. You’ll thrive here if you:

•
Have 4-7+ years as an enterprise seller or solutions engineer, or as a seller who moved into product marketing or enablement, at a SaaS, platform, or API-first company

•
Are hands-on with agents, APIs, or creative tools, and understand at a conceptual level how they work

About Y/n

Y/n is creating a new form of entertainment: interactive stories. Y/n lets people play a character in a book, finally letting anyone meddle with the universes and characters they care about.

Our mission is to build a superhuman A.I. storyteller and distribute it to billions of people. We're giving the technology to creators, so they can turn their most ingenious ideas into stories others can live in.

To date, people have sent over one billion messages on Y/n. Teenagers and twenty-somethings are going to imaginary schools, falling in love with fictional people, and living out entire lives in A.I.-generated stories made for them. Soon, billions will play stories too, across every genre, in text, in video, alone or with their friends. By 2030, playing stories will become the dominant form of entertainment.

Our culture

Our culture is simple:

•
Story quality determines Y/n's success, so we hire people obsessed with making stories great.

•
We are commercially minded. We want people who use their abilities to make numbers go up.

•
We run Y/n like a hedge fund: a small group of people making very big bets on model training and network effects. We hire people who think rigorously and own their domain.

We've raised $14M from Sequoia Capital, Kleiner Perkins, Parable and Y Combinator, and we're hiring for several roles. If you want to live in pursuit of superhuman storytelling, join us.

What you'll do

•
Build and manage our UGC program, from creator sourcing and partnerships to content execution.

•
Create engaging, native content for TikTok and Instagram.

•
Develop fresh, unconventional ideas to grow our social presence and community.

•
Identify emerging trends and cultural moments, and turn them into creative campaigns.

•
Experiment, move quickly, and turn what works into repeatable growth.

What we're looking for

•
An existing social following of 10K+ on Instagram or TikTok.

•
A strong creative instinct and a genuine passion for making content.

•
Deep familiarity with internet culture and social media trends.

•
A self-starter who takes ideas from concept to execution.

•
Kind, humble, thoughtful, and aligned with our values.

Bonus: Experience building creator communities, running UGC programs, or creating content that has taken off organically.

Think this sounds like you? We'd love to hear from you.

ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

•
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

•
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

•
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

•
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

•
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

•
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

•
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

•
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

•
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

•
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

•
Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

•
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re hiring a Sales Execution & NA Enablement Lead to raise how our enterprise sellers plan, pursue, and win complex, technical deals. This is not a traditional training role. You’ll set the standard for what great enterprise selling looks like, turn it into artifacts and operating rhythms, and make sure sellers and managers actually use it.

The role has two mandates: own key global sales execution programs, and act as the primary Enablement partner to North America sales leadership. You’ll work closely with the Global Head of Enablement, Sales Leadership, RevOps, Product Marketing, Product & Technical Enablement, and FDE.

What you’ll do

•
Own enterprise sales execution: Build and operationalize the critical artifacts that drive excellent sales execution.

•
Enable sellers to win technical enterprise deals: Coach reps to build business cases with champions, read 10-Ks, and connect ElevenLabs capabilities to measurable outcomes for technical and economic buyers.

•
Partner with NA leadership on enablement: Diagnose field gaps and adapt global programs to NA needs, including competitive positioning, developer-led motions, and vertical playbooks.

•
Facilitate globally: Lead highly engaging, practical sales execution sessions, not just build the programs behind them.

•
Manage the coaching and operating rhythm: Embed selling standards and artifacts into how managers inspect deals and coach sellers.

•
Build the foundation for a vertical selling motion: Lay the groundwork for vertical selling, which is becoming a global priority, not just an NA need.

•
Execute in an AI-native way: Use AI to scale coaching, practice, and reinforcement, going beyond general AI fluency.

Requirements

•
10+ years experience in enterprise sales leadership and enablement experience, ideally in an AI-native or developer-focused company

•
Excellence building and operationalizing value-selling artifacts across sales org with measurable results

•
Experience with MEDDICC, Command of the Message, Challenger, or similar methodologies, and the judgment to adapt them

•
Experience enabling frontline sales managers and building strong coaching methodologies

•
AI fluency, and comfort building in a fast-growing environment where the operating model is still taking shape

•
Enough technical depth to credibly support sellers selling to developers and technical buyers

•
Proven cross-functional influence across Sales, RevOps, PMM, Product, and FDE teams

•
Bonus: Experience working in voice AI

Location

This is a remote-first role. Candidates must be based in North America.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

What is Kalshi?

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

•
Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.

•
Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

ROLE ROADMAP

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to help Kalshi’s Growth team move faster. You’ll build tools, automate workflows, ship experiments, and solve the technical problems that stand between an idea and a launch.

You’ll work directly with growth and marketing to turn loosely defined requests into working software. Some days you’ll build something new. Other days you’ll debug an integration, fix a broken workflow, or ship a small improvement that saves the team hours. You’ll own the details and follow through until the work is live and working.

This is an opportunity for an exceptional and fast-moving early-career engineer who loves building and learns quickly. We’re scaling fast, and your scope will grow as you demonstrate what you can own.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

•
Build and maintain tools, integrations, and automations that help the Growth team execute faster.

•
Turn growth and marketing ideas into working prototypes, experiments, and production tools.

•
Troubleshoot broken workflows and integrations, resolve urgent issues, and address recurring problems at the source.

•
Connect APIs and data sources to reduce manual work and make existing tools work better together.

•
Use AI coding tools to accelerate development while taking responsibility for code quality, testing, and reliability.

•
Work directly with teammates to clarify requests, prioritize competing needs, and communicate progress.

•
Translate spontaneous business needs into verifiable technical solutions, with a short turnaround time.

•
Own projects from initial request through launch, monitoring, and iteration.

WHAT YOU BRING

•
Must have a Bachelor’s Degree (or foreign equivalent) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related field, plus 2 years of experience working on production systems.

•
Strong coding fundamentals and evidence that you can build and ship working software. Demonstrated ability developing, testing, and maintaining production software. Used languages like Python, Go (Golang), JavaScript to write polished production code. Some mobile development experience with Flutter is a plus.

•
Demonstrated ability working with both relational and NoSQL database systems, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB, including schema design, query optimization, and data modeling.

•
Demonstrated knowledge of APIs, databases, version control.

•
Ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and processes quickly and in a hands-on, feet-first fashion.

•
Resourcefulness in problem-solving – knowing when/how to ask questions while primarily acting independently.

•
Hands-on experience using AI coding tools, with the judgment to understand, debug, and improve what they produce. Your ability to multitask here is important.

•
Resourcefulness when requirements are incomplete. You ask good questions, find a practical path forward, and keep moving.

•
Strong follow-through and attention to detail. You care whether the thing you shipped actually works.

•
Comfort managing several requests at once and adapting when priorities change.

•
Readiness to put out daily fires and respond to frequent changing requests.

•
Curiosity about how software can help a business reach more users and grow.

•
Clear communication and the ability to work independently while asking for help when needed.

New graduates and engineers in the first few years of their careers are encouraged to apply. We care about what you’ve built, how you think, and how quickly you learn.

Bonus Points:

•
You’ve built and launched a product, side project, or business that people actually use.

•
Experience with marketing technology, analytics, tracking, or experimentation tools.

•
Experience running online advertisements, dropshipping, sneaker botting, restaurant reservations, video game servers, etc. You have a knack for niche applications of software and care a lot about shipping fast at scale.

•
Experience building web applications, internal tools, or workflow automations.

•
Interest in prediction markets, finance, or consumer technology.

NYC PAY TRANSPARENCY DISCLOSURE

Salary Range: 115,000 and up annually, plus equity and benefits.

Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and broad variance in experience levels within each title. If your compensation expectations exceed this range, we encourage you to reach out. We’re always happy to discuss.

Our Culture

Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.

Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1.

d.description:
About LiveFlow
LiveFlow is on a mission to redefine how businesses manage their finances. We combine AI and automation with hands-on accounting experts to run month-end close, reconciliations and reporting for multi-location businesses, especially restaurant and hospitality groups.

We have raised over $21M from top-tier investors including YC, YC Continuity, Valar, Seedcamp, WndrCo, Moonfire, Bradley Horowitz (VP Product, Google) and more.

We help thousands of companies streamline their financial workflows, and we have hundreds of 5/5 ratings on G2.

Our founding team previously worked at one of the fastest-growing fintechs, Revolut.

About the role

We are looking for a creative content creator who can make magic happen with limited resources and build a brand and following that scales.

Here's what you'll do:

•
Create content and lead creative direction

•
Grow our social channels from zero

•
Run social campaigns, launches, events, and collaborations with other content creators

•
Be involved in PR and other marketing stuff

•
Track what campaigns work and use analytical rigor to inform your next move

Here's what we're looking for:

•
You've built a social media channel to at least 20,000 followers, ideally your own, but if you did it for someone else or a brand, that's also ok.

•
You take an extreme amount of initiative, set and reach your own goals, and get things moving without being told what to do.

•
You're fully AI-native, meaning you're up to speed on the latest tools and constantly improve your workflows for more efficiency.

Here's what we DON'T require:

•
Any kind of formal education.

•
Any kind of formal prior experience at a specific company or industry.

In short, we hire raw and smart talent, and we don't believe formal experience is critical to success, especially in this role. We welcome applicants of any age and background, so please apply!

Benefits

•
Health, dental, and vision insurance.

•
Paid lunch and dinners in-office.

•
Lots of free dinners at prominent restaurants through the content you make.

•
Extensive travel.

•
Rapid learning experience.

Location: New York City.

We are a fully in-office company, but for this role, there will be a lot of flexibility, as we expect you to spend a lot of time (if not the majority) outside the office making content.
